chapters.title: Chapter 3330 Refuge! III
paragraphs: The pure white space of the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain was shaking.
Seas of authority from Noah gushed out, but because of the low level of complexity of this authority, much more of it was needed for what he wanted to do!
The Existential Entanglement he was holding onto received his thoughts on what he wanted to accomplish.
And a feedback was returned to Noah once just how much such an action would cost.
It was massive.
So massive that no entity at the stage of Eye of Existence could pay!
But Noah wasn't just some entity.
His body gushed out waves of brilliance as outside of the Blancverse Domain...
|Hey, what are you doing?|
The Ancient Phrike, Vujun, was seeking to break into it and felt the changes as its grating voice echoed out.

Its weavings began to feel a sense of urgency as if a grown entity and a child came across an extremely treasured pot of gold, and the child who could barely lift this pot was walking away with it while the grown entity could only watch.
It was a stifling feeling that just didn't sit right!
|OOOH!|
Above its silvery fur figure, a shocking banner began to unfold.
An Ordinance.
But he didn't just declare it, he had already successfully overcome the threat of the collapse of his existence to amalgamate with it.
No part of his existence was out of tune with it as he became one of this Ordinance truly!
Annihilare!
HUUUM!
The golden strings nearby began to twist and distort, this creature radiating terrifying power as his voice bellowed out.
|Break for me!|
Before it was gone.
Before something happened that took away this prized thing before it!
But...
BOOM!

Space began to distort around the white Blancverse as it ignored absolutely everything- the weavings of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer filling it to the brim as moments later, he opened his eyes and stared directly into the thousands of obsidian eyes of the Ordinance Amalgamation entity amidst the waves of webs.
"I'll come find you, O Ancient Phrike, Vujun."
The entirely obsidian eyes of the massive spider entity shrunk at such words.
Its actions halted.
How did this weak creature know its name?

"You have been alive for over 130 Megalos Cycles, and you still haven't learned that you shouldn't make enemies of those you aren't entirely sure about? Very well, I have marked you. Just wait for me."
WAA
Words that caused the Ancient Phrike to pull back echoed out as it gazed forth into the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain with alarm!
But moments later, a flicker of radiance unfolded.
Pure white blazed.
And in a glimmer of brilliance, the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain disappeared.

Where it used to be, golden strings surged to fill in the space as around, countless spiderwebs floated horrifically as the eyes of an Ancient Phrike...began to blaze with madness and a tinge of worry.
How the fuck had that weak creature known its name and even how long it had waded across existence so far?
There was no answer.
It only looked around maddeningly before its aura began to recede, its figure shooting out toward the distance as it gradually became invisible.
Within moments, it entirely disappeared while moving rapidly across the Expanse as even it knew that anything could happen here.
If it was unlucky, it could meet an Existence Severing entity that was just roving about, even in this corner of emptiness.
Even someone at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage...had to be careful while moving across the Expanse!
WAP!
Golden strings became twisted and distorted.
As if they were being squeezed apart, something circular bloomed with shocking force as in an instant, a dazzling white domain appeared!
Noah's Sacred Primal Eye of Existence was bright as he gazed around, finding himself in a region that had the same endless white strings stretching out endlessly, with a few variations.
He turned around towards a far distance behind him.
There, the outline of an illusory purple mountain could be seen stretching out, its brilliance heavy as its complexity of existence felt suffocating.
It was extremely far away, and yet Noah could already see an outline of its base this far away!

He didn't focus on it too much at this moment as he continued to supply his complexity through the Existential Entanglement he held with the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain, this time sending a different intent through.

Seas of authority gushed out from him as, in the next moment, the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain began to reduce in size rapidly, miniaturizing in such a way that within moments, it twisted down to the extent that its circular outline merely pushed away two golden strings in between.

And it shrank even further from here as the round protrusion between the two golden strings disappeared, the white space of the Blancverse Domain becoming unfathomably small until it barely became an indistinguishable dot of white light that was covered by the golden glow of white strings!
Only then did Noah stop.
His waves of energy stopped as he let out a breath while looking around him, seeing the radiance of this intact space as its weavings finally settled and communicated with him again.
He had only just utilized a few of its features, yet it already showed how terrifying this refuge that Bob had brought him to was!
Blancverse.
Empty.
Blank.
It was a type of a Verse as when Noah thought about it, he also thought of the Tresorverse of the Omnifather, Omniverses, Universes, and other similar wonders.
With how pure white and blank it was, and the weavings he had already uncovered about it with the Basal Control, it seemed like a type of a sandbox.
Something that could be altered and filled with an unknown number of things...so long as he held sufficient authority.

Authority that at first, it seemed to seek the Pillars of Existence within the Expanse! Would these not be the countless golden strings moving throughout? The same ones that Bob tugged on to move across the Expanse?
The ideas and possibilities were many as Noah came across these shocking findings, but his mind was already going towards a certain direction as he thought about the Blancverse.
That direction...was the Infinite Omniverse that was about to attempt making a jump that would transcend its very weavings!

chapters.title: Chapter 3331 Blanc!
paragraphs: The sensation was utterly unique.

Since coming to the Expanse, this could be considered the largest gain that Noah had made as the first thing were the Hearthraes he plucked, and the second was this Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain!
Both were gained with causality being twisted by Bob.
Bob!
As Noah secured a hidden area in between countless golden strings, he thought of this being more and more and what could be in store based on his words.
His power and status.

When Noah thought of him, the sensation he recalled based on sheer complexity...exceeded even the sensation he felt when he looked at Quintessential Megalonian Nu or even the injured Omnifather in the Tresorverse Sacred Domain.
This meant that the sensation of power he felt exceeded Existence Severing.
Why was an Entity like that running around an Expanse and doing what he did?
There was no answer to be obtained currently, and so Noah could only focus on the task at hand.
Currently, it remained understanding how to truly manipulate the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain, and how great his Complexity had to be in order to exceed the Basal Control level.

He did all of this while the Infinite Omniverse prepared for its own advancement- more and more Dark Matter Cores and entire Tainted Omniverses being sent to it to be assimilated while the connection with Ozymandias continued to allow for the inflow of Dark Matter into it. It was one of the paramount projects Noah was undertaking all at once, as this period of accumulation would not be so quick to pass.
Time was actually required for it.
But it was time that Noah had.
His actual eyes closed as the only thing that remained open was his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence.
It was in tune with everything occurring across different weavings of Existence- even though different parts of Noah were utilizing it simultaneously!
One in the Expanse. One in the Megalos Ynnere, and One in the Megalos Beyond.
Then, there was also where this eye stemmed from- the Tresorverse Sacred Domain where a shocking reconstruction continued!
Within a Reconstruction of the Weavings of Megalonians. |Young Master Pyrrhus, I never thought you would be so curious about the other Megalos Mountains. Have they satisfied you so far?|

Caretaker Nazal radiated a profound aurora of power as he spoke with a smile, looking back to see the graceful figure of Pyrrhus that was walking behind him on one of the massive golden chains joining the Megalos Mountains.

Nearly a day had passed as Noah moved across the reconstruction, with the time coming when he would be able to activate the Source of Existence within Pyrrhus to cultivate once more and call upon the countless possible versions of himself across the Megalos in increasing his complexity!
"Mmm, let's head back to the Sacred Primal Sea for another baptism."
And so he nodded towards Caretaker Nazal who smiled while wrapping both of their figures in an aurora of light.

This whole time, Pyrrhus continued to watch for any changes that could give a gauge on just how long this reconstruction would continue, but no answer came as after the brief appearance by the injured Omnifather and his lover- nothing else had occurred so far. Within moments, they were back above a mountain that held a radiant golden sea, the throne of the Quintessential Megalonian Nu still being empty at this moment as it seemed she was still dealing with the fallout of Vayan and her actions of bringing in an outsider.

Caretaker Nazal only nodded towards the other Honored Megalonians as they gave their permission, and Pyrrhus once more floated towards the center of the Sacred Primal Sea much to the envy and dismay of other Possed Megalonians!
Over the past few days, more and more had increased in numbers as it made one thing very clear.
Everyone joined the same reconstruction.
If they joined late, it was hard to say if they would benefit from much, and whether another reconstruction would even be viable or occur after this one ended!

Could it be so easy to reconstruct the shocking weavings of Megalonians in a domain, allow one to cultivate like they once did, and even take such boons back towards their own bodies after the set events came to pass?
Noah did not think the power of the Omnifather would be so obscene as to allow this to happen again and again as the fruits of this Reconstruction seemed to be first come first served.
HUUM!
All of this passed in the back of his mind though.

He came to sink in the golden sea as around him, hundreds of illusory versions of Pyrrhus appeared and only increased as they began to elevate their complexity of existence- all of it going into Noah as it caused his Sources of Existence to reach critical levels.

He felt like he was knocking on the doors to declare an Ordinance soon- and a choice had to be made within this declaration and decree- and how he would prevent the collapse of his Existence when the time came to undergo the Amalgamation of his Ordinance.
If just a single part of him did not agree...there would be failure.
There would be the collapse of Existence.
Or so Arguros had warned.
With heavy steps, Noah forged ahead!
Meanwhile.
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
Inside the Omniverse of the Protectors.
Another one of Noah's bodies was seated in the Library within the Obelisk of the Protectors, continuing to devour cycles of knowledge from the Commonwealth when...
BZZT!
His surroundings buzzed as the many floating bookshelves surrounded by auroras of golden brilliance disappeared.
Only the book he held in his hands remained as around him, space twisted and changed as a clear blue water formed beneath him, an island erupting from it as it had the visage of an old man!
An old man who was looking at a white board that had three singularities rotating around each other chaotically.
It was Old Man Eudemus.
The Shield of the Commonwealth!

chapters.title: Chapter 3332 The Warden!
paragraphs: His power seemed to be brimming with brilliance as he stroked his beard and smiled while looking towards Noah.

"I watched you this past day, and you truly didn't even make an attempt to leave or dissipate this...clone? But I have received the news that where the Commonwealth recorded your Omniverse X-999 to be has disappeared within its point in the Megalos Ynnere. We're these your actions? You seem to be keeping your secrecy, yet you do not run."
He spoke while scratching his beard, his eyes focused on the three chaotic singularities on the white board!
Noah smiled at Old Man Eudemus who couldn't help himself but come as he closed the book he was reading and replied succinctly.
"Why would I run from allies? I am, after all, a Protector of Megalos Ynnere."
"Oh? I thought I decreed you a Protector of the Commonwealth?"
The two exchanged words rapidly as Noah floated onto the island swimming on the blue waters, sitting opposite Old Man Eudemus who finally raised his eyes from his board and onto him.

"You also weren't entirely honest regarding your power. You were at the forefront on the Roots of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence...who knows which Megalonian you were lucky enough to possess."
The eyes of Old Man Eudemus seemed to contain endless depth as he looked at Noah who shook his head calmly.
"I never lied regarding my power."
He never lied.
Truly.
When he met Old Man Eudemus, he had yet to form any Fabled Omniverses, nor did he attain his current State of Existence!
He smiled at how much had changed in a matter of days as he continued.

"As for Omniverse X-999...who wouldn't want some secrecy in these Megalos? A power I'd never heard of suddenly came and imposed new rules of existence in the Omniverse I knew. I had to at least understand what I was dealing with, yes."

"Mmm...you had to first know who you were dealing with." Old Man Eudemus nodded, and his gaze turned back to the whiteboard showing chaotic movements of three singularities rotating around each other as he continued.

"You now know of the Commonwealth and the surface of its forces, and from this, you were confident enough to move Omniverse X-999 and even stay here freely. You did not consider the Commonwealth to be a threat to you."
His confidence?
Noah smiled at this and replied while also focusing on the three bodies of singularity on the white board.

"We are all on the side of Matter. On the side of Megalos Ynnere. At the end of the day, are not all allies? Was your call for me not one to root out Agents of Anti-Life? It was all for the sake of the Megalos Ynnere."
No for the Commonwealth.
Not for the Simians.
But for Matter!
For the Megalos Ynnere!
Old Man Eudemus gazed at Noah with profundity at such words as Noah continued.

"As allies, we share information. I have a great deal of information so far regarding the Weavings of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence and the Reconstruction of the Megalonians. I'm curious whether you would also be willing to share something with me?"
WAA!
"I am curious about the Antediluvian Leviathans. The Commonwealth seems to share a history with them?"
The Antediluvian Leviathans that seemed to have first risen within the Tresorverse of the Omnifather!
But they were always here, and the Commonwealth seemed to have been tangled with them.
Old Man Eudemus looked at Noah silently after his questions as moments later, he sighed and looked at the auroras of gold and blue around them as if he were recalling a truly ancient time.

"They are a group we do not fully understand to this day. Antediluvian Leviathans...we came across them in the early days of the Commonwealth, and of course, we sought to incorporate them into our forces. But their resistance was heavy and swift. When the Commonwealth exerted more force, we came to realize the extent of their power as even though our forces were localized to target Antediluvians within a single Omniverse, Other Antediluvian Leviathans appeared right at that moment who could have entirely eclipsed our deployed power. And yet...nobody was destroyed. They simply let our people go."
The Antediluvian Leviathans!

"We realized that they must have been much earlier at consolidating power than us, with an untold number of Omniverses under them. But...the Commonwealth could not be deterred, and so it sought to fight a battle that would determine who would rule and oversee the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere. It was bound to be a grand battle stretching across multiple Omniverses, with heavy casualties expected and nobody being the wiser on who the Victor would be. But as the forces of the Commonwealth gathered and was about to begin a multi-pronged siege...all the Omniverse under the banner of the Antediluvian Leviathans disappeared."
The gaze of Old Man Eudemus was hazy.
As if he were recollecting some ancient history!

"Nothing about them could be found, until one day, a single Entity was found in the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere...surrounded by hundreds of miniaturized Omniverses. The Omniverse of the Antediluvian Leviathans. He had them rotating around him as if they were stars within a small domain, and all of our forces encircled him to force his hand. But..."
Old Man Eudemus shook his head and smiled with self-depreciation.
A single entity.
Against the Commonwealth.

"Nothing mattered. The strongest within the Commonwealth at that time attacked. The Viceroy. The Shield. The Sword. The Star. The Shadow. The Light. Everyone collectively attacked...and nobody could even pierce the domain surrounding that one man. Around him, a prison was built, and yet he was no prisoner. He stayed within that domain for cycles until just recently, right before white portals began appearing within every observable Omniverse within the Megalos Ynnere, this supposed Prisoner disappeared."
WAA!
"We didn't know much about that Entity, but that to this day, none of us could match him. His distinction...was The Prisoner. His distinction...was The Warden of the Antediluvian Leviathans!"

"I am curious about the Antediluvian Leviathans.
The Commonwealth seems to share a history with them?"
The Antediluvian Leviathans that seemed to have first risen within the Tresorverse of the Omnifather!
But they were always here, and the Commonwealth seemed to have been tangled with them.
Old Man Eudemus looked at Noah silently after his questions as moments later, he sighed and looked at the auroras of gold and blue around them as if he were recalling a truly ancient time.
"They are a group we do not fully understand to this day.
Antediluvian Leviathans...we came across them in the early days of the Commonwealth, and of course, we sought to incorporate them into our forces.
But their resistance was heavy and swift.

When the Commonwealth exerted more force, we came to realize the extent of their power as even though our forces were localized to target Antediluvians within a single Omniverse, Other Antediluvian Leviathans appeared right at that moment who could have entirely eclipsed our deployed power.
And yet...nobody was destroyed.
They simply let our people go."
The Antediluvian Leviathans!
"We realized that they must have been much earlier at consolidating power than us, with an untold number of Omniverses under them.
But...the Commonwealth could not be deterred, and so it sought to fight a battle that would determine who would rule and oversee the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere.
It was bound to be a grand battle stretching across multiple Omniverses, with heavy casualties expected and nobody being the wiser on who the Victor would be.
But as the forces of the Commonwealth gathered and was about to begin a multi-pronged siege...all the Omniverse under the banner of the Antediluvian Leviathans disappeared."
The gaze of Old Man Eudemus was hazy.
As if he were recollecting some ancient history!
"Nothing about them could be found, until one day, a single Entity was found in the vastness of the Megalos Ynnere...surrounded by hundreds of miniaturized Omniverses.
The Omniverse of the Antediluvian Leviathans.
He had them rotating around him as if they were stars within a small domain, and all of our forces encircled him to force his hand.
But..."
Old Man Eudemus shook his head and smiled with self-depreciation.
A single entity.
Against the Commonwealth.
"Nothing mattered.
The strongest within the Commonwealth at that time attacked.
The Viceroy.
The Shield.
The Sword.
The Star.
The Shadow.
The Light.
Everyone collectively attacked...and nobody could even pierce the domain surrounding that one man.
Around him, a prison was built, and yet he was no prisoner.

He stayed within that domain for cycles until just recently, right before white portals began appearing within every observable Omniverse within the Megalos Ynnere, this supposed Prisoner disappeared."
WAA!
"We didn't know much about that Entity, but that to this day, none of us could match him.
His distinction...was The Prisoner.
His distinction...was The Warden of the Antediluvian Leviathans!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3333 Progression! I
paragraphs: The Prisoner!
The Warden of the Antediluvian Leviathans!
Noah's eyes shone as he grasped this information.
The entity who disappeared from the eyes of the Commonwealth right before the white portals began to bloom.
Such an entity was likely the one to initiate the will of the Omnifather and cause the eruption of the white gates that led into the Tresorverse.
What sort of power was this? What level of complexity did one need to reach to achieve such a feat?
Noah's weavings churned as he thought about the actions of the Antediluvian Leviathans towards the Commonwealth.
They were more powerful, and yet they didn't wage war against the Commonwealth when they did attack.
This...should have been a binding left behind by the Omnifather as the question was why?
Why?
Noah's eyes pulsed with radiance.
The Omnifather.
If he was involved in the eradication of the Megalonians.
If he blamed himself for it.
He could have theoretically become despondent and laid rules upon the Antediluvian Leviathans to not willfully eradicate entire groups of people if they didn't have to!
It was a possibility, but it was one Noah's weavings found to be the most probable as he nodded to himself.

At this time, Old Man Eudemus shook his head as he closely looked at Noah while his hand went towards the whiteboard, picking up one of the singularities and raising it away as instantly, the two remaining singularities adopted different interactions with each other.
More stable when it was just the two bodies.
Less reactivity!
"What about you, my young friend? What do you know? Of the Omnifather. Of these vast Megalos Ynnere?"
The old man was testing him.
He wanted a favor in return for the information he just divulged as Noah smiled while replying.

"The Omnifather...is likely a domino responsible for the eradication of the Megalonians. He was an Antediluvian Leviathan. The Reconstruction we are in is one that he formed out of guilt for what happened all those cycles ago, and likely the reason why the Antediluvians did not wage war against the Commonwealth when they are so much more powerful."
His words were calm, but they caused the eyes of Old Man Eudemus to constrict as his beard danced wildly!
The Reconstruction of the Megalonians was done by the Omnifather, and the Omnifather was an Antediluvian Leviathan!
Very few had witnessed the scene on the first day of the Reconstruction on the Mountain that Pyrrhus was on, with many Possessed Megalonians being scattered across the 81 Mountains.
No Protector of the Commonwealth had yet managed to arrive within that particular mountain as none saw the scene that played out.
This was tremendous news to Old Man Eudemus as he scratched his beard until some hairs fell out.
"The Reconstruction..." His eyes carried a domineering light as he asked Noah.
"How many days will this Reconstruction last?"
How many days.
Noah shook his head at such a question.

"This I cannot be sure of, but I believe there is less than a week before the Reconstruction ends. And once it ends, it will likely not appear again within the Tresorverse. If any Protectors have yet to enter the Tresorverse of the Omnifather, they should do so very, very quickly."
He told Old Man Eudemus such words as his blazing gold eyes returned the singularity in his hands back to the whiteboard.
The whiteboard held three bodies once more.
And their interactions instantly became chaotic and unpredictable.
A factor of chaos rapidly arose as things became much more complex!
Three Bodies.
Old Man Eudemus stared at them without blinking as he couldn't arrive at an answer!
Within the Infinite Omniverse.
Inside of the Extremity Vein within the Infinite Omniverse.

The concentration of authority within was many times more potent than outside of it, and only a select few gained access to it as at this moment, atop a churning obsidian gold sandy sea of dreams, a monkey stood in front of a set of ancient instruments.

The obsidian sandy gold sea of dreams swirled around him like a galaxy as it was filled with the potent authority of the Dream Aletheian Haven, and there were dozens of other clusters of authority like this around him as there were no earth or skies- just a stellar Expanse of clusters of dense authorities of the Infinite Omniverse!
And on each cluster, was a person.

The monkey on the dense cluster of dreams with instruments all around him smiled as he took drumsticks in his hands and raised them, gazing towards a cluster that showed the main body of Henry...swirling with a golden Fabled Omniverse.
DUM!
The booming sound of drums could be heard as the hands of the monkey- nay, the Bard of Quintessence, began a beat!
He looked away from Henry and gazed towards the tanned visage of Athena, a royal purple Fabled Omniverse surrounding her.
DU! DU!
The Bard of Quintessence felt his beat quickening.
His colorless gold fur radiated excitement as his distinction as the Bard made him want to enact a symphony of grandiosity for what was happening right now.
The mass exist out of the Existential Dominium Realm and into the Omniversal Realm for the top tier powerhouses of the Infinite Omniverse!
DU! DU! DU!
His hands became faster.
The beat became fiercer.
He looked at other figures situated alone on their own separate clusters of authority in this space of stellar multicolored radiance.
Sona.
Kazuhiko. The Emperor Penguin. Piety. Lilith!

One after another, these beings showed their own single or multiple layers of a Fabled Omniverse as they each took a single concept and the boons of the Artificially Constructed Hearthrae Imitations to propel them into their own Fabled Omniverses!
It was a glorious scene that deserved to be recorded in the annals of history as, seeing it, the Bard of Quintessence couldn't help but howl.
"WOO! WOO! WOO!"
A booming symphony began as the monkey like Bard bopped his head while his hands and feet moved with rhythm and charisma.
The beat alone caused the surrounding essence to churn and increase in complexity as a terrific scene took place!

chapters.title: Chapter 3334 Progression! II
paragraphs: Such a scene was observed by Noah in the far distance as in a place only he and a few could enter, he smiled while observing it.
Atop the multicolored throne that all authority within the Infinite Omniverse seemed to be coursing through.

Noah watched his son and others attain the Omniversal Realm as he sought to have them gain an introduction to Psioneutrinos- to potentially increase their complexity with this mixture of Matter and Dark Matter as he sought to induce within them a sensation of at least becoming One With Existence.
None of them could be like him in transcending their existence as they did not have what he had to make it possible.
So they had to be creative.
If they could attain One With Existence before the reconstruction of the Omnifather ended, they would be able to make even more rapid progress with their complexity!
If possible.
Noah continued watching their celebration as he tapped his fingers at the tune of the Bard of Quintessence while speaking to the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse.
"How is it?"

|Six total Dark Matter Cores and Tainted Omniverses are being assimilated, with half of these already being fully melded with the Infinite Omniverse. All calculations show that complexity itself should be sufficient to attempt everything, but to increase the degree of certainty by another margin, the assimilation of even more Tainted Omniverses and their Dark Matter Cores would be beneficial.|
The Infinite Omniverse felt like it was there.
But it wanted a higher degree of certainty.
So more complexity was needed!
And when it came to obtaining Tainted Omniverses after all of Savitar's were swallowed up...
"Mmm, how about we take the established homes of our plotting enemy? We can also use them as the testing grounds for the next generation of the Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction."

His voice was heavy with malice as a cold smile hung on his face, Savitar having exposed all the Tainted Omniverses he knew The Great Ponderor to be a master of as Noah could unleash a set of wonders of his enemy before he went in to assimilate the scraps.
|Understood.|
And the Infinite Omniverse was fully on board.
|Beginning the deployment of the successor of Fat Monkey, the Tzar Versepiercer.|
The Tzar Versepiercer!
A daring name!

A daring weapon developed and improved by the Infinite Omniverse from its tests as it became more and more proficient with Dark Matter, to the point that it packed over a million highly unstable miniaturized Fat Monkeys into a single Tsar Versepiercer.
A million!
Even Noah was entirely scared of this as a single improved Fat Monkey could even decimate the weavings of an early Omniversal Stage Entity.
A million of such horrors packed into a single one?
Very thin layers of weavings separated them as the smallest trigger could set them off.
And once they were set off...
Oh boy.
It honestly felt like an overkill.

Currently, only 11 Tzar Versepiercers had been built so far as they took a tremendous amount of authority for the Infinite Omniverse to focus, direct, and build them to ensure nothing imploded and decimated everything.

The first ones weren't even built in the Infinite Omniverse as the experiments were carried out in an Isolated Aletheian Haven that was thrown out into an empty area of Sector 1 that the Cartographer of Existence had mapped just in case!
And now, one would be put to the test.
"Let's go."
The target had to be ascertained with his own eyes.
|O Dreamer of the Megalos...are you planning to act against the Great Ponderor right away? He has many friends...|
Across the Megalos Ynnere, Savitar led Noah's body across the relative positions of his now devoured Tainted Omniverses and towards a Tainted Omniverse under the banner of the Great Ponderor.
"You don't worry about that. We should be close enough..."
He stopped in a region of complete darkness as Savitar floated behind him akin to a loyal follower.
Above Noah, a dazzling golden eye unfurled that caused the calm Savitar some trepidation, but it wasn't even staring at him!

It stared off into an extremely far distance that they weren't remotely close to, and yet within moments, the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence covered this distance as a pulsating outline of a Tainted Omniverse became clear.
One of the Omniverses under the banner of the Great Ponderor!
Noah's eyes looked at it from afar as he waved his hands and caused the appearance of an obsidian gold statue that looked just like him.

It was adorned in royal purple Armaments over its golden sheen, and his hands were clasped on his chest while the face was one of sorrow as if he were saying a prayer for the poor souls about to be exposed to its wonder!
The Tzar Versepiercer- a Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
"Go...and let me see your fallout."
WAA! Noah gave the command, and with it, an obsidian gold light flashed speedily!
Speed was one of the main components of this unstable construct, its sorrowful expression slowly flickering to cruelty as it thundered towards a Tainted Omniverse even faster than light.
Within the Tainted Omniverse.
A massive Outerversal Morphon bowed towards an obsidian veiled cluster that his master swam in as his deep voice echoed.
|Master, Bellerophon does not understand. What enemy could possibly make you wish to make a temporary retreat into the Megalos Beyond? Your might is endless, and your power is unfathomable...|
A Follower asked their Master, and their master shook their heads as if they wouldn't understand
|Sometimes, one must mak-...!|
The intent stopped.
It couldn't help but stop.
Because in the next moment...
BOOM!

A white light that seemed like it was erasing anything it touched flashed, the last thing this body of the Great Ponderor saw being the skeletal structure of Bellerophon literally melting as his Outerversal Authority was erased as if it didn't even exist.
And then, this blast of white light covered him as thereafter...there was nothing!
Inside the far distance, Noah was ready to observe when his eyes squinted, and his figure turned into a flash of light as even from this far distance, he retreated away rapidly!
Seeing such a scene, Savitar was shocked as he scrambled away as if his very life was on the line!

chapters.title: Chapter 3336 Progression! IV
paragraphs: Around this same time.
Within the Megalos Beyond- inside the Pantheon of Umbra.

Celebrations filled with the odd culture of eldritch horrors were underway as the followers of the Great Beyonder converged around the Instrument, which was currently being led by the Great Wheel and his forces.
In the depths of Umbra, the main body of Savitar floated in a chaotic region of purple flames, a mountain of bones underneath him as his Megalos Regnum was being expressed freely and without fervor.
His skull held many complex emotions as moments later, the flickering flames within his Sockets turned to see a figure manifesting above his mountain of bones.
It was none other than the Great Ponderor.
His body remained clouded by obsidian waves of darkness, but when Savitar looked deeply within, he could see the expression of contained rage.
The moment he arrived, his words were succinct.
|Tell him I want peace.|
WAA!
Peace.
Peace!
The Great Ponderor honed in on Savitar right away as how could his enemy know where his bases in the Megalos Ynnere were?
The only answer was the one he had sent to him through manipulation- Savitar!
So he came here after experiencing an extremely traumatic event of having the entire Records and weavings of one of his bodies erased by a Tzar Versepiercer.
Before everything had perished, he seemed to have captured an illusory humanoid figure blazing with white flames that was making a mocking prayer of sorrow while watching everything vanish!
|Peace? Haha, fucking peace?!|
Savitar's purple flames raged as he looked towards the Great Ponderor.
If they weren't in the Sacred lands of the Great Beyonder that forbid fighting, he may have just staked it out right here and now even if he was weaker!
Savitar looked towards the Great Ponderor as this being had put things in motion that made it so his own Megalos Regnum was under the banner of another.
That was his dignity.
His Honor.
His very essence of authority as an Outerversal Morphon.
And after all this, the Great Ponderor thought he could just call for peace?
|Motherfucker, there will be no peace for you! I've got nothing for you here so you can just roll all the fuck away.|
Savitar let out all his grievances to another Great One as the two gazed at each other coldly!
|I have many allies who would answer my call quickly. We can make things very difficult for you-|

|Call whoever the fuck you want. But after you do, be sure to tell them about the scorching white flames that can instantly decimate the weavings of a Great One. Don't leave that part out, O Great Schemer.|
Boldness was running rampant within Savitar as he spoke back against the Great Ponderor for the first time in what seemed like forever.
He saw that nothing could be gained here as after the white flames were mentioned, his gaze further changed as he waved his tentacles and disappeared!
Savitar was the only one left behind on a mountain of bones as he harrumphed.
He remembered the golden necklace on the Dreamer of the Megalos and the obsidian crown of his Megalos Regnum that it held.
He was now expectantly waiting for the obsidian crown of the Great Ponderor to be added to it!
An Increase in complexity.
A forging of thousands of layers of Fabled Omniverses through the hands of Pyrrhus within the reconstruction.

The abandoned Tainted Omniverses that the Great Ponderor left behind after he took a Tzar Versepiercer in the face, causing multiple Dark Matter Cores and the remnant of Tainted Omniverses to be swallowed by the Infinite Omniverse as it prepared for its own transcending of existence!
All of it seemed like pieces falling in place as the one thing that remained out of reach...was a solution for Noah's Ordinance of Existence and future Ordinance Amalgamation.
All of one's existence had to be synonymous with their decree.
If it was destiny, one had to proudly declare destiny as in the future, they would amalgamate with it entirely. If even a part of them was not loyal to destiny, their existence would collapse.
If even a single cell didn't live and breathe destiny, their existence would collapse!
And Noah...was not a loyal man.
He dipped his feet into far too many things as when the time came to make a choice, it could not be made so freely!

Since the usage of the first Tzar Versepiercer, three days had passed as no notable changes occurred within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain, with the reconstruction proceeding smoothly as all those lucky enough to enter were working to increase their Complexity of Existence.
Every now and then, terrifying auras would undergo a change from the 81 Megalos Mountains as the terrifying auras of Entities staking everything to undergo Ordinance Amalgamation flashed.
So far, no less than 55 of such auras bloomed!

A few were Simians of the Commonwealth or other races likely associated with them, and a few were from Omniversal Lineages born from other Omniverse within the Megalos Ynnere that were never brought under the banner of the Commonwealth.
The vast majority of those attempting Ordinance Amalgamation were the Antediluvian Leviathans!
But out of the 55 attempts in the last few days...only 10 managed to be successful.
Ten.

The rate was absolutely abysmal as 45 Possessed Megalonians would face the collapse of their existence, with the only saving grace being the uniqueness of this Tresorverse where since they were ultimately Possessed Entities, they wouldn't face a full collapse of their true existence outside of this reconstruction.
It was the reason why so many were bold enough to try.
Noah...had to also make the choice to, at the very least, make a decree and form his own Ordinance before this reconstruction ended!
But he knew that if he declared Quintessence, all others would fall behind even if he successfully decreed them afterwards.
The first decree would be the main decree.
All others would fall behind.
This...he didn't not want.
|The weavings of Cheats theorize a possible solution.|
|The weavings of the Protagonist theorize a possible solution.|
Different parts of him were buzzing with possibilities!

chapters.title: Chapter 3337 Osmont's Decree! I
paragraphs: Within the Reconstruction of the Omnifather.
Pyrrhus was surrounded by waves of golden radiance as he sat in front of Quintessential Megalonian Nu and Caretaker Nazal in a domain surrounded by hazy purple light.

The land below was sparkling with purple crystalline radiance while the skies above were covered by regal purple clouds- this place seemed like an isolated abode for Honored Megalonians to rest as further around it, golden celestial rivers flowed.

"Caretaker Nazal had put you forward as One That Was Promised, so letting you know more about the intricacies and rules of Megalonians is a must. Currently, we deal with the judgment of Vayan who jeopardized everything we have just because she spent a single cycle with an Outsider..."
Quintessential Megalonian Nu was surrounded by astral multicolored radiance as she spoke with an angry glare.
With every breath she took, Existence seemed to be changing around her as if she existed in her own separate world.
Existence Severing!
Unfettered from the bindings of Existence outside of themselves and others.
For any type of Existence to affect them...it had to be an extremely heavy one!
Such a being was speaking before Pyrrhus as she was imparting a lesson, and Noah only listened with half his attention as he was studying himself more than anything else.
He felt like all of his Systems had reached a critical step- with tens of thousands of layers of extremely pure and potent Fabled Omniverses surrounding him as they were saturated.
They needed a jump in complexity.
They needed a Decree.
An Ordinance!
And yet he didn't give it.
In front of him, Quintessential Megalonian Nu continued.

"Our domains are anchored within the gaps of the Endless Expanse, sometimes close to the Megalos, sometimes not. We are lucky to be in a domain like this as our existence...is a wonder and a calamity."
WAA!
A wonder, and a calamity.
If they lived as normal, they would continue to be a wonder.
If anyone found out about them...it would be a terrifying calamity!

But, must we live in fear just because of what our Existence represents to others? We strive to be cautious but strong. To raise our heads high and live with dignity while ensuring that our existence forever remains veiled to others. Tell me, for someone who breaks that ruling established through dignity and honor of our whole Lineage, what should their punishment be?"
Quintessential Megalonian Nu asked Pyrrhus.
And Pyrrhus mulled over this issue before replying coldly.

"Putting their own interests above all others, recklessly endangering all weavings of Megalonians with exposure...the only viable punishment is Imprisonment, or death to ensure it cannot happen again."
For love of a single cycle to be put above the well being of the whole race.
Pyrrhus believed such reckless actions were worthy of death!
Caretaker Nazal and Quintessential Megalonian Nu were shocked at these words, Nu smiling and shaking her head wryly soon after.
"Imprisonment is viable, Execution...may be too far since even with her actions, nothing irreparable has occurred. If something irreversible had happened...ah"
Quintessential Megalonian Nu thought wistfully while shaking her head.
She was about to continue when suddenly, her eyes turned incredibly somber as her change in gaze was followed by a voice descending.
|I am afraid that something irreversible has, in fact, been put in motion.|
An intent.
An intent they recognized as they had felt and seen it days ago!

In the next instant, this intent converged to form a dazzling figure of existence- an Antediluvian Leviathan whose skin radiated a calm multicolored splendor while his Existence... gave off a shockingly oppressive feel that seemed to be many times more than Quintessential Megalonian Nu.
This...was this being not one who failed Existence Severing?
So why the hell was their existence currently more terrifying than even Quintessential Megalonian Nu, who was actually at the Existence Severing stage?!
|You dare come here again after the favor Vayan bestowed on you?! You dare?!|
The weavings of Quintessential Megalonian Nu burned heavily above this isolated astral purple domain; the Outsider came down with a complex gaze as he replied.

|I come to see if I can right the wrongs before it is too late. My entrance here was observed and tracked by my enemies. It was then shared with my allies. Both now know of your existence. They now know where you are. They seek what they believe to be an answer within your existence. You all...must leave.|
The words were heavy as they were terrifying.
Quintessential Megalonian Nu had her gaze turn entirely ashen as she flicked her hands and sent out dozens of signals of light that flew out towards Megalos Mountains.
|How long?! How long do we have?!|
This Existence Severing entity asked frantically as at such a question, the Outsider titled their head down in shame as he spoke out.
|There isn't much time. Vayan, may I...|

He seemed to be filled with endless guilt as he asked, and Quintessential Megalonian Nu shook her head in rage and frustration as she waved her hands and formed a portal of astral brilliance that spat out the verdant figure of Vayan.
She looked around listlessly, her eyes brightening up when she saw the visage of the Outsider above as she smiled while flying towards him!
And yet...the only thing he had was sorrow as he held her body tenderly while voicing out.
|You are my everything...and my very existence aches that I have brought all of this on you.|

His words were tinged with countless complex emotions as light began to wrap around him and his lover, while Quintessential Megalonian Nu ragefully disappeared as alarms began to ring across this Megalos Mountain and beyond!
The gaze of Caretaker Nazal turned frantic as he appeared in front of Pyrrhus who was gazing coldly at the Outsider embracing Vayan.
"Young Master Pyrrhus, we must go. Let us..."
"No."

The gaze of Pyrrhus was firm as these weren't just the words of the Will possessing him, but the very intent and direction of Pyrrhus himself as he was filled with endless conviction. He turned away from the scene of the Outsider and took a few steps outwards, crossing light years as within moments, he arrived on top of the golden Sacred Primal Sea once more!

chapters.title: Chapter 3338 Osmont's Decree! II
paragraphs: "Young Master!"

The cries of Nazal rang out behind him as all around this space, Megalonian were looking around frantically as before they could do anything, the visage of Quintessential Megalonian Nu could be seen in the skies making a snatching motion down below as if she were plucking stars, and hundreds of Megalonians disappeared on this Megalos Mountain as they turned into glimmers of light that were contained in cerulean crystals around the waist of Quintessential Megalonian Nu.
She seemed to see the intent radiating from the distant figure of Pyrrhus atop the golden sea as her gaze flickered, but she continued to take all those she could with her.
Atop the golden sea, Pyrrhus seemed to have come to a decision.
At the same time, Noah seemed to have come to a decision.
The Will of Pyrrhus should have long been extinguished over the vestiges of time and shattered records, and yet at this moment...
HUUM!
Noah felt a buzzing within his very soul as in its depths, he felt something rising.
Within the depths of a Reconstruction done by unfathomable means!
This buzzing...came in the form of an extremely regal voice.
[That day, they attacked.]
BOOOM!
After this voice buzzed within him, the golden skies of the Megalos Mountain here split open.
The sound was heavy and unfathomably loud as the decibels reached a level where even those at the stage of One With Existence felt their existence buzzing as a sense of confusion would dawn on them!
From the split skies, two massive golden hands pulled on either side and ripped it further open, and from the opening...an extremely majestic face popped in.
A face shimmering with golden splendor as the moment it peeked into the Megalos Mountain and saw the Megalonians within, its eyes radiated profound glory!
Its pupils were shaped with an animalistic serpentine glow, and they shone with magnificence at this moment as when they observed the Megalonians, they smiled with ecstatic brightness.
|So it was true!|
BOOM!

Along with these words, the skies were split apart even more as the titanic entity that seemed to be spanning the size of an Omniverse tore open the golden skies of an entire Megalos Mountain, his upper body squeezing itself in as it fully radiated golden splendor.

Seeming like a celestial entity descending from the skies, the steely hands of this entity moved as their palms radiated a shocking suction force- such a force instantly caused Megalonians to forcefully rise to the skies at the speed of light towards them!
At the same time, the serpentine eyes of this being flashed as they spared a glance towards Quintessential Megalonian Nu who had a horrified expression on her face.
|Existence Sealing.|
The terrifying power emanating from Quintessential Megalonian Nu instantly began to falter and reduce as if it were nothing.
The serpentine eyes of this golden entity the size of an Omniverse radiated beams of light that focused on the cerulean crystals around Quintessential Megalonian Nu as if it could see everything.
The cerulean crystals instantly cracked as thousands of Megalonians spilled out from it, astral light leaking all around as their bodies also began to be pulled towards this entity!
At such a time...
|THEODOSIUS!|

A booming bellow echoed out from the heart of the Megalos Mountain as the visage of the Outsider who was brought here injured just days ago appeared while staring dreadfully at the entity the size of an Omniverse above, the visage of Vayan by his side as the hands of this outsider chopped up!
HUUUM!
Existence trembled.

The hand of the Outsider chopping out enlarged and stretched maddeningly until its size became comparable to the massive invader above, and it went on to smash onto its body as the pull of Megalonians towards it was disrupted!
It was a shocking show of power.
It seemed to exceed the bounds of what they knew to be Existence Severing.
|You...you truly thought you could keep this to yourself?! Against the vastness of Existence, this is one of the few viable options! You stupid fool, we should have never taken you in!|
The Invader voiced out with rage as the hands chopping towards him was rebuffed, his serpentine eyes looking down below as he pointed around him.
|Look around you, it is already too late. Stop this inconsequential interference.|
Around them.
On the other Megalos Mountains, scenes similar to this and even worse were occurring.

The skies were torn apart as entities brimming with heart shaking power descended, some the size of Omniverses as only half of their bodies peered through the cracks as they gazed down with looks that felt like they were observing untapped treasure.
They reached out towards the Megalonians as if they were dangling fruits, their eyes filled with an insatiable need!

Seeing this, the eyes of the Outsider showed tremendous pain as beside him, his beloved was trembling as her very existence seemed to age from the sheer emotion of understanding the consequences of what she had done.
The Outsider felt all of this closely as he couldn't help but release his pain upwards!
|CHOP!|
An unbelievable battle bloomed.
On the golden sea below, the visage of Pyrrhus remained calm and unfettered as, at this moment, its eyes didn't seem to be one.

It was as if two beings were looking through the same lens, the shocking will of the complex entity who was born while attaining the state of One With Existence, and attained his Eye Of Existence a day after being extremely active at this moment.

[That day, they came and took everything. They treated us as if we were mere objects to be taken, and we...did not have the power to stop it. We were too weak. We were given too little time. Even I...had only been alive for days.]
He couldn't effect any change.
He couldn't do anything against those who came into his home!
The emotions of Pyrrhus were extremely active at this moment as his existence began to seethe, countless versions of himself appearing as he prepared a decree.
[What has happened cannot be changed, but I can't help but feel stifled.]
WAA!
[If I had more time.]
[If existence was not so cruel.]
Regrets.
They filled Noah's weavings as while Pyrrhus moved, he also moved!
His eyes radiated an endless blue light as he...also prepared his decree.

chapters.title: Chapter 3339 Osmont's Decree! III
paragraphs: Regret!
As Entities appeared and picked off his people and his home, the unique Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian that was Pyrrhus felt boundless waves of such an intent.
It was brazen.

His Sacred Primal Eye of Existence was open as he could see all the 81 Megalos Mountains, and on some of them, Invaders at the Existential Severing Stage and Ordinance Amalgamation stage appeared- their weavings mixed.
Some radiated waves of profound Matter.
Others pulsed with incandescent Dark Matter.
While others pulsed with glorious Anti-Matter.
Each held their own uniqueness as not all of them were the massive Omniverse sized entities who split open the golden skies above the Megalos Mountains.
But the entities smaller in size were even crueler as Pyrrhus saw.

He saw an Ordinance Amalgamation entity grab a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian who was moving others away while exploding with power; this Ordinance Amalgamation Invader...opened his jaws unnaturally as tentacles erupted from it that pulled this Megalonian in.
They devoured him whole.
Thereafter, the jaws of this entity closed as an ecstatic expression appeared on his face- his existence buzzing with resonance as he actually showed great astonishment and shock!

For a brief second, thousands of illusory versions of himself exploded outwards as they exploded in complexity, and all of this complexity merged into the central body as all others faded a moment later.
But the complexity of this Ordinance Amalgamation Invader...was at least 25% more.
From devouring the records and weavings of existence of a single Megalonian!
The Ordinance Amalgamation Invader felt this change personally as his eyes turned crazed, his figure howling as he madly shot out towards other nearby Megalonians.
Others say his shocking eruption in complexity after devouring as even though they were given certain orders to mainly capture, they began to devour Megalonians on sight.
It was brutal.

On all 81 Megalos Mountains, such horrors only became more intense as on another mountain, three Existence Severing Invaders besieged a Quintessential Honored Megalonian, their power erupting out heavily as they cut the very existence of this Megalonian apart into thirds before they each swallowed any piece!
And their bodies instantly exploded with complexity as thousands of illusory versions of themselves appeared- their bodies burning with ever brighter complexity.
[They did it so freely.]
Pyrrhus continued to buzz within Noah's weavings.

[They did it without a care. As if they were plucking fruits or flowers that naturally deserved to be plucked by them, as if they were on a farm and simply enjoying the livestock there. Days after I was born, I had to watch all that I came to know be taken away. My existence was unwilling. My Source was unwilling. My Ordinance...was unwilling.]
HUUM!
The golden sea below Pyrrhus seethed.
As destruction and chaos unfolded all around, he seemed detached from it all as a third of the golden sea was instantly turned into streams that disappeared into his body.

[I know that none of this is real. I know that what has come to pass cannot be reversed. I know that I am dead, and merely part of the Reconstruction of the guilty conscious of an Outsider. But nonetheless, it is a Reconstruction of who I am. Of my Origin. Of my Decree.]
An Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
[And even if it is a Reconstruction, in this, there lies a possibility.]
BOOM!
The body of Pyrrhus exploded with radiance as above him, a terrifying Banners that spanned across this Megalos Mountain and extended to the others bloomed.

It was so blinding that the Invader called Theodosius by the Outsider turned his gaze towards Pyrrhus, his eyes showing shock and elation thereafter as he moved his arms with fervor towards the golden sea.
|THEODOSIUS!|
A move that caused the Outsider to fight back with even greater fervor!
Pyrrhus turned his gaze up to stare at the eclipsed golden hand as his banner unfolded.
As his decree became clear.
As his Ordinance was made!

[I detected the Megalos that made these Invaders. But I was born out of the Megalos themselves. Gaps within the Expanse, but it was the Megalos regardless. So my decree...was a decree of the Megalos themselves.]
BOOM!
Megalos.
The Ordinance of the Megalos!
It stretched out madly all around as it seemed far too vast.
Far too glorious than if it was even declared by any other Megalonian.
This was because...

[My Megalos contains everything about me. What made me. My Origin. With it, the one capable of binding me in this Reconstruction should be able to withstand it. To obtain it. If you do, I simply ask...for carnage.]
WAA!
[I do not seek justice. I do not seek for wrongs to be made right. I seek the same carnage and destruction imposed on the Megalonians...by the Invaders.]
HUUM!
Pyrrhus' body radiated pure, unfathomable waves of wonder.
They stretched out to cover all Megalos Mountains with a blinding light that seemed to empower even the remaining Existence Severing Megalonians- their bodies burning ever brighter.

[I seek destruction and cataclysm on all those across the Expanse who rose ever higher from the Blood of the Megalonians. I seek carnage on these Invaders...and the one who brought them here, whether inadvertently or not.]
[I seek Carnage on the Outsider that made this very Reconstruction.]
Noah's will pulsed at such words.
Pyrrhus sought the destruction of the Omnifather himself!
[With my Origin, you will not even need a cycle. With my Megalos, many things are possible.]
After he said these words, the will of Pyrrhus simmered and turned silent.
And at such a moment, Noah sighed as his eyes turned unfathomably bright.
Pyrrhus was making his decree.
He had to make his own.
But he couldn't make just a single decree, he had multiple decrees.
And he could not call even a single one before the others, otherwise it would all be for naught.
If he did this, he knew that when the time came for Amalgamation, he would very likely face the collapse of his existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3340 Osmont's Decree! IV
paragraphs: So a single decree could not be made, nor could they decrees be made one after another.
This only left behind the option...of making many, many decrees instantly.
All at once!
It wasn't feasible.
It was viable.
At any one point in time, only a single authority could be expressed.
Only a single decree could be made.
But he wanted to make over a hundred Decrees instantly!
The only possible pathway for this...lay in Mana.
HUUM!
His eyes radiated a truly unfathomable blue light.
A light so heavy and so pristine unlike any other time in the past!
Mana.
It was developed, forged, and reforged again countless times over the past days.
Through Infinity, endless waves of mana coursed through intricate Fabled Omniverses- upon hundreds of layers of such intricate constructs.
Through Manadynamics, it was interwoven with ever greater complexity!
But what Noah wanted it to do now was a task it had never done before.
Yes, it could change and transform from its Basal forms of mana into another authority.
What he was asking it to do now was to transform into...everything.
All his concepts.
All his weavings.
And not just transformed, but simultaneously express with extreme purity of all of these concepts as Decrees!
As Ordinances!
If it was the past him from days ago, his complexity may not have been enough for such an ordeal.
But his current weavings.
His current complexity.
The body he occupied of an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
It should be enough.
It had to be enough!
HUUUM!
Around Noah, a sea of gorgeous cerulean mana unfurled and began expanding outwards for light years.

The golden sea below was reflected in its grandeur as, shockingly, similar to Pyrrhus, its light went on to bathe this Megalos Mountain and even began stretching out towards the other 81 Megalos Mountains.
It radiated such profound purity and a sense of infinity that it felt like it could endlessly stretch out to even flow within the gaps of the Expanse and continue expanding outwards!
It was unprecedented as such a pure light was not meant to bloom.
Not with such intensity, and certainly not within this Reconstruction.
This Reconstruction.
At this moment, the billowing visage of the golden titan-like entity who had split the skies of the Megalos Mountain above looked down with ever greater focus towards Pyrrhus.
The light within his eyes reflected a greater sense of cognizance and greed as, at this moment, his hands thundered down with even greater fervor.
As if he had to get his hands on this being!
In the skies, even the Outsider turned back and gazed towards the visage of Pyrrhus with bright eyes of melancholy.
Even the Sealed figure of Quintessential Megalonian Nu that was being pulled towards the Titanic Invader in the skies gazed over with a look of reminiscence and regret.

On the distant Megalos Mountains, many Rare and Quintessential Megalonians had their eyes flickering with a greater concentration of radiance as they looked at the cerulean brilliance spreading out towards them, their eyes gaining a sense of cognizance as if they understood what was happening right now!
Their eyes filled with hatred and regret.
They looked towards the Invaders around them as...even though they knew in their hearts that nothing would change.
Even though they knew they were merely whispers of themselves in a reconstruction, their complexity of existence seethed as they pulled towards this seemingly endless source of brilliant blue light!
And their bodies gave off brighter glows as they roared with ferocity while charging toward their enemies, the existence around them beginning to distort.
Causality began to distort.
During such a shocking phenomenon, the man at the center of it all had many things flashing across his mind.
Memories from what seemed like a distant world- a distant part of him who was holding onto a Fireball Skill Book on a small world.
The moment this skill book had disappeared, he tapped into something greater.
The first time that his existence dipped into Mana.

When he released fireballs again and again behind a dilapidated apartment complex, it was mana that flowed out of him and transformed into clusters of fire. That same mana had been with him all these many months as today, its purity was many times more than that point in time.
Its complexity even more so!
And just like all those many months ago, at this moment, Noah allowed this same Mana to flow out of him endlessly.
It didn't transform into fireballs, but his Existence permeated across every corner of this stretched out mana as he called out.
|O, Mana!|
A single call.
A single Decree.
A single Ordinance of Mana!
But it wasn't alone.
Simultaneously, at the same time this intent arose, the word [Mana] seemed to be overlapping with many other words!
It didn't seem like a single word was uttered as at the same instant, many other words were uttered.
Many other Ordinances were called out at the same exact time!
|O, Quintessence!| |O, Infinity!| |O, Protagonist| |O, Loot!| |O, Cheats| |O, Manadynamics!| |O, Destiny!| |O, Entropy| |O, Kuklos!| |O, Ingeniare!|...!
Countless Decrees.
All contained in a single Decree.
It was unimaginable to even think of as this didn't just occur here.
Across countless weavings, in the depths of the Megalos Beyond, within the Pantheon of Umbra.
Ozymandias was sitting in the midst of thousands of Outerversal Morphons, enjoying the eldritch wonders and uniqueness of these Entities as in the middle of these festivities.
His stellar obsidian skin radiated glory as he lifted up a golden cup while gazing at the endless darkness of the Megalos Beyond.
|Hmm?|
Nearby, the Great Wheel and a few other Great Ones that had gathered felt something as their gazes came to lock on him.
With his gaze expressing calmness and serenity, Ozymandias lifted up the golden cup as he decreed.
|Outerversal.|
HUUUM!
As if he were merely uttering out something so simple.
As if it were the most common thing in existence!
He made such a decree at the same time as in distant weavings of a Reconstruction, the Decree of Mana and countless others were laid down.

And an instant after, the skies above the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra that was ten times the size of a normal Omniverse shuddered, waves of unfathomably pure obsidian Outerversal Authority flowing down from all directions towards a single entity as above him, a heavy decree bloomed.
The Great Ones nearby looked at such a scene with sheer incredulity as it did not at all seem real!

If it was the past him from days ago, his complexity may not have been enough for such an ordeal.
But his current weavings.
His current complexity.
The body he occupied of an Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
It should be enough.
It had to be enough!
HUUUM!
Around Noah, a sea of gorgeous cerulean mana unfurled and began expanding outwards for light years.

The golden sea below was reflected in its grandeur as, shockingly, similar to Pyrrhus, its light went on to bathe this Megalos Mountain and even began stretching out towards the other 81 Megalos Mountains.
It radiated such profound purity and a sense of infinity that it felt like it could endlessly stretch out to even flow within the gaps of the Expanse and continue expanding outwards!
It was unprecedented as such a pure light was not meant to bloom.
Not with such intensity, and certainly not within this Reconstruction.
This Reconstruction.
At this moment, the billowing visage of the golden titan-like entity who had split the skies of the Megalos Mountain above looked down with ever greater focus towards Pyrrhus.
The light within his eyes reflected a greater sense of cognizance and greed as, at this moment, his hands thundered down with even greater fervor.
As if he had to get his hands on this being!
In the skies, even the Outsider turned back and gazed towards the visage of Pyrrhus with bright eyes of melancholy.
Even the Sealed figure of Quintessential Megalonian Nu that was being pulled towards the Titanic Invader in the skies gazed over with a look of reminiscence and regret.

On the distant Megalos Mountains, many Rare and Quintessential Megalonians had their eyes flickering with a greater concentration of radiance as they looked at the cerulean brilliance spreading out towards them, their eyes gaining a sense of cognizance as if they understood what was happening right now!
Their eyes filled with hatred and regret.
They looked towards the Invaders around them as...even though they knew in their hearts that nothing would change.
Even though they knew they were merely whispers of themselves in a reconstruction, their complexity of existence seethed as they pulled towards this seemingly endless source of brilliant blue light!
And their bodies gave off brighter glows as they roared with ferocity while charging toward their enemies, the existence around them beginning to distort.
Causality began to distort.
During such a shocking phenomenon, the man at the center of it all had many things flashing across his mind.
Memories from what seemed like a distant world- a distant part of him who was holding onto a Fireball Skill Book on a small world.
The moment this skill book had disappeared, he tapped into something greater.
The first time that his existence dipped into Mana.
When he released fireballs again and again behind a dilapidated apartment complex, it was mana that flowed out of him and transformed into clusters of fire.
That same mana had been with him all these many months as today, its purity was many times more than that point in time.
Its complexity even more so!
And just like all those many months ago, at this moment, Noah allowed this same Mana to flow out of him endlessly.
It didn't transform into fireballs, but his Existence permeated across every corner of this stretched out mana as he called out.
|O, Mana!|
A single call.
A single Decree.
A single Ordinance of Mana!
But it wasn't alone.
Simultaneously, at the same time this intent arose, the word [Mana] seemed to be overlapping with many other words!
It didn't seem like a single word was uttered as at the same instant, many other words were uttered.
Many other Ordinances were called out at the same exact time!
|O, Quintessence!| |O, Infinity!| |O, Protagonist| |O, Loot!| |O, Cheats| |O, Manadynamics!| |O, Destiny!| |O, Entropy| |O, Kuklos!| |O, Ingeniare!|...!
Countless Decrees.
All contained in a single Decree.
It was unimaginable to even think of as this didn't just occur here.
Across countless weavings, in the depths of the Megalos Beyond, within the Pantheon of Umbra.
Ozymandias was sitting in the midst of thousands of Outerversal Morphons, enjoying the eldritch wonders and uniqueness of these Entities as in the middle of these festivities.
His stellar obsidian skin radiated glory as he lifted up a golden cup while gazing at the endless darkness of the Megalos Beyond.
|Hmm?|
Nearby, the Great Wheel and a few other Great Ones that had gathered felt something as their gazes came to lock on him.
With his gaze expressing calmness and serenity, Ozymandias lifted up the golden cup as he decreed.
|Outerversal.|
HUUUM!
As if he were merely uttering out something so simple.
As if it were the most common thing in existence!
He made such a decree at the same time as in distant weavings of a Reconstruction, the Decree of Mana and countless others were laid down.

And an instant after, the skies above the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra that was ten times the size of a normal Omniverse shuddered, waves of unfathomably pure obsidian Outerversal Authority flowing down from all directions towards a single entity as above him, a heavy decree bloomed.
The Great Ones nearby looked at such a scene with sheer incredulity as it did not at all seem real!

chapters.title: Chapter 3341 Ordinance! I
paragraphs: Outerversal Morphons had a long lifespan as many lived for tens of Cycles.
This equated to millions upon millions of years as depending on their level of power, they could grow the complexity of their existence enough to live dozens more cycles.
But at the end, like all bodies of existence, everything fell towards disorder and collapsed.
There were rumors that if one was capable of severing their Existence, they would effectively break the confines of life span and live for an unknown number of cycles!
Mere rumors that many couldn't confirm with conviction.
But many Outerversal Morphons lived for a great deal of time as should many things!
Great Ones especially, with their vision being much more expanded.
At this moment.
|These old bones shouldn't be put to work this much, it goes against everything I stand for as the Observer.|
The Observer of Old and Young walked into the Pantheon of Umbra silently as beside him, the tentacles forming an Infinity symbol that represented the Great Mother brimmed with life!

Her Tentacles let out vibrations as she seemed expectant to see the Instrument after their short separation, and both of these Great Ones quickly located the visage of Ozymandias in the depths of the Pantheon of Umbra as they saw him in the middle of a feast hosted by the Great Wheel. |Shouldn't the Elders put in more work to have the way for the juniors? Especially the one we have been waiting for this whole time. Part of me always had a sliver of doubt, but when that dusty wheel sent the message that he attained the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos and then his Eye of the Megalos right after...can it be anything but the Instrument? Hmm? Tell me, Observer, did you manage to become One With the Megalos and attain your Eye of the Megalos days after you were born?|
The Observer of Old and Young couldn't say anything as he seemed to be thinking about a great deal of things.
Everything about Ozymandias so far continued to exceed their expectations as he was everything promised by the Great Beyonder, and more!
|You are right. It seems that we only have to defend him for a little while longer before he can stand on his own two feet-...!|
They hadn't reached the area of the feast yet.
They had only neared it as they could see everyone there with clarity.

The Observer of Old and Young was forced to pause along with the Great Mother as from the distance, they saw the figure of Ozymandias, unprompted...nonchalantly raise his golden chalice as he made a decree.
Outerversal.
He made such a decree as moments later, the very Megalos above the Pantheon of Umbra trembled as they bent- their purest essence surging towards him as a terrifying banner began to unfold above him.
The tentacles of the Great Mother trembled with stupefaction as she had seen many things...but she had never seen such a scene before!
Beside her, the Observer of Old and Young had his body vibrating as he asked somberly.
|Any prophecy from the Great Beyonder that covers this?|
A question that didn't have an answer.

It only bore witness to the shocking brilliance of Ozymandias as at this moment, an illusory...Pantheon began to form around him, his Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology rapidly rising as after this, they would no doubt have tipped into the Seventh Echelon if not nearing the Eighth!
This was Ozymandias.
Another part of Noah that made a decree simultaneously alongside all of him as through coming changes would be grand!
Across the weavings of existence.
Back into the Tresorverse Sacred Domain, within the Reconstruction.
The endless sea of blue that spanned across the 81 Megalos Mountains pulsed as in the span of an instant, they flashed with countless other colors.
Countless other decrees all at once!
Quintessence.
Tyranny.
Loot!
Colorless, purple, golden waves were among the many colors that flashed with interminable purity and wonder as they all stemmed from a single being!
In this Reconstruction, it wasn't just the Megalonians.
The Possessed Megalonians, who didn't see the full intricate story behind the Outsider and the Invaders, only knew that the calamity of the Megalonians that had already come to pass was here.
They also saw the incandescent endless blue that flashed with multiple colors as the vast majority simply thought this was part of the reconstruction.
Actions of a particularly unique Megalonian!
It was only the Possessed Megalonians on the same mountain as Pyrrhus who could identify him as another Possessed Megalonian who saw things with much more clarity!
And they watched with appalling emotions as they saw under the banner of one being...there were dozens of Decrees.
Dozens of Ordinances!
This...this isn't feasible.
It wasn't possible.
And yet here it was!

Below them, the Sacred Primal Sea...entirely turned into massive rivers of golden light that were sucked into the body of the only Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian rapidly- all of this acting as the fuel to power this madness.
Concepts evolved.
Sources of Existence changed.

Kuklos pulsed as an intricate Wheel of Noah's own design began to be reconstructed, while Ingeniare began to construct violet-purple constructs burning with the illusions of both Omniverses, Megalos Pantheons, and Megalos Mountains!

The emergence of so many different Ordinances under one banner was far too different and unique as the sheer aura and complexity it carried...caused all nearby Possessed Megalonians who had declared their own Ordinances to feel inadequate.
They had one.
He had many.
And it was not just one plus one.
There seemed to be a compounding effect regarding the type of complexity brought through these shocking declarations as a terrifying aura of oppression instantly bloomed from Pyrhuss!

One that caused the entities who had already attained the Ordinance of Existence to feel a heavy sense of trepidation, while entities who had already spent millions of years nurturing their Ordinance and raised their complexity to a high enough level to perform the Amalgamation of their Ordinance...felt as if a sharp sword that could possibly threaten even them was forming.
What?!
