chapters.title: Chapter 3342 Ordinance! II
paragraphs: The sensation didn't feel real!

But Possessed Megalonians, whether they were Antediluvian Leviathans, stemming from the Commonwealth, or even across the myriad of undiscovered Omniverses out there- any who were already at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage or those who had attempted to do so and succeeded during this reconstruction, or even those who were not confident enough and were stuck at the Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation level.
They all instinctively felt like an extremely sharp sword that could even harm them was being formed!
And its edge...felt unfathomably sharp!
Many became somber at such an affirmation as the reality of an entity of a lower State of Existence ever threatening one of a higher state was an impossibility.
But this entity seemed far from the norm as above him, a multicolored banner that seemed to stand for multiple Ordinances blazed over others like a royal emperor of all Ordinances.

The banner of the Ordinances shone their purest light over the visage of Pyrrhus as the complexity of his existence began to transform, his existence carrying a signature of regality and majesty at this moment that when others felt it...their own existences buzzed with...greed.
The Megalonians were hunted to extinction because of the weavings of their Existence.
When devoured, even the weakest Megalonian could increase the complexity of even an Ordinance Amalgamation entity by 25%.

When other entities saw Megalonians, they felt a unique pull as they seemed like panaceas to the weavings of their existence! This sensation was even more amplified the rarer and more unique a Megalonian was.
An Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian that had made his decree, paired with a possessed will that had decreed over a hundred Ordinances...
His existence itself felt like a Panacea found in the rarest corners of the Expanse!
Above, the titanic golden Invader had his serpentine eyes blare with cognizance as he voiced out.
|What are you...|

Its eyes carried a hungry light as its left hand opened wide, Quintessential Megalonian Nu finally falling in his grasp as this Existence Severing entity...had her isolated existence that nobody should have been able to dirty entirely sealed.
No Existence Severing Entity would be affected by the weavings of Existence of another.
Any semblance of damage would be nullified, any causality would be destroyed, and any cause and effect, destiny, or karma would be severed!
They could distort how their existence experienced time. They could close their eyes as a Cycle passed outside, and only a moment would have passed for them.
If their existence was powerful enough, they could experience a whole cycle with their existence while only a second passed outside!
They wouldn't be affected by anything other than their own Existence.
They were not weak.

The only possibility for their Existence to be violated came when an opposing party far, far exceeding their level of existence and complexity appeared, and such beings could intrude and violate their Severed Existence.

But even if they were twice or thrice as powerful, it still wasn't easy to violate the bounds of an Existence Severing Entity- one had to be many times more powerful, or even having exceeded the stage of Existence Severing entirely!

Such...was the case that showed the Quintessential Megalonian Nu glaring with defiance and hatred towards the titanic golden Invader as he threw her in his mouth- an unfathomable grinding force pressing down like a milestone as her weavings were entirely shredded.
And the titanic invader's eyes instantly radiated a terrifying light of complexity as this being seemed heavily energized, his voice booming out as he struck down with his massive hands.
|Good! Very good! This is a true answer to our current problem...so let it be done!|
BOOM!
The Outsider was pushed aside.
The Megalos Mountain cracked in half as with endless greed, the titanic golden Invader eyed Pyrrhus who stood stably while gazing up in defiance!
His hands began to burn with golden flames, and an instant later, the Megalos Mountain was also covered and burning with gold flames.
|NO!|
The Outsider cried out with rage and guilt, but his power was nowhere close at this moment as he was pushed aside.
The eyes of Pyrrhus and the titanic golden invader seemed to have locked onto each other, but nobody knew that Pyrrhus' eyes were observing waves of prompts calmly at this moment.
|All of your weavings perfectly and simultaneously attained their Ordinance.|
|The Complexity of your existence has risen and is continuing to rise in a way that cannot be entirely quantified.|
|Your existence itself is changing in quality.|
|The Origin Sacred Primal Existence of Pyrrhus is being inherited.|
|The Source of Existence of the Megalos is attempting to be bound.|
|The Ordinance of the Megalos attained simultaneously with Pyrrhus acts as the gateway!|
The Source of Existence of the Megalos.
What allowed Megalonians, who had lived for an extremely short period of time, to gain tremendous power.
It was a Source of Existence that was entirely eradicated across the Megalos and the Expanse!
It did not exist anymore.
And yet...
BOOM!
|Give yourself to me!|

The titanic golden Invader that had already swallowed Quintessential Megalonian Nu raged maddeningly as the Megalos Mountain collapsed, the empty Sacred Primal Sea split into pieces as his massive hands were thrust towards Pyrrhus!
What had occured in the past.
The set events that would play out without fail.
On that day, when Invaders were about to get their hands on the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian...
|Know, O Harbinger of Carnage, that this is not over.|
WAA!
The voice of Pyrrhus rang out.
And in the next moment...
BOOM!
His stellar golden astral body exploded into tendrils of golden light that rapidly collapsed on themselves.
That day, countless years ago, Pyrrhus had chosen to dissipate and collapse his existence over being devoured by the Invaders!
And the Will that was occupying him...

|Hoping for a future that had an extremely low chance of playing out, Pyrrhus collapsed his existence entirely while leaving behind a sliver of his Origin within his newly established Ordinance of the Megalos.|
|This sliver of Origin with the Ordinance of the Megalos across Cycles and countless complex weavings of Existence now blooms once more, connected to you by an unbreakable thread.|
|With it, the Source of Existence of the Megalos shall bloom once more!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3343 Ordinance! III
paragraphs: The existence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian was a terrifying one.
He knew death was coming as instead of giving himself over to the terrifying invader, he willfully collapsed his existence while hiding traces of his Origin in his newly declared Megalos!
His existence collapsed, and yet a semblance of his Megalos lived on.
For a possibility that had a very low chance of happening.
If ever even a trace of the Megalonians was unearthed.
This Reconstruction...was one such possibility.

As the Astral body of Pyrrhus disappeared, the hand coming down for it raged as the serpentine eyes of the invader above seemed to be looking for something- honing in on the area where Pyrrhus had collapsed his existence as he bellowed out with heavy and undefiable greed.
|I will find you. I will find you, Possessor! I have marked your scent! I have marked your Ordinance!|
BOOM!
Possessor.
Not Pyrrhus.
Not Megalonian.
Possessor!

At this moment, the terrifying eyes of the Invader gained waves of more cognizance as if he understood exactly what was happening, looking around himself as regal coldness and ancient complexity filled his eyes.
|In the middle of all this, you dare use my likeness for a reenactment? You still haven't left this obsession behind?|
HUUM!
The Tresorverse Sacred Domain began to tremble.
The Reconstruction began to tremble as the moment this cognizance from this being came...
BOOM
The reconstruction of the Megalos Mountains of the Megalonians was split in half and rapidly began to crumble.
As if a safety mechanism was triggered as events reached an unwanted level.
Instantly, all Megalos Mountain and reconstructed entities collapsed!
As it did, intents appeared in the eyes of every Possessor who was observing everything in shock.
[The timeline of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain has come to pass.]
[The gains in complexity and states of Existence will be inherited as soon, a pathway up the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence will open up once more.]

After the collapse of the Megalos Mountains, heavy darkness descended before everyone found their bodies and wills as they were before, but they were submerged within...a sea of stellar purple sand where they couldn't see anyone else.
Noah's body was also in a sea of purple sand, but he wasn't fully paying attention to his location as he sensed the shocking changes within his Existence!
For him, he didn't even have to wait for the events to pass before he was inheriting the power of the Reconstruction.
This remained the same as at this moment, his main body took the brunt of the continued elevation in power and complexity, as well as the changes brought about due to his Decree and Pyrrhus!
Within the Infinite Omniverse.
Atop the multicolored throne connected to all weavings of the Infinite Omniverse.
|A Source of Existence with appalling complexity has been found within a recently bound Ordinance and sublimated with your existence.|

On the throne, his body trembled as his Atlas of Existence pulsed, an astral brilliance shining on the Fifth Mundi of Power as there, an extremely heavy Source of Existence that seemed to possibly overcome a few others under Noah's banner bloomed!
|The Source of Existence of the Megalos sees the light of day once more as it comes with an obsession.|
|An Obsession of carnage and apocalypse fills the Source of Existence of the Megalos, the signatures of its enemies who had descended upon Megalos Mountains many cycles ago bound to it.|
Pyrrhus' Obsession.

It burned brightly within the inherited Source of Existence as hundreds of massive illusory Megalos Mountains stacked on top of each other bloomed within the Fifth Mundi of Power, this source representing far too many things as the instant it bloomed, Noah's existence underwent great changes.

From his eyes and then on his skin, astral brilliance began to leak out and increase in intensity as his Existence that was already rising up exponentially felt like it was gaining additional millions of pairs of wings to rise up ever faster.
He was reflective at this moment as the change took place.
"Love..."
He called out this word lightly as he thought about the Outsider.
The Omnifather.
His attachment to the Megalonian Vayan was the causality that brought about their destruction.
Vayan ignored every rule of the Megalonians and placed her entire lineage on a path of extermination...all because of her attachment to an Antediluvian Leviathan after a single cycle.
Millions upon millions of years.
He wondered.
If he were to spend millions of years with Adelaide.
With Barbatos.
With Athena...and many others.
Would his love for them exceed everything else to the extent that if a choice came between them and the Infinite Omniverse, the weight of his attachments would outweigh everything?
He didn't know.
HUUM!
Around his body, the transformation caused his hair to dance with an astral gold light as above his head, radiant multicolored banners began to stretch out.

A distance from his throne, the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse was looking towards Noah with calm eyes that held countless calculations and complex weavings, feeling as if her Master was thinking about something she could lend her aid to, but at the same time, she couldn't interfere.
Master and Construct were lost in their own thoughts as the former also thought of a critical piece from the Reconstruction.
The titanic golden Invader who had gained cognizance that he was in a reconstruction, and had looked at Pyrrhus' dispersed existence while affirming that he had marked Noah.
The Possessor of Pyrrhus!
Marked.
The truthfulness of this was unknown as Noah could only cautiously prepare- unable to erupt with indefatigable Tyranny and state that it was merely an Invader.
Talent and potential were great, but it wasn't everything.
Pyrrhus was a terrifying Entity who was already One With Existence at birth, awakening the Eye of Existence a day later, and establishing his Ordinance less than a week later.
By all means, he was his own protagonist.
Someone that could have etched their records across the Megalos and Expanse.
And yet...what happened to him?
No matter how terrifying the complexity of his existence was, he died!

He knew death was coming as instead of giving himself over to the terrifying invader, he willfully collapsed his existence while hiding traces of his Origin in his newly declared Megalos!
His existence collapsed, and yet a semblance of his Megalos lived on.
For a possibility that had a very low chance of happening.
If ever even a trace of the Megalonians was unearthed.
This Reconstruction...was one such possibility.

As the Astral body of Pyrrhus disappeared, the hand coming down for it raged as the serpentine eyes of the invader above seemed to be looking for something- honing in on the area where Pyrrhus had collapsed his existence as he bellowed out with heavy and undefiable greed.

I will find you, Possessor!
I have marked your scent!
I have marked your Ordinance!|
BOOM!
Possessor.
Not Pyrrhus.
Not Megalonian.
Possessor!

At this moment, the terrifying eyes of the Invader gained waves of more cognizance as if he understood exactly what was happening, looking around himself as regal coldness and ancient complexity filled his eyes.

You still haven't left this obsession behind?|
HUUM!
The Tresorverse Sacred Domain began to tremble.
The Reconstruction began to tremble as the moment this cognizance from this being came...

Instantly, all Megalos Mountain and reconstructed entities collapsed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3344 Ordinance! IV
paragraphs: Forced to collapse his own Existence not to be devoured by another.
He wasn't given the time to shine.
Noah also needed time.
He didn't know everything and couldn't peer across all the mysteries, but he could take it step by step as he ensured that he and his people...did not end up like the Megalonians one day.
The reconstruction...was a cautionary tale!
And it was even more applicable at this moment as a golden banner of Megalos shone unfathomably bright above Noah, a terrifying sea of complexity burning into him from it as...
|Within the Blood of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer, the complexity of the extinct Megalonians flows once more.|
|Your Existence has seamlessly grasped the Origin Sacred Primal Existence of Pyrrhus.|
|Through you, the resurgence of the Megalonians is not an impossibility.|
Seeing these prompts, Noah couldn't help but sigh.
In the past, he had unearthed the weavings of Lumen as they were a unique race that fell under the banner of the Conceptual System of Existence, but that was it.
A race born within an Omniverse in the Megalos Ynnere.

The Megalonians...were entities born within the Megalos Mountains contained within the gaps of the Expanse, their lineage being so terrifying that they were hunted down to extinction by a force that could even eradicate Existence Severing entities as if they were nothing.
And that was an unknown number of cycles ago.
Noah...now inherited the same complexity of such a lineage.

His existence would be akin to a Panacea that far exceeded the value of even an Existence Severing Entity like Nu as at this moment, he accepted the full weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- Pyrrhus!
How would his fate be different from the Megalonians?
He truly didn't know.
What he did know was the depths of his own complexity of Existence.
He closed his eyes as he felt the Banners above him.
His Ordinances.
As above, so below.

Within his body, he felt the Ordinances pulsing and interacting with each other across his existence, their interactions only prompting the emergence of even greater complexity as their power was truly unique.

At this moment, even without using his connection to the Infinite Omniverse or the Sacred Primal Eye of Existence, he felt like he could use his Ordinances to see everything within the Infinite Omniverse, and even Omniverse X-999.
Not just see, but act.
Not just see, but act.

He instinctively felt like he could impose his Ordinance instantly on a vast surface area, that he could be sitting in another corner of Omniverse X-999 as if an enemy appeared in an opposite corner, he would be able to release an Ordinance upon them and attack without ever having to move a step.
This...was the power of entities who had attained Ordinance of Existence.
They held such subtle control that they could use their ordinance to strike from an extremely far distance!
Noah felt like he easily covered Omniverse X-999, but even this was not his limit.
He didn't know what equivalent distance other entities could cover, but even when he thought about this, it didn't matter.
They could impose a single Ordinance of Existence when they made a move.
But what about him?
He smiled lightly as he opened his eyes and looked at the visage of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse before him.
"Are you ready for your own advancement?"
He had made his jump as a shocking transformation and level of power bloomed.

The Infinite Omniverse was next as it had devoured and assimilated more than enough Dark Matter Cores and Tainted Omniverses that its chances of success in what it wanted to do nearly bordered on the absolute.
|I shall start soon, Master.|
Her intent came out brightly as she prepared.
Far from here, a body of his within a Blancverse in the Expanse was also ready to receive her!
"Very well."
He gave a light nod as his thoughts moved.
In the next second, his eyes reflected the scene of a purple sea of authority as within the Tresorverse of the Omnifather, changes bloomed once more.
His body within disappeared and was taken to another location entirely as here, many, many other auras could be felt.
Tens of thousands of terrifying auras found themselves deposited in a new domain that was astoundingly vast.

Antediluvian Leviathans, Protectors of the Commonwealth, and other unique entities who didn't belong to any of these powers, but held their own shocking power from isolated Omniverses across the Megalos Ynnere!

They all appeared atop what looked like a golden inner bark of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence itself, this flat area extending outwards for light years as uniquely, all those who passed through the Reconstruction were deposited near each other.
Tens of thousands of Entities who had transcended their Existence!

The vast majority had at least attained their Eye of Existence, followed by rare geniuses at the One With Existence level who managed to raise the complexity of their existence enough to also arrive in the Expanse.
Then, the third largest group were entities at the Ordinance of Existence, and then the terrifying auras of Ordinance Amalgamation blared here and there!
Of course, mixed in were those at the Quasi-Ordinance of Existence and Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation level.
Then, there were those whose aura could not be felt as they hid it deep.
But the moment everyone arrived here, they all rapidly grouped up with their own forces.

The massive Antediluvian Leviathans circled around each other, the eyes of many being somber as it seemed the news regarding the Omnifather being the Outsider who inadvertently brought destruction upon the Megalonians began to spread.

The Simians and others belonging to the Commonwealth also rapidly found each other as many of them showed jubilation- thousands surrounding the Shield of the Commonwealth, Old Man Eudemus, who at this moment burned brightly with the terrifying aura of an Ordinance Amalgamation entity!
Many had made tremendous gains in the Tresorverse Sacred Domain as what they brought back with them was an astounding level of power.
As many entities gathered and grouped together, there were a few who remained where they were or probed around cautiously.
Then there was Noah.
Nobody around him, and no group to associate himself with.

He seemed to exude a sense of loneliness as at this moment, a part of his Origin was burning as the obsession of Pyrrhus was buzzing against the Antediluvian Leviathans- the lineage of the Omnifather!
He sighed as he had to take care of this obsession, but before he could think any further, his head rose up along with many others as they stared upwards.
There, an intent bloomed.

|Complexity of Existence alone is not enough, one has to also be proficient in weaving this complexity to achieve substantial results- to truly express their power exceptionally at their level, or even exceed it.|

|The Megalonians were eradicated even though many had attained high complexities of Existence. They were not able to fight back against those more powerful. This Tresorverse Prison Domain is meant to forge Entities with weavings of existence capable of standing confidently in their stage or exceeding it.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3345 Disregard! I
paragraphs: The Tresorverse Prison Domain.
This was the distinction given to the area they were currently in as it was meant to hone the way they utilized the Complexity of their Existence!
The Megalonians were mentioned as one had to have lived through the reconstruction to truly understand what this was about.
But Noah knew that the weavings of that Reconstruction would never rise again within the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence.
It was a one time opportunity as this Tresorverse Prison Domain should be the major playing field for all those who reached the Trunk of the Primaltree of Existence!
A buzzing clamor of majesty echoed throughout as the entities here were those filled with extreme power and positions.

Among the throngs of thousands of Protectors of the Commonwealth, apart from those paying their respect to the Shield of the Commonwealth and the Sword of the Commonwealth who brimmed with shocking power, there were also many centered around another figure.
The distinguished Viceroy himself had made it into the Reconstruction who knew when, and he now stood amidst other Simians who protected his majesty.
His visage...radiated a unique power of the Ordinance of Existence level as there was a veiled Ordinance Amalgamation Simian standing behind him protectively!
The Shield and the Sword of the Commonwealth were also not far away from this entity.
The Symbol of Power of the Commonwealth.
Someone Noah had seen act within an Arena.
The Viceroy!
The Simians treated his status highly as they all continued gazing above at the blooming intents.
|The Tresorverse Prison Domain is a domain of combat, a domain that can be lethal to those weak or unlucky.|

|Once the true Tresorverse Prison Domain is revealed, you will come across Tresorverse Towers of Existence the size of Omniverses. Each tower may only be led and occupied by a single Lead Existence who will get their hands on a Modus Operandi that shows unique means of weaving Complexity.|

|Different rarities of Tresorverse Towers of Existence flow abundantly, with ownership of the Towers decided by strength. The one who can occupy a tower for the time it takes a singularity to disperse will gain its ownership, with heavy gains and responsibilities falling upon them depending on which tower they occupy.|

|Each State of Existence will have their own unique Tresorverse Towers of Existence as only the strongest within a state of Existence will determine ownership. After a period of acclimation, those leading these Towers will have to withstand the assault of a Lineage that has been imprisoned here for the past 10 Cycles. For them, killing you is a condition for their freedom. Life and death will rely on your own Existence.|
A Lineage...that had been imprisoned for 10 entire cycles?
Noah's gaze turned sharp at this as at this moment...
HUUUM!
The surroundings began to tremble as the golden bark they stood on fluctuated.
There were tens of thousands of powerful Entities standing atop it as at this moment, these golden lands seemed like they moved as all around them, reality began to change.
As if a veil was dropped, stellar astral obsidian radiance was seen all around, waves of golden light burning as massive wonder bloomed around them and stretched out for lightyears!
In comparison, their figures on the golden bark seemed like a grain of sand.
Radiant, different colored structures that were the size of Omniverses stretched out, and they seemed like huge monoliths suspended in space!

Each one pulsed with a unique aura of power as the majority didn't feel that oppressive, but there were 81 Multicolored Monoliths stretched out within this Trunk of the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence that felt extremely oppressive.
There were 9 that felt suffocating.
And then...there 3 that seemed to innately make others want to kneel in reverence.
There were all Tresorverse Towers of Existence!
At the same time that space unfurled around them, everyone also saw different colored strings appear above each of their heads.

|The Tresorverse Towers of Existence are free to contend for, simply choose the difficulty based on the complexity of your Existence and the confidence to withstand and rebuff others for the time it takes a Singularity to distinguish entirely.|
A choice had to be made.
When Noah looked up at the strings, he couldn't help but think of the endless golden strings within the Expanse.
A momentary thought.
After it passed, his eyes that were looking closely at the strings saw some details.

|White String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for an Average Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within an Average Tresorverse Tower of Existence. Of Average Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 50%. Many of these towers are available.

|Blue String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for a Rare Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within a Rare Tresorverse Tower of Existence. Of Rare Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 100%. There are 81 Rare Tresorverse Towers of Existence.

|Purple String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for a Quintessential Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within a Quintessential Tresorverse Tower of Existence. Of Quintessential Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 150%. There are 9 such Quintessential Tresorverse Towers of Existence.

|Gold String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for an Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence. Of Origin Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 500%. There are 3 such Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence.
The Omnifather very clearly drew inferences from the tiers of Megalonians in designing this unique domain!
Average, Rare, Quintessential, or Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence!
Only a single Lead Existence could take hold of a single Tower- and they were exclusive to a single state of Existence!

At the same time that space unfurled around them, everyone also saw different colored strings appear above each of their heads.

|The Tresorverse Towers of Existence are free to contend for, simply choose the difficulty based on the complexity of your Existence and the confidence to withstand and rebuff others for the time it takes a Singularity to distinguish entirely.|
A choice had to be made.
When Noah looked up at the strings, he couldn't help but think of the endless golden strings within the Expanse.
A momentary thought.
After it passed, his eyes that were looking closely at the strings saw some details.
|White String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for an Average Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within an Average Tresorverse Tower of Existence.
Of Average Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 50%.
Many of these towers are available.
|Blue String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for a Rare Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within a Rare Tresorverse Tower of Existence.
Of Rare Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 100%.
There are 81 Rare Tresorverse Towers of Existence.
|Purple String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for a Quintessential Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within a Quintessential Tresorverse Tower of Existence.
Of Quintessential Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 150%.
There are 9 such Quintessential Tresorverse Towers of Existence.
|Gold String of Existence]:: Pulling upon it will designate one to vie for an Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi within an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence.
Of Origin Quality, it can at most allow one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 500%.
There are 3 such Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence.
The Omnifather very clearly drew inferences from the tiers of Megalonians in designing this unique domain!
Average, Rare, Quintessential, or Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence!
Only a single Lead Existence could take hold of a single Tower- and they were exclusive to a single state of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3346 Disregard! II
paragraphs: The numbers of Towers Noah gained information about seemed to only be prevalent to entities at the Ordinance of Existence, and he didn't know how many of such towers there were for those who only attained the Eye of Existence, or those at Ordinance Amalgamation.
It was a System that was meant to have the strongest entities of the same state of Existence take the lead!
Naturally, there was only one tier of a Tresorverse Tower of Existence that Noah could go for.
After all, his type of Existence had just inherited such a level of Complexity.
It could only be Origin!
With steady hands, Noah moved his hand up as he tugged on the golden string.
An instant later, this string came down and wrapped around him as a golden robe was adorned on his body, and on his back- runic words stating [Origin Pass] were inscribed!

Out of what seemed like hundreds of Tresorverse Towers of Existence, many were White and Blue, with nine massive Purple Tresorverse Towers of Existence and three largest Gold Tresorverse Towers of Existence that were floating on the fringes of the stellar obsidian astral domain they were in.
Compared to these Towers that were the size of Omniverses, the tens of thousands of transcended entities here on the golden bark were truly like insignificant grains of sand.

As more and more entities pulled on the strings above them, they were divided and split based on their level of power as with the vastness of this space, those at the state of One With Existence were sent towards the leftmost side of this region, those at the Eye of Existence level coming after them, those at the Ordinance of Existence following, and then to the rightmost side of this domain, the few terrifyingly powerful entities at the Ordinance Amalgamation Stage could be seen.

There were less than a hundred of these terrifying entities as the Shield and Sword of the Commonwealth among other Ordinance Amalgamation Protectors were sent here- along with Arguros of the Antediluvian Leviathans.
The Leviathans...who made up the majority of the forces of Ordinance Amalgamation entities as the scattered Existences not belonging to any group followed.

The four different groups demarcated by different states of Existence were divided with the length of over 50 Omniverses between them- being equivalent to the distance of an entire Sector of the Megalos Ynnere!
They could not interfere with others.
And as far as anyone knew, unless there was an exception made for them...nobody could see Existence Severing Entities here!
It was hard to believe that there weren't any in the Megalos Ynnere.
But nobody truly knew as such existences were too distant. Too pristine!
So their focus remained on themselves at this moment.

After the demarcations made due to the States of Existence, Noah found himself in a region surrounded by a thin golden barrier, with a few hundred terrifying auras of Ordinance of Existence entities actually contained in this domain.
Gold!
All of them were competing for the Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence- of which there were only three!
Outside of the thin golden barrier, thousands of entities at the Ordinance of Existence stage watched on with caution and interest- none of them having selected the golden string.
|The selection of the Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence shall be carried out first.|
HUUUM!
Within the golden demarcated area, three dazzling golden thrones appeared in the distant space- a calm singularity floating atop each one!
|The Ones who can remain seated on the throne for the length of time it takes for the singularity above to disappear shall gain ownership of the Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence.|
Three thrones.
The powerful entities who had already transcended their existence all carried extremely deep records, history, and power as none made a move right away!
There were a few hundred of them here.
Each one at the Ordinance of Existence.
Whichever three were bold enough to try and claim the three golden thrones first...would become enemies of all others here as they had to defend for an unknown amount of time!
Just who would have such tremendous confidence in their power to be among the first ones to step forward?
As such a daring question arose, Noah's brows raised as among all Ordinance of Existence Entities here, two stepped out right away.
One was a cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan, his body vibrating with ecstatic power.

The other...was the Viceroy of the Commonwealth- the young leader of this power as behind him, there were close to 20 Protectors at the stage of Ordinance of Existence that followed behind him protectively!
He sought to take one of the three golden thrones while being protected by his forces!

His simian fur shone with a regal golden luster as he looked around all Ordinance of Existence entities here with a gaze full of majesty and power- his figure magisterially floating towards one of the thrones unhurriedly!
As if he was so confident in his power that he wasn't even worried that others here might shake him.
With a few steps, he arrived before the central golden throne and sat grandly- Protectors circling around him protectively as above the throne- the singularity began to burn!

On the other throne, the cerulean Antediluvian that had also stepped out arrived in no time, his body adorned with a golden robe similar to all others here taking a seat on the right throne with tremendous speed.

A flaming blue crown swirled above this Antediluvian Leviathan as he seemed like an ancient Emperor who could erupt with an unfathomable Ordinance at any moment- giving many here a sense of oppression!
Now, only a single throne was left.
Who would be bold enough to sit on it before chaos ensued?
Who-?
|Huh?|
Many gazes blinked as they only saw the golden robe of a devilishly handsome man step forward, his demeanor carefree and without any worries as in a few steps, arrived and sat on the leftmost throne.
After he sat, he stared at the throngs of Protectors, Antediluvian Leviathans, and other unique entities from across the Megalos Ynnere as he did not at all seem worried!
Who was that?
He dared to actually be among the first seated on one of the golden thrones?

Many eyes looked between his figure that they couldn't sense much threat of, then towards the seated Viceroy of the Commonwealth who was surrounded protectively by over 20 entities of the same stage, and then they gazed at the cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan who emanated extremely heavy and stifling complexity of existence.
And...their eyes returned back to Noah's visage as their expressions seemed sour, showing complete disregard.
Who was this complete nobody that actually dared to be among those seated up there?
His demeanor was filled with confidence as the dignity he carried seemed high enough, but so what?
Did he actually consider himself an unshakable power at the Ordinance of Existence stage?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3347 Disregard! III
paragraphs: The scene was a heavy one filled with tension, with faint banners rising and falling above many heads as they could erupt at any moment.
One of the things that made the situation even more tense was that nobody knew what the actual passage of time was for the singularities above the golden thrones to extinguish.
Depending on this period of time, even truly powerful entities can be bombarded by attacks on all sides by multiple combatants!
One had to move carefully or have absolute strength in order to be daring enough.
Three entities had gone to sit on the golden thrones as the singularities above began to burn, and many eyes became honed on a single entity on these thrones.
A devilishly handsome man who sat there freely, his gaze laid back as if what was happening right now wasn't a big deal!
He even met the gazes of those who were eyeing him on the throne as in this tense situation...
He actually blinked towards the few hundred entities as he spoke!
"I'll save you all some time and tell you that your best chance is going to be one of these other two thrones."
Noah pointed towards the Thrones that the Viceroy of the Commonwealth and the unknown Antediluvian Leviathan sat on as many intents arose!
The golden furred Viceroy gazed towards Noah with calm eyes that flashed with distaste- as his words had made it clear that he put himself above him.
Him.
A Viceroy.
THE Viceroy!
|...| He gazed at this entity with a calm light of regality as he didn't even bother to reply.
His distinction and power would speak for itself as he waved his hand and declared.
|This Viceroy shall take one of the Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence. If anyone wishes to challenge me on this, they are more than welcome!|
WAA!
A declaration!
Along with it, the bodies of over 20 Ordinance of Existence Protectors exploded with terrifying auras of power as golden Banners of Wheels bloomed above them!
They looked like ancient soldiers currently with their adornment of the golden robes- soldiers who only moved under the banner of an even more ancient emperor.
Many eyes were pensive towards this throne.
On the other throne, the cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan was a seasoned warrior from the Primal Family of Oceanetheus, one of the four Descendant Lineages of the Omnifather as he was fearless!
And yet.
In the next instant.
PA!
The sound of a bubble popping echoed out.
In front of the Cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan seated grandly on the throne, the humanoid figure of an entity that seemed to be in his teens appeared.
The speed was ridiculously fast that the eyes of the Cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan constricted in alarm, but before he could do anything...
PA!
His figure on the golden throne disappeared.
He appeared where the young looking humanoid entity used to be, while this entity was right where he was just now!
With a calm gaze, he sat on the throne as above, the singularity reset before it began to burn again!
These sets of actions caused caution to rise in the hearts of many as this young entity came into focus.
Dark hair flowing to his shoulders.
Gold robe like all others here, but his eyes...they swirled with what seemed to be millions of golden lines.
He had a calm expression on his face as he looked at the furious visage of the Antediluvian Leviathans meters away as he spoke out softly.
"I do not wish to kill today nor make an example out of anyone. Turn back and fight for a Quintessential Tresorverse Tower of Existence."
The words were heavy.
The words smashed into the honor and power of the Cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan!
His expression twisted as he bellowed out, a wife blue banner unfolding above him as it read- Aqua!

Gloriously blue, the moment he bellowed out, a terrifying sea filled with immense weight and complexity of Existence bloomed behind him- its effect even nearing the throne where the Viceroy sat on as three Ordinance of Existence Protectors stepped forth and erupted with golden banners to protect their Viceroy.
It was a heavy Ordinance filled with power as it seemed about to blanket the young entity before it!
And yet, this young entity actually shook his head.
"A shame."
Two words.
Thereafter, a faint gold banner just briefly flashed above him.
In an instant, faint strings of light converged in front of him and smashed into the Cerulean Antediluvian Leviathan as....
BOOM!
His figure was smashed back mightily.
Flung back at such speed that he smashed into a spectator Ordinance of Existence Antediluvian Leviathan that he smashed into- the chest of that being caving in!
The endless blue sea behind him flickered and disappeared.
The front of his body...was entirely missing as one could see crystalline organs and skeletal structures shining with brilliance.
His weavings of Existence...were silent as shockingly, his eyes were dim.
He was...knocked out.
Not dead, as his existence still burned bright, but he was hit with such shocking complexity that he couldn't even remain conscious!
Over a dozen Antediluvian Leviathans quickly gathered around him as their gazes expressed shock and rage.
They knew the Leviathan before them was a powerful champion- his power even being equivalent to a few of them here!
For him to be treated like this...
They glared with deadly brilliance towards the calm entity on the throne.
"I truly do not wish to kill."
His voice echoed out as he sat back on the throne calmly.
"Do not force me."
Above him, they barely saw a flicker of his unfathomable Ordinance.
It read...Stringere!
When Noah observed this Ordinance and the actions of this entity, his eyes flashed with surprise as silently, his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence unfurled.
Across the Megalos Ynnere, there were a wide array of entities and oddities who rose over the cycles.
The entity that seemed like a young humanoid teen did not belong to the Commonwealth nor Antediluvian Leviathans, and yet his power was so astonishing!

chapters.title: Chapter 3348 Disregard! IV
paragraphs: The Protectors of the Commonwealth.
The Antediluvian Leviathans.
These groups...were not everything within the Megalos Ynnere.
This reality was made clear at this moment as a young humanoid entity calmly sat on a throne!
Others may not be able to see, but Noah's Sacred Primal Eye of Existence could observe a twinkling of countless golden strings around this being.
Strings.
The Ordinance of Stringere!
The vast Expanse was filled with countless strings that bound together and weaved Existence, and this entity actually set an Ordinance related to this as it made Noah contemplative.
At this very moment, another part of him in the expanse was studying the Blancverse Domain he had bound while gazing at the countless golden strings that made up the Expanse.
If he could manipulate them like Bob could...
Many thoughts were burning within his mind as when he came across this Ordinance, her merely found it unique.
He knew that among his own Ordinances, there was one that could give him an answer and increased understanding towards strings.
Towards how they could all come together to weave existence.
But as for the oddity seated on the throne...

[Odyssion, the Wonderling]:: State of Existence- Ordinance of Existence. Source of Existence- Stringere. Lifespan- 5 Megalos Cycles/450 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- An entity unique in nature as he rose to prominence within his Domain at an early age. He has focused on nothing else but the blind obsession for higher states of Existence, and will do anything in his power to achieve his aims. Many of his records are inaccessible due to the complexity of his weavings...

Noah nodded at the feedback and details of this being as he lived less Cycles than even Great Ones like Nietzsche in the Megalos Beyond, and yet his power almost reached their level- and in fact far stripped Great Ones like Savitar.
He was an entity worthy of his power as after he showed it off, many eyes did not wish to test him again so quickly.
There was one entity alone on a throne that has yet to be tested on whether he even deserved to be sitting there.
Many eyes came towards the throne Noah sat on.
He sat there calmly as he gazed back towards these powerful entities, and he actually nodded as he waved his hands towards them!
"You all can definitely give it a try."
WAA!
Bold words filled with confidence echoed out as at this time, some entities could not hold back.
An Antediluvian Leviathan wreathed in black flames stepped forward, a scorching banner blooming above him as others stepped back while frowning.
The banner of Onyxfire.
The Ordinance of Onyxfire!
|This opportunity of the Omnifather...we must all give it everything we've got. So, come off that throne for me.|
The banner above him shone as he didn't move another step.
As an Entity at the Ordinance of Existence, he could attack anywhere in this small enclosed domain just by applying his Ordinance!
And he did just that as above Noah's throne, an obsidian flaming furnace bloomed and released apocalyptic lava-like tenebrous flames that could break down the complexity of existence itself.
They were so potent that they even burned and remained burning on the surrounding weavings of Existence!
They washed over the throne Noah sat on as...
|Huh?| Many of the observing Entities clicked their lips in disregard as if they had been fooled, because they didn't even see the being on the throne release his Ordinance to defend.
He wasn't even fast enough to activate his Ordinance, and they had actually been cautious of him?
And due to their exceedingly cautious nature...
SAA!
The obsidian flaming Leviathan already appeared meters away from the throne as he seemed about to sit on it after he scorched the overconfident entity who sat before him.
But...
"What are you doing?"
HUUM!

In the middle of the burning Onyx flames of the Ordinance of Onyxfire, the visage of Noah still calmly sat on his throne as the burning flames spilling all around...didn't seem to be doing anything to him!
This eerie action instantly caused astonishment to bloom in the eyes of the obsidian flaming Leviathan as he rapidly moved back.
|You...my Ordinance is imposed around your existence, its will must be imposed! You...you..!|
At the words of the Leviathan, Noah raised his hands wreathed in the burning flames that did absolutely nothing to him as he voiced out calmly.
"Why would your Ordinance have any effect on me?"
HUUM!
He could see the eyes and very core of existence of the Leviathan shaking when he said these words.
His body.
His being.
His very existence was surrounded by over 100 Ordinances!
Even without activating any of them, just the regal brilliance of his many Ordinances could offset and ignore average Ordinances.
Only those with truly deep complexity or unique Ordinances could even force him to make a move.
He shook his head as he entirely denied the very Ordinance of Existence of this being.
"The complexity of your Existence is far too simple to affect me. Don't even bother."
He waved his hand dismissively.
And the terrifying obsidian flames around him were pushed away and extinguished as if they never existed.
Immense silence descended in the surroundings!
The gazes of many changed.
They looked at this being who had a seemingly simple disposition as they became immensely serious!
On the other throne, the figure of the Viceroy turned his eyes extremely sharp as he voiced out his intent only to the Protectors around him.
|This entity...what do we know about him?|
He asked lightly.
If he probed his weavings just a bit more, he would have come to remember that he had actually seen this being before in an Arena!
But at that time, he had disregarded all those within the newly discovered Omniverse as nobody within was prevalent enough for him to even taint the memories of his records.
So he asked.
And a Protector around him opened his eyes in shock as he replied.
|I ran his physiology over our database just now! He...he is actually a newly ordained Protector from Omniverse X-999- Viceroy, a part of you gave them a visit recently!|
A unique finding bloomed.
Apart from Old Man Eudemus, no other core power of the Commonwealth had known or bothered with Noah.
Today, he sat on a throne similar to its young Viceroy as his visage came under scrutiny!

sentences.text: The Protectors of the Commonwealth.
The Antediluvian Leviathans.
These groups...were not everything within the Megalos Ynnere.
This reality was made clear at this moment as a young humanoid entity calmly sat on a throne!
Others may not be able to see, but Noah's Sacred Primal Eye of Existence could observe a twinkling of countless golden strings around this being.
Strings.
The Ordinance of Stringere!
The vast Expanse was filled with countless strings that bound together and weaved Existence, and this entity actually set an Ordinance related to this as it made Noah contemplative.
At this very moment, another part of him in the expanse was studying the Blancverse Domain he had bound while gazing at the countless golden strings that made up the Expanse.
If he could manipulate them like Bob could...
Many thoughts were burning within his mind as when he came across this Ordinance, her merely found it unique.
He knew that among his own Ordinances, there was one that could give him an answer and increased understanding towards strings.
Towards how they could all come together to weave existence.
But as for the oddity seated on the throne...
[Odyssion, the Wonderling]:: State of Existence- Ordinance of Existence.
Source of Existence- Stringere.
Lifespan- 5 Megalos Cycles/450 Megalos Cycles.
Records of Weavings- An entity unique in nature as he rose to prominence within his Domain at an early age.
He has focused on nothing else but the blind obsession for higher states of Existence, and will do anything in his power to achieve his aims.
Many of his records are inaccessible due to the complexity of his weavings...

Noah nodded at the feedback and details of this being as he lived less Cycles than even Great Ones like Nietzsche in the Megalos Beyond, and yet his power almost reached their level- and in fact far stripped Great Ones like Savitar.
He was an entity worthy of his power as after he showed it off, many eyes did not wish to test him again so quickly.
There was one entity alone on a throne that has yet to be tested on whether he even deserved to be sitting there.
Many eyes came towards the throne Noah sat on.
He sat there calmly as he gazed back towards these powerful entities, and he actually nodded as he waved his hands towards them!
"You all can definitely give it a try."
WAA!
Bold words filled with confidence echoed out as at this time, some entities could not hold back.
An Antediluvian Leviathan wreathed in black flames stepped forward, a scorching banner blooming above him as others stepped back while frowning.
The banner of Onyxfire.
The Ordinance of Onyxfire!
|This opportunity of the Omnifather...we must all give it everything we've got.
So, come off that throne for me.|
The banner above him shone as he didn't move another step.
As an Entity at the Ordinance of Existence, he could attack anywhere in this small enclosed domain just by applying his Ordinance!
And he did just that as above Noah's throne, an obsidian flaming furnace bloomed and released apocalyptic lava-like tenebrous flames that could break down the complexity of existence itself.
They were so potent that they even burned and remained burning on the surrounding weavings of Existence!
They washed over the throne Noah sat on as...
|Huh?| Many of the observing Entities clicked their lips in disregard as if they had been fooled, because they didn't even see the being on the throne release his Ordinance to defend.
He wasn't even fast enough to activate his Ordinance, and they had actually been cautious of him?
And due to their exceedingly cautious nature...
SAA!
The obsidian flaming Leviathan already appeared meters away from the throne as he seemed about to sit on it after he scorched the overconfident entity who sat before him.
But...
"What are you doing?"
HUUM!

In the middle of the burning Onyx flames of the Ordinance of Onyxfire, the visage of Noah still calmly sat on his throne as the burning flames spilling all around...didn't seem to be doing anything to him!
This eerie action instantly caused astonishment to bloom in the eyes of the obsidian flaming Leviathan as he rapidly moved back.
|You...my Ordinance is imposed around your existence, its will must be imposed!
You...you..!|
At the words of the Leviathan, Noah raised his hands wreathed in the burning flames that did absolutely nothing to him as he voiced out calmly.
"Why would your Ordinance have any effect on me?"
HUUM!
He could see the eyes and very core of existence of the Leviathan shaking when he said these words.
His body.
His being.
His very existence was surrounded by over 100 Ordinances!
Even without activating any of them, just the regal brilliance of his many Ordinances could offset and ignore average Ordinances.
Only those with truly deep complexity or unique Ordinances could even force him to make a move.
He shook his head as he entirely denied the very Ordinance of Existence of this being.
"The complexity of your Existence is far too simple to affect me.
Don't even bother."
He waved his hand dismissively.
And the terrifying obsidian flames around him were pushed away and extinguished as if they never existed.
Immense silence descended in the surroundings!
The gazes of many changed.
They looked at this being who had a seemingly simple disposition as they became immensely serious!
On the other throne, the figure of the Viceroy turned his eyes extremely sharp as he voiced out his intent only to the Protectors around him.
|This entity...what do we know about him?|
He asked lightly.
If he probed his weavings just a bit more, he would have come to remember that he had actually seen this being before in an Arena!
But at that time, he had disregarded all those within the newly discovered Omniverse as nobody within was prevalent enough for him to even taint the memories of his records.
So he asked.

|I ran his physiology over our database just now!
He...he is actually a newly ordained Protector from Omniverse X-999- Viceroy, a part of you gave them a visit recently!|
A unique finding bloomed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3349 Unveiling Complexity! I
paragraphs: An entity unbothered by the Ordinance of an Antediluvian Leviathan!
Unbothered to the extent that he didn't even unleash his own ordinance to defend.
Such a being sat on one of the three thrones competing for an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence that promised fantastical wonders.
Seeing such a scene, the calm coldness within the Viceroy shone as theoretically, he should be looking at his subject at this moment.
Someone under his banner.

As more information about him was discovered, and sensing his power, the calm Viceroy surrounded by Ordinance of Existence Protectors looked in the far distance where one could barely see the majesty of Ordinance Amalgamation Entities burning from afar.
In that place, he sent an intent towards the entity he was just told ordained this being near him as a Protector.
|Old Man Eudemus, is there anything to consider regarding the recently ordained Protector Osmont?|
His commanding intent traveled vast distances as he sought to uncover who this creature that acted like a weakling in front of him mere days ago!
At the same time...
|Hmm?|
His gaze flashed with a chilling light as he saw the Protectors around him swirling with vibrance, their bodies showing radiant circling wheels as they looked ahead!
All others seated on the thrones were tested.
Only the throne the Viceroy sat on remained untested as at this moment, others could only have designs on them when the other gel thrones showed entities of high difficulty on them!
Seeing this, the Viceroy couldn't help but sneer.
They thought him weaker than two unknown entities? |I welcome you all to test me. Just know that I won't be as merciful.|
His voice boomed out.
But the entities here would not be stopped so easily.
Each one had declared an Ordinance.
Each one held a wondrous level of Complexity of Existence!
They would not go without a fight as there were a few hundred here.
Even if a few of them were exceptional to sit on the thrones first...

|Brothers and Sisters...there are hundreds of us here and a few of them over there. Since they think themselves to be the most powerful, let us all attack together until we topple them, and then us average folks can have a go ourselves, yes?|

From among the few hundred Ordinance of Existence entities, a woman adorned in a golden robe smiled mischievously as her blue eyes looked ahead, her words causing the surroundings to light up with brilliance as heavy chaos was about to unfold!
In the midst of the selection of Tresorverse Towers of Existence occurring.
Away from it, within the Infinite Omniverse.
Noah rose from the multicolored throne made up of countless authorities of the Infinite Omniverse as he disappeared.

When he reappeared, he was within the depths of the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Omniverse, within a stellar domain that had dense swirling clusters of authorities at terrifying concentrations and purity.
And within these massive clusters, his people were calmly cultivating within.
Inside a golden cluster of swirling authority, the Bard of Quintessence could be seen- his head bobbing back and forth as he played a glorious melody!
Unconsciously, his hands playing the drums became faster as his trance was broken while he looked around.
And there...he saw Noah's figure.
DU! DU! DU!
The symphony he played became more ecstatic and glorious.
Many other eyes were roused from within the depths of the Extremity Vein as they came to land on Noah's figure!
Their Existence felt a sense of heaviness when they stared at him as he was surrounded by a regal astral light.
He looked at the many eyes that turned towards him and smiled.
He looked towards his son who rose up.
He looked towards Sona, Barbatos, Athena, and others.
He looked towards the Primogenitor of Steel, Cimmerian Architect, and Hyperion!
He looked at many beings as his voice echoed out.
"The Infinite Omniverse is about to undergo a great change and step into an unimaginable place. You all...need to take a similar step as you cannot be left behind."
WAA!
As he spoke, his main body began to glimmer with astral light.
He was the Omniversal Archontes Engineer, but he was also the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
And even now, he was assimilating the boons of this terrifying resurgence of a lineage and source of Existence alongside his breakthrough into the stage of Ordinance of Existence!
All parts of him were advancing.
But nothing more so than his distinctions.
Nothing more so than his lineage.
"Catch a glimpse of what I am talking about, as this is the power I will sacrifice a great deal to flow within your blood."
The Source of the Megalos.
The Records of the Megalonians!
He was currently the only Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, as he could pave the way and give rise to other Megalonians.
But it wasn't free.
There was a cost to pay in terms of complexity of existence!
But when it came to costly things, was this ever a problem for Noah?
"It is a terrifying power, and also a heavy one as others cannot know of its existence- with its records being entirely sealed by me. Glimpse...at the Megalos."
HUUUM!
His body buzzed.
For the first time since the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian fused with Noah, a System was used for the first time.
The System of the Megalos!
A glimmer of multicolored radiance.
Soon after, Noah's lone figure was surrounded by hundreds of other illusory entities that looked just like him...but with distinct varieties.
Possible versions of himself that could have bloomed from different causalities!
They bloomed this time not just for the further increase of Complexity, nor just to show off in front of his people.
His people needed to see the weight of what they would soon gain, and he...he needed a better grasp of Complexity as he continued to become increasingly complex.
Complexity...just how could it be quantified?
How did it tie to the Echelons of Existence and the States of Existence?
Change in chap titles

chapters.title: Chapter 3350 Unveiling Complexity! II
paragraphs: The scene was an alarmingly heavy one.
Those watching it felt like they were being privy to secrets they had no job knowing, their existence feeling sheer astonishment at the scene portrayed by Noah!
A single body of his, and yet hundreds, and then thousands more illusory bodies unfolded.

Each of them seemed to be a variation of himself across the Megalos, as while part of their job was to increase complexity, Noah had already made it clear that he wanted to understand Complexity itself the most!
How could he define it?
How he could quantify it!
So at this moment, as tens of thousands of illusory possible versions of himself unfolded and only continued to increase, each of them looked at each other and...
HUUM!
Opened their Sacred Primal Eyes of Existence.
It was a terrifying method and usage of the Source of Existence of the Megalos.
If one of him would take a long period of time to gain a better understanding of Complexity, what if endless versions of him sought the answer?
The unfolding reality became an even heavier one.

Blinding multi-colored light suffused all around as his people turned their eyes away, but Noah's endless Eyes of Existence continued to open luminously and peer across layers of weavings as soon- there were results!
There had to be results after such a drastic action!
|The Complexity of Existence and all that it encompasses has been made clear to you.|
BOOM!
Boundless waves of information flowed into him.

The tens of thousands of variations of himself radiated shocking glory as their eyes shone, their mouths opening to release an intent at this moment that felt like thousands of ancient voices overlapped together.
|The most basic level of complexity of Existence has been distinguished to be Terrestrial Complexity.|
A deep, inhuman voice that seemed to be steeped in mystery echoed out to his people- as if it were the words of a Sage coming down to enlighten others!
As he spoke, the surrounding reality flickered as blue lines converged to show the images of trees and animals.
An Ant. A Lion. A Human. A Dragon. An Antediluvian Leviathan. A Simian.
Myriads of races were reflected as Noah's intent continued!

|At the Terrestrial Complexity of Existence, entities ranging from the most basic life forms to those with increased complexity are included. Those who have not touched mana and those who have touched its existential authority are all included.|

|Terrestrial Entities constantly struggle against the ravages of time and adapt to their surrounding existence- gaining a semblance of control in the alteration of their immediate reality as they advance further, but little control and influence beyond their bounds of existence. Terrestrial Entities are forever confined to the Domains they were born in, never catching a glimpse of a Higher Weaving of Existence.|
Terrestrial.
In the distance, Henry felt his body shake as he affirmed to himself that he and all others within the Infinite Omniverse...were Terrestrial Entities!
But his father...it seemed that surely, he had broken these confines and should no longer be at this level of complexity.
Henry gazed at the tens of thousands of illusory bodies of his father as the sagely voice of overlapping entities continued.

|Within the bounds of the Terrestrial Complexity of Existence, there are three distinctions one can be- A Basic Terrestrial Entity, An Intermediate Terrestrial Entity, or an Advanced Terrestrial Entity.|

|Basic Terrestrial Entities are Life forms with minimal complexity, lacking any influence or control beyond their immediate reality. Many have not touched mana and remain ignorant of it all their lives. Countless quintillions upon quintillions fill this distinction across the Megalos of Existence.|

|Intermediate Terrestrial Entities are those who have reached a higher level of adaptability, having interacted with mana, and enabling limited control within their own existence. They are capable of manipulating weak laws and edicts of the reality around them, transforming Mana into a tool that aids them in the advancement of life. At the peak of this level stands those who are seeking the Extremes of what they stand for.|

|Advanced Terrestrial Entities are those that have achieved significant complexity within Terrestrial Complexity, gaining substantial influence over their surroundings and maximizing their potential within the bounds of their existence. Those touching upon Existential Extremity Authority fall within this level, with some unique ones even grasping at the complex States of Existence if the potential of their being is high enough.|
Thoroughly.
Clearly.

His people felt like their existence was defined in an extremely straightforward manner, their minds buzzing as the records of their lives flashed to when they were still only the most basic Terrestrial Entities!
In their reminiscence, they still heard the buzzing voice of utter majesty from Noah boom out.

|From the Basic level of Complexity known as Terrestrial Complexity, those who manage to grow their complexity to a sufficient enough level can transcend their own weavings and touch upon the Constellation Complexity of Existence.|
Constellation!
From Terrestrial Entities to Constellation Entities- a mere gap existing in between as few manage to cross it!

|Constellation Entities have their existences unburdened, their struggle against time and other natural factors of existence lessening as they can live for many cycles. They can exert a much greater control and influence over their own existence and their surrounding existence. Such Entities greatly range in the type and level of influence they can exert, and they can seamlessly traverse across Higher Weavings of Existence outside of the limited domain they were born in.|
Above them.
Noah's people saw an image of...Noah himself.
His body surrounded with Astral light, spinning around like a model for others to see and follow!
Alongside him, images of an Antediluvian Leviathan, a Simian, and an Outerversal Morphon whose bodies radiated terrifying waves of power and complexity appeared.

|Within the bounds of the Constellation Complexity of Existence, there are also three distinctions one can be- A Minor Constellation Entity, A Greater Constellation Entity, or an Elder Constellation Entity.|
Countless waves of information continued to flow into Noah from endless versions of himself, and he analyzed it all before he spoke about it as many things were made clear!

chapters.title: Chapter 3351 Unveiling Complexity! III
paragraphs: The words coming out from Noah were akin to words of sages from the distant past reverberating in their ears.
Among the many entities listening to Noah, Hyperion was sitting in a cluster of crimson gold radiance as his body was trembling while he listened.
When the demarcation between Terrestrial and Constellation Entities was made, his body couldn't help but tremble as this was something he could feel in his heart!
He could feel it so because he, along with many other Enders, were deeply connected to the Infinite Omniverse.
They could feel it.
They knew.

The Infinite Omniverse wanted to tackle this gap between a Terrestrial Complexity of Existence and Constellation Complexity of Existence not just soon, but it seemed like it would be at any moment from now.
For them, it felt like a moment of life and death as what would happen in the case of failure?!
They didn't know everything it knew.
They only wanted for it to succeed in its endeavor as at this moment, Hyperion could only listen.
He saw the tens of thousands of bodies of Noah floating around each other, their collective voices echoing out freely as they continued.

|Minor Constellation Entities are recently transcended entities who have minimal influence in their Constellation tier. They can traverse limited Higher Weavings of Existence and exercise moderate control over their surroundings. Some entities who fit this category include those who may have declared the Ordinance of their Existence or those who have reached the Eighth Echelon of Existence.|

|Greater Constellation Entities are more developed Constellation entities capable of living for many, many extended cycles. They can influence multiple domains of existence and exert considerable control over their environment with very little effort, unburdened by some existential limits. Some entities who fit this category include those who have undergone Ordinance Amalgamation, scales up to those who were capable enough to Sever their Existence- entities who have raised their Echelons of Existence to the Ninth Level.|

|Elder Constellation Entities are those with the highest level within Constellation Complexity, with substantial authority over the Higher Weavings of Existence. They wield significant influence and command across different weavings of existence- with the chance of others affecting their existence being extremely low. Elder Constellations can walk across the Expanse without fear of death as their very existence commands power. Such Entities are distinguished as Pioneers of Existence.|
Minor, Greater, and Elder Constellations.
Uniquely, even Existence Severing entities were placed as Greater Constellations, with Noah himself only taking on the distinction of a Minor Constellation at this moment!
And past those who severed their Existence, there were the Elder Constellations.
Entities termed as Pioneers of Existence.
Noah thought of this word himself even though he was the one who spoke about it, with him only continuing to filter and organize the incoming information before he laid it out.
He thought of the Great Beyonder and the Omnifather.
He felt like these beings had long since become Pioneers of Existence, and that they shouldn't even be settled in this stage at this moment.
They were very likely away from the distinction of Constellations entirely.
As he thought of this, his mind focused on the next waves of information cascading down.
And he spoke of them freely.

|As far as can be inferred by the current level of complexity, the advanced level of Complexity of past Constellations is known as the Source Complexity of Existence. Very little can be inferred from this as it is too far away.|
Source Complexity!

The Sacred Primal Eyes of Existence above each of the possible versions of himself opened ever wider, seeking to uncover even a little bit more knowledge on this as their golden pupils crackled with celestial lightning!
But some results came through.
|Within the bounds of the Source Complexity of Existence, there are also three distinctions one can be- A Lesser Source Entity, A Greater Source Entity, or a Prime Source Entity.|
Lesser Source, Greater Source, Prime Source Entities!
He knew too little of them.
He couldn't even infer what type of power each type of entity wielded.
The Great Beyonder and the Omnifather...were they within this stage?
And what about someone as mysterious as Bob who could seamlessly give a Blancverse Domain to another without so much as a thought.
Was he a Prime Source Entity, or something even beyond this in terms of Complexity?
Noah couldn't say.
HUUM!

But he had managed to achieve the goal of classifying and getting a deeper knowledge of Complexity, and the tens of thousands of illusory possible versions of himself began to disappear as the blinding light around each of them converged towards Noah!
In moments, only his figure remained as there was immense silence all around him.
Astral brilliance flickered around his body when his eyes opened, he seemed like a dazzling Constellation that others could only look to.
His eyes twinkled with Astral radiance as his hair danced like golden flames, the wings of Invictus Maximus spread out behind his back with colorless radiance covered by an astral gold glow.
At this moment, his eyes turned in a certain direction as he called out.
"My son."
WAA!
A single call.
And the visage of Henry appeared in front of him.
Dark blue threads of hair.
A face filled with dignity and regality as if he were a young king from an ancient kingdom.
Noah smiled while looking at him as he continued.

"My blood has always been heavy, but it is even heavier now as having it will implicate you. Having it will mean that in the future, Greater Constellations that have already Severed their Existence and even Elder Constellations who are Pioneers of Existence may be searching for you- seeking to devour your very existence. Do you want such a burden? Do you want this Lineage?"
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian Source of Existence he had obtained was tremendously powerful.
It was.
But it was also unfathomably dangerous as the Megalonians did not live long at all.
He was confident in shouldering the burden that came with this power, but he would not impose it on anyone else unless they understood what it truly represented!
