chapters.title: Chapter 3352 Unveiling Complexity! IV
paragraphs: And yet, not even an instant passed before his son bowed his head towards him and spoke without a shadow of a doubt.
"Let me share this burden with you, Father."
He didn't even ask for the boons that would come with it.
He just asked to share some of the burden his father carried so that he wouldn't have to hold all that weight on his shoulders alone!
Noah smiled at such an answer as he nodded, his existence burning brightly as the gate he had placed within his lineage that stopped the flow of unfathomable weavings of existence opened.
His lineage began to burn with golden astral splendor as above him, an endlessly blue banner began to spread out for light years.
Mana.
It was a single banner, but it also represented the many other banners he had under him, as it could transform into any Ordinance and all Ordinances at once!
The transfer and emergence of his Megalonian Blood into others of his lineage required a level of such authority.
Mana burned freely.
But in the next moment...
|A unique type of complexity of existence is blooming with the chosen target under the influence of your lineage.|

|Variations of this complexity exist as depending on the level of purity of the lineage of the target compared to yours, they may have the emergence of an Average Sacred Primal Megalonian Bloodline, a Rare Sacred Primal Megalonian Bloodline, or a Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian Bloodline.|
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Henry's figure became ensnared with waves of astral brilliance as deep within his existence, his blood erupted with fervor.
His father was inducing a shocking level of complexity within him as at this moment, his voice echoed out.

"During this process of emergence of complexity, you have a greater chance of attaining the state of One With Existence. Of achieving enough of a precipice in your complexity to go from a Terrestrial Entity and into a Constellation Entity that can roam the expanse. If anyone can do it, it should be you."
He released everything of his Lineage freely to his son.
His cells that were made up of quarks, leptons, and Psioneutrinos of Matter and Dark Matter.
They wouldn't be exactly the same, but their weavings would be passed on.

They were much more complex than other entities with just this alone as with it, the induction of entry into the States of Existence and even the transformation of Terrestrial Complexity into a Constellation Complexity was possible!
Henry heard these words as his eyes illuminated with terrifying golden radiance.
Around him, layers of Fabled Omniverses began to swirl as the single greatest tool he could use at this moment to ensure success in this ordeal...was the authority of Nepotism.
Who was he? Whose son was he?
With these mere questions, his Existence surged up exponentially as his degree of complexity began to rise!
He didn't even have to rely on his own brilliance, with the weavings of Nepotism brilliantly pulling on the weavings of his father to achieve the most favorable result!
|The Weavings of a Quintessential Sacred Primal Megalonian bloom within the Existence of Henry Osmont.|
BOOM!
A refulgence of brilliance unfolded.
And an instant later...the body of Henry seemed to vibrate with such a shocking frequency that it began to meld with the surrounding Existence.
The first sign of one attaining an existence complex enough to seamlessly understand and begin melding with the surrounding Existence!
One With Existence!
Such a phenomenon bloomed with the first entity that the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian passed down his weavings to, a shocking inheritance being carried out as others watched with open eyes.
This occurred within the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Omniverse that, at this moment, began to radiate a profound and concentrated light of complexity.
The Extremity Vein was something that stretched out the length of five normal Omniverses, and it was surrounded by stacks of Aletheian Havens all around in addition to the ones constructed within it.
The level of authority it contained far exceeded even one hundred normal Omniverses put together, and at this moment, all of it seemed to be rising and put to work for a specific purpose.
It was a unique oddity when one thought about it.

Entities increased their complexities, and domains of Existence remained relatively the same over the cycles- the increasing chaos only leading them towards eventual destruction after hundreds of Megalos Cycles, with some even withstanding thousands.
It was as if due to the fact that their weavings of Complexity were so stable at a certain stage, they could outlive entities who could increase their complexity to shocking degrees.
There seemed to be a demarcation between the two as one could not impose on the bounds of the other.
Megalos Ynnere would always be Megalos Ynnere, and had been this way for thousands of cycles past and thousands of cycles to follow.
The Megalos Beyond had always been the Megalos Beyond, nothing more, nothing less.
Megalos Nihilos was also the same!
Megalos Mountains that existed within the gaps of the Expanse also retained what they were, with nothing changing.
A World always remained a World.
A Universe always remained a Universe.
A Cosmos always remained a Cosmos.
The Infinite Omniverse had always violated this ruling.
It was merely a floating island, and yet it became much more than that- multiple times over.
On this day, it was about to violate this seemingly unbreakable rule yet again!
Within the depths of the Infinite Omniverse where a multicolored throne stood empty and mightily.
The Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse closed its eyes in front of this throne as it uttered out terrifying words- an influence of its master.
|Merely Complexity.|
HUUM!
|Who decided you could bind me to a certain state of Complexity?|
Who decided it could only be a floating Spiritual Land?!
Who decided it could only be a slightly larger Omniverse?!
Who decided that?!
BOOOM!
With unburdened fervor and brilliance, the Infinite Omniverse took all the authorities it carried.
All the complexity it had raised.

It took all of it...and caused it to begin transforming as through the sheer force of countless intricate weavings of complexity and the influence of being bound by an oddity of unfathomable measure...it began its incursion towards a greater state of complexity.
Towards the Expanse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3353 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! I
paragraphs: Over endless stretches of the Expanse.
Over the Megalos and the countless light years they covered.
There were innumerable entities within as whenever every single one made a move that would tremendously alter their existence, there was always a shred of caution and doubt.
They always knew that something could go wrong.
But, it was different for the Infinite Omniverse.
It had planned and calculated.
From its countless calculations, it had even gone above and beyond what it considered enough- devouring more Tainted Omniverses and Dark Matter Cores than it even needed for its complexity!
The boundless weavings of the Megalos from Ozymandias that it had only stopped just now to ensure that there would be no interruptions.
The Existential Terraforming that greatly expanded its weavings.
It had already surpassed all the scopes it set for success in transcending existence by a terrifying margin as the possibility of failure...was infinitely close to zero!
This was because the Infinite Omniverse knew that it couldn't afford to fail.
|My Extremity Vein.|
HUUUM!
The fabric of existence that made the Infinite Omniverse was buzzing as the Extremity Vein was stimulated.
The Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse had a calm expression, but one could see immeasurable defiance in its eyes as it called out again!
|My Aletheian Havens.|
Surrounding the Extremity Vein, the dazzling Aletheian Havens of Dreams, Apollyon, Elysium, Genesis, Helios, Oceanus, Prana...all these Havens pulsed with shocking valor as they contributed.
They were Havens, but they also had other identities.
|My Ordinances.|
WU!
One of the tools it had as a domain that others did not have.
Its Havens...were declared Ordinances under its Master!
And not just its Havens.
But also what made up the very foundation and pillars of the Infinite Omniverse were declared Ordinances!
Their level of Complexity was more than enough to induce transcendence within any Entity.
And yet the Infinite Omniverse held dozens of such Ordinances as its Pillars of support, along with their complexity!
So it asked again!
Who decided it would forever remain an Omniverse?
BOOM!
|Rise.|
Its voice boomed out across the Aletheian Havens and Extremity Vein.
All the countless areas of complexity it had so intricately prepared were ushered and moved at once, the connection towards Noah being focused on the most!
The connection towards a part of him that was not within these Megalos.
The connection towards the part of him within a Blancverse Domain inside the Expanse!
|Transcend.|
Commandingly.
Unquestioningly!
The Infinite Omniverse stated so as all the prepared Complexity...was to be used to directly traverse into the Expanse where Noah was!
This was what all the preparations were for.
For a single journey.
For a single jump!

The moment this journey was complete, the Infinite Omniverse would have transcended its past weavings of existence and be something else entirely once it arrived in the Blancverse Domain in the Expanse!
BOOM!
An unfathomable light wrapped around the Infinite Omniverse entirely- this construct buzzing as at this moment, within Omniverse X-999, an insignificant singularity blazed with terrifying brilliance.

A light so bright that the Omniversal Ankyra, who was currently in the midst of becoming One With Existence after his ventures across the Primalwater of the Primaltree of Existence, was shocked and blinded, barely catching a glimpse of this brilliance as an instant later, 99.999% of it disappeared.
A mere fraction was left behind within Omniverse X-999 as in part, this Omniverse that contained the Vacuous and Vitalis Domains were roots that were not abandoned!
But the entirety of the Infinite Omniverse itself had long since disappeared!
At this moment, the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse was gazing out as if it could see absolutely every grain of sand and any changes it experienced within this domain.
The whole Infinite Omniverse felt like a rapidly traversing body as it was surrounded by multicolored light, and a terrifying pressure was bearing down on it the further ahead it traveled!
But the more distance it covered, the closer it got to something grand.
To the Expanse.
And the closer it was to the Expanse, its complex weavings of Existence across its Aletheian Havens and Extremity vein began to undergo fundamental changes.
The complexity of the Infinite Omniverse began to rise above Terrestrial!
The closer it got to the Expanse, the closer it would be towards the next demarcation of complexity.
The closer it got to the Expanse, the more terrifying the pressure that was pressing down on it became!
As if the pressure was stating again and again, and with even more ferocity each time that the Infinite Omniverse should not do this.
It couldn't do this!
And yet...
|What are you to decide that?!|

The expression of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse gained more emotion as heavy, unfathomable majesty erupted on it, livid defiance flashing on its face as it kneeled down near the multicolored throne of authorities and roared!
HUUUUM!
A deep, ancient roar of authorities.
It activated waves of countless weavings of existence of the Infinite Omniverse as instantly, the distance it covered and crossed exponentially increased as it only became faster!
Within the Expanse.
In an unknown region, between two golden strings, a miniaturized Blancverse Domain could be seen.
Within its depths, a golden robed young emperor with astral brilliance surging around him opened his eyes wide as he...heard a distinct roar.
A roar of endless defiance and regality.
He didn't hear it from the Infinite Omniverse, but from the depths of the Blancverse Domain that he had loosened the bindings of the most to welcome a new entrant!
For him to hear this roar...
HUUM!
His eyes turned down with a sense of ecstasy.
He looked at the center of the Blancverse Domain where a spinning white gold singularity had begun to bloom.
As if a pathway was being opened for something connected to him to arrive!
All this time, the Infinite Omniverse had calculated and planned as when it moved into action, there was only assured success!
BOOM!
The Blancverse Domain trembled
With the control and understanding that Noah had gained recently, he loosened its restrictions towards what was coming as the task of the Infinite Omniverse became even easier!

The whole Infinite Omniverse felt like a rapidly traversing body as it was surrounded by multicolored light, and a terrifying pressure was bearing down on it the further ahead it traveled!
But the more distance it covered, the closer it got to something grand.
To the Expanse.
And the closer it was to the Expanse, its complex weavings of Existence across its Aletheian Havens and Extremity vein began to undergo fundamental changes.
The complexity of the Infinite Omniverse began to rise above Terrestrial!
The closer it got to the Expanse, the closer it would be towards the next demarcation of complexity.
The closer it got to the Expanse, the more terrifying the pressure that was pressing down on it became!
As if the pressure was stating again and again, and with even more ferocity each time that the Infinite Omniverse should not do this.
It couldn't do this!
And yet...
|What are you to decide that?!|

The expression of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse gained more emotion as heavy, unfathomable majesty erupted on it, livid defiance flashing on its face as it kneeled down near the multicolored throne of authorities and roared!
HUUUUM!
A deep, ancient roar of authorities.
It activated waves of countless weavings of existence of the Infinite Omniverse as instantly, the distance it covered and crossed exponentially increased as it only became faster!
Within the Expanse.
In an unknown region, between two golden strings, a miniaturized Blancverse Domain could be seen.
Within its depths, a golden robed young emperor with astral brilliance surging around him opened his eyes wide as he...heard a distinct roar.
A roar of endless defiance and regality.
He didn't hear it from the Infinite Omniverse, but from the depths of the Blancverse Domain that he had loosened the bindings of the most to welcome a new entrant!
For him to hear this roar...
HUUM!
His eyes turned down with a sense of ecstasy.
He looked at the center of the Blancverse Domain where a spinning white gold singularity had begun to bloom.
As if a pathway was being opened for something connected to him to arrive!
All this time, the Infinite Omniverse had calculated and planned as when it moved into action, there was only assured success!
BOOM!
The Blancverse Domain trembled
With the control and understanding that Noah had gained recently, he loosened its restrictions towards what was coming as the task of the Infinite Omniverse became even easier!

chapters.title: Chapter 3354 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! II
paragraphs: Were the Infinite Omniverse to try to reach the Expanse itself- at any random point, the difficulty would be extremely high.
But for it to reach a land in the expanse under the control of the Master?
HUUM!

With booming roars of defiance akin to an ancient steeds breaking past shackles to reach its Master, the white gold singularity exploded heavily as there, without a shadow of doubt, was a circular object glimmering with multicolored radiance.

The moment it arrived, Noah felt the countless golden strings around the Blancverse Domain vibrate and radiate a terrifying light of pressure- as if it were trying to snuff out something that should not be here!
The pressure even caused Noah's existence to tremble as he looked around angrily, feeling this pressure be something that may even crush dozens of Ordinance of Existence Entities in an instant.
"HO!" He bellowed out while pulling on the authority of the Blancverse Domain, this domain itself trembling with a protective light as 80% of the terrifying force was mitigated!
By the time it reached the Infinite Omniverse, only a portion of it remained as it was withstood valiantly, the multicolored circular object only becoming more resplendent!
And then, the moment after the pressure was withstood, the Infinite Omniverse vibrated as it seemed to gain a sense of stability.
As it became anchored fully and without a doubt, Noah felt the surrounding Blancverse Domain vibrate- along with the innumerable golden strings all around them.

Thereafter, the pristine Higher Weavings of Existence of the Expanse began to converge towards the Infinite Omniverse- dazzling multicolored light flowing into it as it devoured everything hungrily as if it hadn't eaten anything for cycles!
The golden strings in the surroundings buzzed with ineffable glory.
Moments later, an illusory mountain of tremendous size appeared below the Blancverse- stretching out the length of over a dozen Omniverses easily.
Above, an iridescent tree bloomed as its sheer size was the same, with its ends seeming to stretch out endlessly as it gushed down multicolored radiance below!
A mountain gushing endless waves of authority below, a tree gushing down seas of authority above.

It was the appearance of the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse that had appeared when Noah first absorbed Hearthraes, but their sizes...were incredibly tens of times more!
Noah's eyes were luminous at such a reality, but also somber as this was far too showy.
His Manifestation of the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse had attracted a Nihilos Ordinance Amalgamation entity.
Such a massive change here...could draw in others as well!
His eyes shone with a dangerous light as he got the Blancverse Domain ready to leave if need be.
But at this time, dazzling prompts rose before him.
|An Unfathomable and Irreversible Causality has been achieved!|
|Crossing untold distances, the Infinite Omniverse has arrived within the Higher Weavings of Existence as its weavings are being fundamentally changed to match its surroundings.|
|It can no longer be designated as an Omniverse, its new designation being-|
"Stop."
HUUUM!
A ringing sound bloomed as Noah's voice commandingly echoed out.
The prompt stopped in place as Noah gazed down at the seemingly small object being bathed by waves of dense and complex weavings of Existence, his voice extending towards it.
"What do you wish to be? Nothing can dictate your direction and path for you!"
The Master asked.
And the Infinite Omniverse answered as shockingly...the visage of an illusory woman draped in multicolored splendor appeared in the Expanse.
Her expression was one filled with majesty and curiosity as she looked around the Expanse, and she spoke out decisively in the next moment.
||I shall no longer be the Infinite Omniverse...and shall advance to become the Infiniverse Megalos Seed!||
WAA!
A grandiose declaration was made.
A declaration of appalling power and wonder as the moment it was made, the authority gushing into the Infiniverse Megalos Seed became interminably denser.
Infiniverse!
They had seen Omniverses, they had seen a Tresorverse, and they had seen a Blancverse.
On this day, the beginnings of an Infiniverse began, its ambitions far, far too heavy.
Noah gave a light nod as moments later, the prompts resumed.
|Within the Blancverse Domain, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed has been born.|
|An intricate and unbreakable connection is being formed between the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.|

|From the weavings of a Terrestrial Complexity of Existence, the components of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed are undergoing a metamorphosis into the weavings of a Constellation Complexity of Existence!|
Appalling brilliance shone as heavy, heavy changes occurred.
But as always.
Every choice led to countless effects.
A small ripple could lead to countless confounding results.
A vast distance away from where the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain was.
An Entity was traversing across the Expanse as she was not alone, a congregation of beings following behind her and below her.

Uniquely, she radiated the aura of an Ordinance Amalgamation entity as behind her, three terrifying Ordinance Amalgamation entities followed closely, while she herself was on top of a mount that radiated the aura of an Ordinance of Existence!
A Constellation Entity...was being used as a mount as it had the form of a radiant Three-Eyed Goldflame Steed.
Regality and royalty emanated from it, and yet the woman riding on top of it seemed to be dripping with even more majesty as at this moment...
|Oh?|
Her eyes and the eyes of those around her turned towards a certain direction where the brilliance of a massive mountain and tree shone.
So bright that even from this far distance, they saw it all clearly!
The eyes of the woman lit up brightly as she laughed.
|And they said I wouldn't come across anything myself even if I traversed a whole Cycle. Hmph, let's go grasp this opportunity. If anyone else even dares to come near it- kill on sight!|
Waves of terrifying power surged around these beings as they nodded, their figures shooting out towards the dazzling area in the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 3355 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! III
paragraphs: A terrifying Three Eyed Goldflame Steed strutted across the Expanse, bringing with it a unique existence at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage who was followed behind by three Ordinance Amalgamation Entities and 10 attendants.
Attendants.

But even these Attendants were at the stage of Ordinance of Existence- their weavings brimming with power as they looked around like battle-hardened soldiers who would move to protect at any sign of trouble.
It was a terrifying force moving around the Expanse as within moments, they traversed across the golden strings and saw the phenomenon blooming out much more clearly!
|My goodness...|
The female entity couldn't help but shake her head incredulously at the sight, their figures slowing down when they were quickly able to pinpoint the source of this commotion.
The moment they did so, their eyes flashed as their gazes brimmed with excitement.
They saw that in between the massive Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse, an area of blank white that was made as small as possible could be seen!
Whoever had bound it was trying to hide it, but how could it escape from their eyes after such a commotion?
And all of these waves of Complexities were surging into this area of white- this Blancverse Domain!
|Haha, it is actually a Blancverse Domain! A Blancverse Domain! If I bring this back, what more could they ask of me?!|
The gaze of the regal woman on the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed was brilliant as she uttered such words, her eyes flashing with radiance as she was even able to observe the areas within the Blancverse.
And there.
She saw two figures surrounding a singularity of multicolored radiance- like the Manifestation of the core weaving of the Blancverse Domain that seemed to be elevating itself to another level.
|Hmph.|
She saw the figures within it as her eyes became sharp.
A terrifying purple eye opened above her as it was reflected in her actual eyes, its gaze far-reaching.
Observing the two Entities closely, she felt nothing from the woman that had an illusory body, and a level of Complexity that should be below hers from the man as he...
|Bah, an Entity at the Ordinance of Existence was actually lucky enough to bind a Blancverse Domain and even had enough weavings to miniaturize it? Very well, it is a good gift prepared for me!|
WU!
Her stance was made clear as the entities within who seemed to be discussing amongst themselves turned to also gaze towards them.
The woman held no emotions on her face, while the man...
Was able to even rouse the eyes of the entity on the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed in appreciation as his complexity of existence was a refreshing one.
It made one naturally feel goodwill and held a sort of a magnetic pull that attracted other weavings of existence, making one want to innately possess him for themselves!
The terrifying entity licked her lips towards such a man as after she had spoken...the three Ordinance Amalgamation entities behind her moved forward.

One waved their hands as the surrounding light years were instantly encased in a dome of purple brilliance- this dome doing nothing to the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse as they simply passed through it.

The central one had the figure of a human with a silver horn shining brightly on his forehead, his figure adorned in silver robes just like all others as he spoke coldly towards the entities within the Blancverse Domain.
|A Daughter of Existence graces you with her presence, and you do not come out to greet her?|
A Daughter of Existence.
Sitting atop the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed, this woman had a figure that seemed to be carved from true treasures of the expanse itself.
Her dark hair shimmered with the light of stars, her fair skin vibrating with a layer of terrifying light.

Her curvaceous figure was wrapped in a simple gold dress that seemed made just for her, and she looked delicate as a flower while also shimmering with hardened brilliance that made it clear absolutely nothing could hurt her!
Her eyes were clear and tranquil as they radiated a terrifying purple light, their gaze looking over everything as if it should naturally be bowing towards her.
A Daughter of Existence.
Her Followers.
The moment they appeared, Noah felt a part of himself buzzing and shaking- deep within his existence, it was the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian Bloodline!
His eyes radiated a mighty level of power that wanted to erupt by itself, his stern will controlling his existence and communicating with the weavings of records left behind by Pyrrhus.
His obsession!

|The signature of the Complexity of Existence of one of the forces that descended onto the Megalos Mountains cycles ago to devour and extinguish Megalonians is felt within the weavings of the targets above.|
The Weavings of Pyrrhus.

They would resonate whenever the enemy of this obsession arose as with the Antediluvian Leviathans, there was a level of animosity purely due to the Omnifather who had been the first domino in all this.

But the hatred felt towards the signature of these beings ahead...was immeasurably vile as they had to be descendants or direct followers of those who greedily devoured Megalonian all those cycles ago!
A Daughter of Existence.
Sensing the terrifying level of complexity around her, as well as the three Ordinance Amalgamation Entities accompanying her, Noah frowned.
He was of the Ordinance of Existence.
But he was a terrifying entity at this stage as he instinctively felt...that there was a possibility to even withstand an Ordinance Amalgamation entity with the tools at his disposal!
But it had to be tested.
Fighting against a single Ordinance Amalgamation entity would have given an outlook and allowed Noah to gauge his power, but four of them?
He shook his head as it seemed just like before when he met the massive, silver-furred spider with thousands of eyes and limbs- he may have to relocate the Blancverse Domain once more.
As for the obsession of Pyrrhus...it would be achieved in time as Noah would mark all these enemies and find them later!

chapters.title: Chapter 3356 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! IV
paragraphs: Seeing his frowning gaze and even disregard, the three Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants of the Daughter of Existence became stern as their power roiled out, causing the surrounding weavings of Existence to vibrate!
|You dare not show respect to a Daughter of Existence? Are you not aware of what she represents? Are you not aware of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?!|
HUUM!
Each of his words were like shocking decrees as all of surrounding existence near the Blancverse Domain rapidly changed color.

Instantly, purple chains bloomed and covered everything- thousands of them covering all surrounding landscape as they only curved and did not apply their oppressive effects on the other Ordinance Amalgamation Entities and around the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed behind them!
But everything else.
All weavings outside of the Blancverse Domain were under his control.
"The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?"

Noah raised his brows at such words, the obsession of Pyrrhus further buzzing as if it were telling him one of the culprits...were either within this Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, or made up this power entirely.
Seeing his nonchalant expression, the Attendant of the Daughter of Existence let out a laugh of surprise.
|You really do not know of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse? Did you just recently begin roaming the Expanse? And you even attained a Blancverse Domain?|
Such a phenomenon was rare as this had to be a person of great luck!
On the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed, the Daughter of Existence smiled as she tapped on the gold fur beneath her.

|Young Man, come out and give up ownership of this Blancverse Domain to me, and I will expand your gaze to the wonders of the Expanse. You won't even know what to truly do with it anyway. Do this, and I can even consider making you my Prime Concubine. You will enjoy resources within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse that will allow to to fearlessly amalgamate your Ordinance- and even Sever your Existence!|
Her eyes were bright as she couldn't help but look at this defiant man with favor.
She didn't know why, but his very existence emanated an attractive force that made her want to put him under her!
|The Daughter of Existence, Sentara, Third of her Name, has shown you have favor. Are you still not coming out to receive it?|
The Attendant with the silver horn on his head had an ugly expression at this moment.
A Prime Concubine!
The Daughter of Existence actually favored him so much to offer him this in exchange for the Blancverse Domain!
This was something that even he could not attain as if he did, his status within the Immovable Sacred Palace would be cemented for cycles to come.
The status of the Daughters and Sons of Existence were that high!
Yet this buffoon before him didn't even seem to know favor from calamity as he shook his head.
"I do not need to be a Concubine, and I think I will keep this little Blancverse to myself."
|You...!| The Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Attendant turned furious.
But Noah waved his hands dismissively towards these beings as he waited for the transformation of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed to finish, and then-
||Master.||
HUUM!
Beside him, the Manifestation of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed stepped forward, her illusory form pulsing with multicolored radiance as ever so slowly, it began to become very, very real.
The curves of the figure became distinguished.
Multicolored strands of hair formed from terrifying authorities cascaded past her shoulders.
Fair skin that shone with a bronze golden luster formed, and eyes filled with endless light of trillions of singularities came to being!
A multicolored robe pulsing with shocking authority draped over her as she looked like an ancient queen gracing the common lands with her presence, her bright eyes illuminating everything!
She didn't seem like a Manifestation any longer- she seemed unfathomably genuine.
||I wish to try something, Master.||
Noah gazed towards the Manifestation- nay, could it still be called a Manifestation?
"This is?"
He asked with bright eyes as the reply came while this dazzling visage of a woman raised her scintillating hand up, seeing the trillions of layers of reinforced authority underneath.
||My Infiniverse Megalos Body. With it, I wish to test some things.||
Authority crackled around her madly.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body!
Noah looked at this wonder with bright eyes as prompts flashed over his eyes.
|The limitations and bindings of the past are being rewritten.|
|The potential and possibilities of the complexity of existence of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and what weavings it can accomplish are unknown and endless.|
Such prompts flashed within Noah's mind as he gave a nod of dazed affirmation, and in the next moment...
PA!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body took a single step and instantly appeared outside the Blancverse.
Outside!
Any Ordinance Amalgamation or Ordinance of Existence Entity did not need to personally use their bodies to attack their enemies.
Some could attack the distance of an Omniverse away, and terrifying Ordinance Amalgamation entities could fight and exert their Ordinance the distance of multiple Omniverses!
By all means, the Infiniverse Megalos Body had no need or reason to appear outside of the protection of the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.
And Noah knew she was far from being stupid with its calculations.

So he didn't call her back or doubt her, only watching with a sense of amazement as the moment she arrived outside the Blancverse, she was faced with the terrifying altered existence filled with layers of purple chains!
All of the surrounding Existence- under the banner and control of the Silver Honed Ordinance Amalgamation expert.
Yet when she arrived, her body shimmered with a seemingly appalling radiance- a radiance of weight.
Of Mass.
Of Tonnage!
Her body seemed to carry ancient and unbearable weight that tyrannically pressed down over everything at this moment!
The dense purple chains in the region she appeared...vibrated and quaked before they were actually shattered an instant later- leaving behind a gold region of golden strings of the Expanse once more.
The eyes of the Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Entity opened wide with incredulity!

sentences.text: Seeing his frowning gaze and even disregard, the three Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants of the Daughter of Existence became stern as their power roiled out, causing the surrounding weavings of Existence to vibrate!
|You dare not show respect to a Daughter of Existence?
Are you not aware of what she represents?
Are you not aware of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?!|
HUUM!
Each of his words were like shocking decrees as all of surrounding existence near the Blancverse Domain rapidly changed color.

Instantly, purple chains bloomed and covered everything- thousands of them covering all surrounding landscape as they only curved and did not apply their oppressive effects on the other Ordinance Amalgamation Entities and around the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed behind them!
But everything else.
All weavings outside of the Blancverse Domain were under his control.
"The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?"

Noah raised his brows at such words, the obsession of Pyrrhus further buzzing as if it were telling him one of the culprits...were either within this Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, or made up this power entirely.
Seeing his nonchalant expression, the Attendant of the Daughter of Existence let out a laugh of surprise.
|You really do not know of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?
Did you just recently begin roaming the Expanse?
And you even attained a Blancverse Domain?|
Such a phenomenon was rare as this had to be a person of great luck!
On the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed, the Daughter of Existence smiled as she tapped on the gold fur beneath her.
|Young Man, come out and give up ownership of this Blancverse Domain to me, and I will expand your gaze to the wonders of the Expanse.
You won't even know what to truly do with it anyway.
Do this, and I can even consider making you my Prime Concubine.
You will enjoy resources within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse that will allow to to fearlessly amalgamate your Ordinance- and even Sever your Existence!|
Her eyes were bright as she couldn't help but look at this defiant man with favor.
She didn't know why, but his very existence emanated an attractive force that made her want to put him under her!
|The Daughter of Existence, Sentara, Third of her Name, has shown you have favor.
Are you still not coming out to receive it?|
The Attendant with the silver horn on his head had an ugly expression at this moment.
A Prime Concubine!
The Daughter of Existence actually favored him so much to offer him this in exchange for the Blancverse Domain!
This was something that even he could not attain as if he did, his status within the Immovable Sacred Palace would be cemented for cycles to come.
The status of the Daughters and Sons of Existence were that high!
Yet this buffoon before him didn't even seem to know favor from calamity as he shook his head.
"I do not need to be a Concubine, and I think I will keep this little Blancverse to myself."
|You...!| The Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Attendant turned furious.
But Noah waved his hands dismissively towards these beings as he waited for the transformation of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed to finish, and then-
||Master.||
HUUM!
Beside him, the Manifestation of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed stepped forward, her illusory form pulsing with multicolored radiance as ever so slowly, it began to become very, very real.
The curves of the figure became distinguished.
Multicolored strands of hair formed from terrifying authorities cascaded past her shoulders.
Fair skin that shone with a bronze golden luster formed, and eyes filled with endless light of trillions of singularities came to being!
A multicolored robe pulsing with shocking authority draped over her as she looked like an ancient queen gracing the common lands with her presence, her bright eyes illuminating everything!
She didn't seem like a Manifestation any longer- she seemed unfathomably genuine.
||I wish to try something, Master.||
Noah gazed towards the Manifestation- nay, could it still be called a Manifestation?
"This is?"
He asked with bright eyes as the reply came while this dazzling visage of a woman raised her scintillating hand up, seeing the trillions of layers of reinforced authority underneath.
||My Infiniverse Megalos Body.
With it, I wish to test some things.||
Authority crackled around her madly.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body!
Noah looked at this wonder with bright eyes as prompts flashed over his eyes.
|The limitations and bindings of the past are being rewritten.|
|The potential and possibilities of the complexity of existence of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and what weavings it can accomplish are unknown and endless.|
Such prompts flashed within Noah's mind as he gave a nod of dazed affirmation, and in the next moment...
PA!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body took a single step and instantly appeared outside the Blancverse.
Outside!
Any Ordinance Amalgamation or Ordinance of Existence Entity did not need to personally use their bodies to attack their enemies.
Some could attack the distance of an Omniverse away, and terrifying Ordinance Amalgamation entities could fight and exert their Ordinance the distance of multiple Omniverses!
By all means, the Infiniverse Megalos Body had no need or reason to appear outside of the protection of the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.
And Noah knew she was far from being stupid with its calculations.

So he didn't call her back or doubt her, only watching with a sense of amazement as the moment she arrived outside the Blancverse, she was faced with the terrifying altered existence filled with layers of purple chains!
All of the surrounding Existence- under the banner and control of the Silver Honed Ordinance Amalgamation expert.
Yet when she arrived, her body shimmered with a seemingly appalling radiance- a radiance of weight.
Of Mass.
Of Tonnage!
Her body seemed to carry ancient and unbearable weight that tyrannically pressed down over everything at this moment!
The dense purple chains in the region she appeared...vibrated and quaked before they were actually shattered an instant later- leaving behind a gold region of golden strings of the Expanse once more.
The eyes of the Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Entity opened wide with incredulity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3357 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! V
paragraphs: Incredulity.
Such an emotion flashed past the eyes of the Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation entity as it knew its power well.
Currently, its Ordinance of Dignity was covering this whole region as for him, it was akin to an extension of his body.
As if this whole region was now a part of him.
And Dignity could be expressed thoroughly and absolutely in this space!
For it to be denied, an equally imposing authority had to be laid down as even then, the two Ordinances would fight for supremacy.
The better and more unique Ordinance would win.
The more complex Ordinance would triumph!
As someone who did not only express his Ordinance, but also amalgamated with it entirely through his existence- denying him was that much harder.
Another Ordinance Amalgamation entity would have to be more complex than him by a factor of two or more to be able to even deny it!
This was the truth.
And yet...
Without using an Ordinance.
Without any superfluous means.
This woman shimmering with multicolored radiance actually denied and broke his Ordinance by what seemed like sheer mass of complexity alone!
|Mass? Your Amalgamated Ordinance is mas-|
HUUM!
The Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Entity had begun to speak with an ugly expression, but the Infiniverse Megalos Body paid him no heed as she moved towards him.

With every step she took, the dazzling purple chains laid out shattered and disappeared- her figure looking like a runaway train that could not be stopped no matter what as in an instant, she arrived before her enemy!

Such an action caused alarm to rise on all those here as hastily, the Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Entity waved his hands as his figure became encased in a crystalline purple exoskeleton of dignity- unbreakable in nature.
Above him, a banner of purple Dignity unfurled as it burned with endless majesty, and behind him, the outline of a grand celestial palace began to form imposingly!
With all of this unfolding, a terrifying feeling of undeniable royalty flowed out as the Daughter of Existence in the back, along with her other Attendants, nodded and breathed easily once more.
Yes.
This was how their might should be.

In front of this endless grandeur of Dignity, all enemies would find the complexity of their existence to not be enough as their Ordinance would gain a feeling of inferiority until it was ultimately suppressed!
Yet in the next moment.
The dazzling figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body balled her hands into fists before she swung them down like hammers.
BOOM!

Appallingly, the radiant exoskeleton and forming Manifestation of a scared palace instantly shattered, the fists of the Infiniverse Megalos Body shattering the swirling Dignity around her enemy as her hands actually smashed on top of the head and caved it in!
Purple gold blood gushed out from the eyes and nose of this regal Ordinance Amalgamation Entity, his eyes fully bulging out of their sockets from the blow!

The expression of the Infiniverse Megalos Body was cold as her right leg was flung out right after, going up towards the groin mercilessly as any shred of complexity was destroyed by sheer mass alone, a horrific sound booming out as her leg deformed the groin to the extent that her leg extended all the way to his stomach.

Unbearable, unfathomable waves of pain echoed out within the bulging eyes of the Silver Horned Ordinance Amalgamation Entity, his existence feeling as if the heaviest thing in its whole life had knocked into it as at this moment- he couldn't even retaliate.
All of his complexity felt dazed and denied entirely, his Dignity utterly shredded as it couldn't find itself rising again from the sheer tonnage pressing down!
And in such a state...
WUU!

The Infiniverse Megalos Body raised her hand up and chopped down as if she was a sharp sword, purple gold blood bursting in abundance in the next moment as like a jagged blade, the unfathomable complexity of her sheer weight alone tore the body of an Ordinance Amalgamation entity top to bottom.
It wasn't just the tearing of the body.
It was also the decimation and tearing of the weavings of Existence of this entity fully as in the next moment, no manifestations of purple chains remained active anymore.

Only the golden strings of the Expanse surrounding a small Blancverse remained, along with the bloody and wild figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body fully tore in half an Ordinance Amalgamation entity, their deep and dense weavings of existence being turned dim as she grabbed the halves of his body and flung them towards the Blancverse Domain.

Her figure then vibrated as purple gold blood and pieces of organs drifted off her body, her cold eyes staring ahead towards the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed, the one atop it, and those around it who looked towards her with rage and small traces of fear!
This was because they just watched an Ordinance Amalgamation expert be literally ripped apart in seconds.
What kind of monster was this?
What-
BOOM!

Her figure was relentless as it flung itself forward, being even faster with no laid out Ordinances around as she actually reached the front of the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed in an instant, this horse jumping back in fright as the figures of the other two Ordinance Amalgamation Entities appeared in front of it while crying out.
|Protect the Daughter of Existence!|
|You dare to do this?! Understand that behind us, there is the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!|
Two shouts.
All with self-explanatory purpose, but there was a sense of fear in each shout!
After all, they had just observed their colleague literally be ripped apart.
Their bodies had begun to erupt with signature complexities of Dignity, a massive palace beginning to manifest behind each of them when...
PANG!

The hands of the Infiniverse Megalos Body swung left and right like hammers, smashing into their bodies and shockingly causing their emerging Ordinances to forcefully retreat in their bodies, and the head of the Infiniverse Megalos Body flung itself forward to smash into the Three Eyed Goldflame Steed that the Daughter of Existence sat on!
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3358 Infiniverse Megalos Seed! VI
paragraphs: The two Ordinance Amalgamation Entities to the left and right had their Ordinances suppressed and flung away, one being smashed on the chest as he heaved, while the other had their head fully twisted with a huge dent.
They were Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
The Three Eyed Goldflame Steed...was merely of the Ordinance of Existence.

It faced the terrifying complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Body head on- literally, as when the head of the Infiniverse Megalos Body smashed into its own head, the appalling scene of the horse-like head being pulverized into a cloud of golden blood emerged.
Up to the long neck, everything was turned into a cloud of blood.

A terrifying power and complexity seemed to be carried along with this strike as the brightness of any Ordinance and life of the now headless Three Eyed Goldflame Steed dimmed greatly, its weavings entirely shutting down!
Such a scene...now caused waves of rising horror.
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed moved rapidly and savagely.
She seemed like a celestial child of the wilderness who tore everything with brute force, her body flinging her arms and legs as their force alone tore everything apart!
The Three Eyed Goldflame Steed dead, the Daughter of Existence atop it was utterly livid and filled with trepidation.

At this moment, the angered Daughter of Existence finally moved from her dead steed and appeared right before the Infiniverse Megalos Body, her hands rising up as behind her, the manifestation of a purple mountain the size of half an Omniverse already appeared.

It supported her small figure as she exploded with terrifying strength, her hands swinging like hammers and with tremendous speed to smash onto the head of the Infiniverse Megalos Body as she wanted to overpower just like it- give it a taste of its own medicine!
BOOOM!
The strike and force was heavy, and yet...
The radiant head of the Infiniverse Megalos Body was only forced to turn sideways slightly.

Her hands reached out to grasp both arms that had swung down on her face- slight redness on her cheeks slowly fading away as she came to stare at the Daughter of Existence coldly- horror rising on the face of this woman.
When she stuck down, she didn't even feel like she had hit a living, complex being! What was this?
What was this?!
RIIP!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body savagely pulled down the arms it held, muscle and bone tearing apart as all of these physical actions carried heavy implications of the weavings of existence.
It was like the very complexity of existence of the Daughter of Existence was being denied and ripped apart, her arms actually becoming torn from her shoulders as golden blood overflowed!
The hands of the Infiniverse Megalos Body then swung towards the neck of the Daughter of Existence like scissors as...
SNIP!
The head was cleaved clean off.
The gorgeous head of the Daughter of Existence that was filled with appalling horror.
It wasn't just her head, but it felt like all of her existence was being cleaved off by the terrifying complexity the Infiniverse Megalos Body possessed!
The shadow of death came for the Daughter of Existence.
The two flung-back Ordinance Amalgamation entities cried out in shock and horror as their Ordinances whipped out again from afar, but it seemed like everything was all done!
At such a moment.
HUUM!

A unique power rose within the headless body of the Daughter of Existence- bursting with a terrifying radiance that shockingly emitted a Severing light that struck out towards the source of the deathly damage dealt to the Daughter of Existence.
BOOM!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body was flung back like a ragdoll, only coming to a stop a distance away as her hair whipped around her head maddeningly.
A huge gash split open her body top to bottom as if it was seeking to bisect her, but her body was shockingly far too sturdy!
In the gash that was rapidly healing, one could only see multicolored astral radiance within- not any blood or organs.

As she healed, she looked ahead to observe the scene of the bisected head of the Daughter of Existence going back towards her neck along with her ripped hands- her dying existence instantly returning to its previous state due to a shocking power!
A power that wasn't hers.
Likely a safeguard placed on her by her people!

In an instant, she was healed and back to her prime as she had a savage look on her face, her eyes and intent betraying her fear as her two remaining Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants appeared beside her.
|Escape!|
Escape.
They could do nothing else as their enemy was too dominating!
Behind them, the Ordinance of Existence attendants scrambled away rapidly as all of them turned into streaks of light.
HUUM!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body had finished healing as her gaze was unfathomably cold.
She raised her hand and formed a fist.
Instantly, for the distance equivalent to three Omniverses, a sandy gold domain emerged rapidly.
Its sands were filled with the authority of the Ordinance of Dreams, and it wrapped around everything while making it clear that nobody would leave!
The hearts of these terrifyingly powerful Ordinance Amalgamation Entities began to fill with terror as at this moment, they began to burn their existence, going all out!
But the Infiniverse Megalos Body was relentless.
With the emerging sandy gold domain, she finally stayed still as her body...began to shimmer with the grandeur of Ordinances.
Plural.
Instantly, a violet purple light flashed in her eyes as dazzling flames of Entropy burned around her.

In the far distance, sandy gold waves surging around the two Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants instantly changed to become filled with heavy Entropy- its imposition causing their own Ordinances to tremble as the Complexity of their existence slowly began to erode!
And an instant later, in addition to the light of entropy, a blazing white banner of Genesis flashed above the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
Instantly, above the fleeing figure of the Daughter of Existence, a sharp white sword manifested and cleaved down as if it sought to return everything to its initial, basal state!

chapters.title: Chapter 3359 Savage! I
paragraphs: An Ordinance could strike out an equivalent distance of an Omniverse or even more depending on the level of complexity.
At this moment, the Infiniverse Megalos Body was targeting the Daughter of Existence light years away who was seeking to escape!
BOOM!
The white sword of Genesis transformed from the golden sand all around and struck down above the Daughter of Existence, her expression maddened as she continued rushing out.
The moment the white sword reached her...
BZZT!

The invisible but terrifying power that had reversed her very death seemed to still be present as it Severed away the descending Genesis- the whole nearby region of a single light year having the sandy gold domain also dispersed as the Daughter of Existence continued to run.
But it was like running in an endless region of dreams as the Infiniverse Megalos Body knew that she wouldn't be able to escape!
And the authority protecting her...it would run out soon enough.
So in the meantime...
Her gaze turned towards the two Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants, as well as the remaining Ordinance of Existence Attendants.
While scrambling away, their skin felt an undeniable chill of death as they didn't even turn around, each step they took traversing light years as all around them, only golden sand blazed around!
Each one shot towards another direction to increase their chances of survival, and when the Infiniverse Megalos Body saw this, her eyes became even colder as another Ordinance bloomed around her.
The Ordinance of Cloning blazed around her as instantly, ten Versions of her appeared.
All the attendants felt a chill as their observation still saw what was happening behind them.
What occurred next was simply a sequence of catastrophes.
WAP!

All the clones of the Infiniverse Megalos Body dispersed and melded with the golden sand nearby, and in the next instant, they crossed vast distances to appear above or in front of the Attendants- their bodies reforming from the golden sands themselves!
Above one of the Ordinance Amalgamation Attendants.
His white hair fluttered in his head as he was aged, and yet his unfathomably deep complexity of existence made him seem like he was in his prime.
Amalgamation.
Reaching such a stage was truly difficult as any wrong step, and they would have their very existence collapse!
Such complexity was truly hard to overcome.
But the Infiniverse Megalos Body seemed to defy all of these truths, her sheer complexity of existence bulldozing everything.
One had to understand just what type of Existence she was right now to be able to grasp why she could thrash the Ordinance Amalgamation Entities here.
The representative of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Her scale was something that these beings couldn't even fathom as when she appeared above them, they only felt terror as their existence howled out in defiance!
|OOH!|

The Existence Amalgamation Attendant bellowed upwards a purple banner of an Ordinance sought to bloom above him, but the Infiniverse Megalos Body came with its legs swinging down as if it were giving a beat down.
BOOM!
The forming banner dispersed before it could even be formed.

This man wasn't even able to bring out his complexity as the legs of the Infiniverse Megalos Body felt like hundreds of Megalos Mountains smashing unto him, the pressure causing his existence to buzz as golden blood leaked out from all orifices!
In his daze, the Infiniverse Megalos Body slapped down, her palm lightly landing on his body.
Lightly.

And yet, as if tremendous tonnage was applied internally, the weavings of the existence of this Ordinance Amalgamation entity became scrambled entirely- the light of his existence dimming as if something far too heavy extinguished it!
His body went limp moments later.
Another Ordinance Amalgamation Entity, dead.

Simultaneously, in another direction, another clone of the Infiniverse Megalos Body had appeared above the third Ordinance Amalgamation Attendant, her body clad in the Ordinance of Helios as her skin and everything about her turned clad into fiery golden flames!

The whole temperature within that area turned to an unbearable octave as the Infiniverse Megalos Body burning with Helios swung her hand down- a stanchion of golden flames smashing down as the Ordinance Amalgamation Attendant roared out and sought to use his complexity to fight it, but...
Any roars stopped seconds later as the golden stanchion of flames disappeared.
It all happened simultaneously.
In other directions where the 9 escaping Ordinance of Existence Attendants were fleeing to, bodies of the Infiniverse Megalos Body had appeared there as well.
These Entities died in even less time than those more powerful than them as in a matter of seconds, only their bodies remained.
And the golden sand formed into tendrils that wrapped around their lifeless bodies as they were speedily flung towards the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain.
Of the party that had been attracted by the appearance of a dazzling tree and mountain in this region, only a single one now remained.
SAA!
As if she was surfing across the sandy gold waves of dreams, the Infiniverse Megalos Body appeared right in front of the path of the Daughter of Existence.
Moments later, her clones also appeared around her, each one coldly staring at the Daughter of Existence before their bodies turned into golden lights that merged with the singular figure.
Soon, only one Infiniverse Megalos Body was present as she looked at the Daughter of Existence who was surrounded by a terrifying light of existence that was gradually fading away.
Towards such a being, the eyes of the Infiniverse Megalos Body were filled with calculating light that observed the rate the unique power was fading around her as her intent echoed out.
||You will not live.||
A few words.
But they were akin to a decree.
As if the Infiniverse Megalos Body was stating the most common fact!
As if she had decided that at this moment, the life of this Daughter of Existence was severed!
The Daughter of Existence glared hatefully towards this terrifying existence.
Hatred and fear permeated her every pore as she looked ahead, but she didn't plead!

At this moment, the Infiniverse Megalos Body was targeting the Daughter of Existence light years away who was seeking to escape!
BOOM!
The white sword of Genesis transformed from the golden sand all around and struck down above the Daughter of Existence, her expression maddened as she continued rushing out.
The moment the white sword reached her...
BZZT!

The invisible but terrifying power that had reversed her very death seemed to still be present as it Severed away the descending Genesis- the whole nearby region of a single light year having the sandy gold domain also dispersed as the Daughter of Existence continued to run.

chapters.title: Chapter 3360 Savage! II
paragraphs: She didn't voice out that she came from the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse again.
She didn't voice out regarding her status as a Daughter of Existence, nor that she should refrain from killing her due to it. She could see that this...thing did not care at all.
Even if she was the next Successor of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, this creature wouldn't care- she would kill regardless!
The Daughter of Existence realized this as in this moment of sheer terror for her life, she actually laughed.
|I hope my death makes things very, very difficult for a monster like you. For the possibility that you will feel what I feel now.|

The fear of death could not be entirely erased in her voice as she spoke out, the power protecting her continuing to fade away as she saw the Infiniverse Megalos Body come closer and closer- her voice devoid of any emotion!
They were warned while growing up within the Megalos Seas of their homes.
That the Expanse was vast and filled with countless unknown wonders and terrors.
They came hand in hand as the biggest thing they had to be careful of...was to not come across a creature that could extinguish their Existence!
She was even given a Protection Charm from an Existence Severing Entity, and yet...nothing could be changed.
|I truly hope for it, you monster!|

She spat out spitefully as the last shred of protection around her faded, and the Infiniverse Megalos Body moved instantly- her figure akin to a released arrow as her hand pierced the chest of the Daughter of Existence savagely!

A multicolored beating heart was held in her hands that punctured through the back of the Daughter of Existence whose weavings were entirely oppressed and extinguished, her body slumping forward as her lifeless head even landed on the shoulders of the Infiniverse Megalos Body.

As if something dirty had landed on her, sandy gold tendrils grabbed the corpse of the Daughter of Existence and pulled it towards the Blancverse Domain, her own figure warping and appearing within the domain with a multicolored heart in hand!
Her body buzzed with savagery as she looked towards her Master, who gazed towards her with a sense of fascination and incredulity, her voice echoing out.
||The test is half completed, Master.||
She didn't ask for any praise, and she even stated that what she wanted to try was only halfway completed!
Just what more frightening things did she wish to do?

Her gaze went towards the corpses of Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence entities, the latest one of the Daughter of Existence arriving as she looked at all of them and gathered them together before her.

||Their Sources of Existence are more inclined towards Matter, with their Systems of Existence being nothing significantly different. Their complexity of existence still remains even after their weavings of who they are were extinguished...||
Bloodied and beaten, the corpses of Ordinance Amalgamation entities glowed with a dim radiance of complexity as if to show just what terrifying state they had reached even in death.
The ones at the Ordinance of Existence stage glowed just a little less brighter as after they were lined up, the Infiniverse Megalos Body swung her hand down commandingly!
|Existence Derivation of the Megalos has been utilized by the Infiniverse Megalos Body.|

With a wave of her hand, her entire body became covered with the incandescent gold light of loot, the corpses in front of her becoming cut up and broken down as they became bathed with a golden light that compressed everything about them!

From their bodies filled with heavy complexity, a unique authority altered everything as they were broken down and compressed- golden singularities being made from their bodies as they emanated a heart shaking allure when one stared at them.

Not just this, but behind the broken down corpses, golden light emerged to form the outline and framework of illusory figures of these beings- their arms and legs in fetal positions with their eyes closed!

|The Complexity of Existence of the selected targets has been broken down into 36 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities and 90 Ordinance Hearthraes Singularities, with the remaining weavings of their existence utilized to induce the formation of the Blanc Illusory Weavings of Existence.|

|The Complexity of the Blanc Illusory Weavings of Existence can be filled and nurtured by any Ordinance, and once a critical amount of complexity has been infused, they will become Illusory Weavings of Existence specialized towards a certain Ordinance of Existence.|
The Infiniverse Megalos Body said she wanted to try something.
But she was truly going above and beyond as her transformation into a Constellation Complexity was something that had far exceeded anything imagined!
With a wave of her hands, only dazzling golden circular gems floated where the bodies of the Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence entities used to be.

The Infiniverse Megalos Body grasped a golden Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity in her hands as behind her, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself continued to radiate a shocking light of complexity as it devoured the deluge of authority all around the Expanse.
Its advancement was a heavy one.
An unfathomable one!
And there was something even more astounding.
Effectively, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed was now in the Expanse.
But it was not alone.

Within, there were countless quintillions of entities who were now inadvertently exposed to the Higher Weavings of Existence, with the levels of atmospheric authority they could take in their bodies being something that others couldn't even imagine!

For those whose complexity was intricate enough, how little time would they need for them to entirely transcend the weavings of their Existence and be able to freely step out of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and into the Expanse?
||There are many changes to grasp and understand with the entry into the Expanse, but my gifts to Master will start with this- if that girl can also come out and increase the number.||
The Infiniverse Megalos Body waved her hands as all the Hearthraes Singularities floated towards Noah, and she called out for a girl to come out and increase the number.
A girl.
Naturally, who else could it be other than Ruination who was able to arrive in the Expanse within Noah's weavings of existence even faster than the Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3361 Dominoes I
paragraphs: Inexplicably linked and bound to the Omniversal Archontes Engineer- to the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
Ruination!
A unique complexity tracing its origins to Noah's earliest beginnings.

Someone who had provided a spark that made many things possible today. Noah smiled when he heard the way that the Infiniverse Megalos Seed referred to Ruination as that girl, noting the unique relationship these two had over the months.
A second later, a light glimmered around Noah as from him, a streak of crimson gold radiance came out to form into the body of none other than Ruination.
Currently, radiant crimson hair flowed down her shoulders as her skin shone with a tan bronze hue.
A gold dress flowed down her body as on her ears, she had crescent earrings that looked eerily close to her old form as a weapon!
She appeared in the Blancverse- in the Higher Weavings of Existence that was the Expanse, and there was no sense of rejection.
As if she was a Constellation Complexity Existence who naturally belonged here!
And of course, being with Noah's Forge that was hidden in the depths of his existence meant that when Noah transcended his Existence, so did she.
But her change was gradual.
Influenced by the one she was inside the weavings of!
Until at this moment, she came out in a grander form than ever before as she was in her prime.

She gazed towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body and nodded towards it gently, her gaze then focusing elsewhere. Always within Noah's weavings, her body currently carried a shocking sense of complexity as she stared at the wonders of loot around her.
And she then waved her hands towards an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity as its details rose up for her and Noah!

[Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity]:: A Singularity containing part of the complexity of the collapsed weavings of existence of an Ordinance Amalgamation Entity. Devouring this Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity allows one to increase their own complexity- easing the path across the three demarcations of the complexity of Constellations. If taken and assimilated by those who have yet to step into the Complexity of a Constellation, these singularities are capable of inducing change forcefully for a sufficient amount.
The round gold gems pulsing with heart shaking pressure were of tremendous value, and Ruination grasped one before she turned towards Noah as if she was asking for permission!
And Noah nodded with a smile as around Ruination, dazzling crimson gold light bloomed.
A grandiose capability born within Ruination after she attained higher weavings of existence was utilized for the first time.
[The Feature of Randomized Existence Proliferation has been activated.]
|Randomized Existence Proliferation has been utilized on an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
Brilliant crimson gold light bathed the golden gem. But...
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful, resulting in the collapse of the Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
The unfathomably bright gold gem instantly lost its luster as moments later, it turned to ash!
A distance away, the Infiniverse Megalos Body raised her brows questioningly towards Ruination.
There were only 36 of them, and one had already perished.
Randomized Existential Proliferation.
Just what mysteries did it hold?
It wasn't a set multiplier.
Not by a factor of 2, 4, or even 10!
It was Randomized.
This was one of the terrifying gifts that Ruination currently held as even after failing the first time, her gaze didn't change as she moved to the next one.
|Randomized Existence Proliferation has been utilized on an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
The crimson gold light flashed once more.
This time, it did not turn dim!
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was successful, a factor of 10 being triggered and resulting in the emergence of 10 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities.]
An incandescent gold gem filled with heavy complexity instantly had 9 others appear beside it.
9 more!

It was a terrifying result that caused Noah's eyes to shine, while Ruination raised her head as her crimson hair fluttered brilliantly, gazing calmly towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body that remained calm while watching everything- looking like an unfettered celestial queen!
Thereafter, another wave of crimson gold radiance ensued as truly, results were not guaranteed.
|Randomized Existence Proliferation has been utilized on an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful, resulting in the collapse of the Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]

The third Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful as the complexity of this terrifying ability seemed to have a high chance of failure, but Ruination utilized it regardless because when there was success, the results could potentially be maddening.
But...
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful, resulting in the collapse of the Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful...]
The third, fourth, and fifth tries all ended with the bright golden gems collapsing, with only 31 left among the 36 original ones that Randomized Existence Proliferation could still be used on!

Noah watched on calmly as he didn't feel any pain from these three failures, and in the next instant, his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence trembled as it was faced with the emergence of a vast crimson gold sea of loot after another Randomized Existence Proliferation was utilized.
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was successful, a factor of 1,000 being triggered and resulting in the emergence of 1,000 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities.]
HUUM!
The surroundings of the Blancverse vibrated as instantly, hundreds of extremely heavy and complex Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities appeared! Hundreds!
To obtain them naturally, over a hundred Ordinance Amalgamation entities had to collapse.
And yet...

"Hmm..." Noah hummed happily at the results as under the allure of golden brilliance, he noticed the faint smile of achievement on Ruination that quickly faded as she returned to her seriousness, ignoring the flood of golden gems of complexity that emerged behind her as she simply reached out for the other Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities!
Such a shocking weaving unfolded as, at the same time, an Infiniverse Megalos Seed continued to bathe in the Higher Weavings of Existence, subtle changes beginning to unfold in the expanse.
Subtle changes.
Cause and effect.
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed came into the Expanse as its entry caused the appearance of the shocking phenomenon that drew in the gazes of a Daughter of Existence and her Attendants.
A conflict ensued due to greed- due to wanting something that wasn't theirs to begin with!
