The third Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful as the complexity of this terrifying ability seemed to have a high chance of failure, but Ruination utilized it regardless because when there was success, the results could potentially be maddening.
But...
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful, resulting in the collapse of the Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.]
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was unsuccessful...]
The third, fourth, and fifth tries all ended with the bright golden gems collapsing, with only 31 left among the 36 original ones that Randomized Existence Proliferation could still be used on!

Noah watched on calmly as he didn't feel any pain from these three failures, and in the next instant, his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence trembled as it was faced with the emergence of a vast crimson gold sea of loot after another Randomized Existence Proliferation was utilized.
[Randomized Existence Proliferation was successful, a factor of 1,000 being triggered and resulting in the emergence of 1,000 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities.]
HUUM!
The surroundings of the Blancverse vibrated as instantly, hundreds of extremely heavy and complex Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities appeared!
Hundreds!
To obtain them naturally, over a hundred Ordinance Amalgamation entities had to collapse.
And yet...

"Hmm..." Noah hummed happily at the results as under the allure of golden brilliance, he noticed the faint smile of achievement on Ruination that quickly faded as she returned to her seriousness, ignoring the flood of golden gems of complexity that emerged behind her as she simply reached out for the other Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities!
Such a shocking weaving unfolded as, at the same time, an Infiniverse Megalos Seed continued to bathe in the Higher Weavings of Existence, subtle changes beginning to unfold in the expanse.
Subtle changes.
Cause and effect.
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed came into the Expanse as its entry caused the appearance of the shocking phenomenon that drew in the gazes of a Daughter of Existence and her Attendants.
A conflict ensued due to greed- due to wanting something that wasn't theirs to begin with!

chapters.title: Chapter 3362 Dominoes II
paragraphs: But who would come across a Blancverse and observe that a mere Ordinance of Existence entity found it, and simply just wave goodbye and bid them good will?
Thus, causality continued to distort.
Terrifying power bloomed from the Infiniverse Megalos Body as the Daughter of Existence was wiped out along with her people!
One domino after another fell.
And after the latest domino fell, its reverberations stretched out really far.
Within the Expanse.
An extremely far, far distance compared to where a certain Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain was.
The countless golden strings of the Expanse flowed in complex manners, giving off a sensation of endlessness as they stretched out all around.
And yet in a certain region, these golden strings twisted and made way for a circular white domain the size of over a dozen Omniverses.
It was a Blancverse Domain.
It stood serenely and caused the golden strings to part ways for it, a white light covering it up entirely as what was within could not even be observed!

Behind this Blancverse Domain though, one could see an even more unique phenomenon that seemed to be overlayed with the Expanse itself- the appearance of a dazzling body of water that stretched out far too many light years.
Dazzling blue as if every drop was made from astral brilliance.
A Sea.
A Megalos Sea!
It radiated a shocking splendor of power while it stood behind the Blancverse Domain.
Within the depths of such a sea, blue waters filled with sparkling golden radiance flowed.
Inside its depths, in a small area where the sea tapered off its blue radiance and became more gold in color, the body of a massive creature slumbered.
HUUM!
At certain intervals, it seemed to be rhythmically breathing as its golden scales absorbed tendrils of complexity all around, shining ever so brighter with every passing second!
The massive body of water was all around him, and yet an invisible field seemed to exist around this massive body for miles that isolated even a single drop of water from touching it.
It seemed as if this being existed in their own weavings.
As if they were cut off and severed entirely from being affected by surrounding weavings of existence!
Existence Severing!
Such a being was slumbering within the depths of a Megalos Sea next to a Blancverse as in the next moment...
|Palace Master! Palace Master! Sentara...her Life Scale! Her Life Scale!|
A hurried voice filled with pain came out as a woman with a face filled with shocking beauty appeared- this face currently filled with pain that very few could emulate.
The pain of a mother losing something closest to them.
The woman looked towards the golden scaled entity that was isolated from the surrounding weavings of Existence, seeming frantic and hurt at the same time as golden tears fell around her.
|I know.|
WUU!
A deep voice carrying heavy brilliance boomed out before it continued.
|I just felt the power I left within her fade away. She is gone.|
The voice stated everything as if it were a matter of fact.
As if it was simply how things were!
The woman had a frantic expression as she ground her teeth while voicing out with Great pain.
|She is gone? She is gone?! Why do you speak of her as if she was nothing? That was your daughter too! That was your...|
Astral crimson gold tears fell down on the woman as her weavings of Ordinance Amalgamation trembled.
Before her, the massive golden scaled entity sighed as a bright light shone, a human figure appearing that looked towards the grieving woman with a calm gaze.

|She could not yet escape the confines of Existence, and Existence ground her down before she could manage to escape. Of course, I care. But there is nothing that can be done. In a moment here, I will know her cause of death as thereafter, I will do what I can to allow her to rest.|
His words carried age and power as if nothing could shake him.
His wisdom felt unfathomable as seeing his expression, the woman felt aggrieved as she shook her head.

|I told her. I told her she didn't need to prove herself. So what of the other Daughters and Sons of Existence? The Expanse is cruel! The Expanse does not care about a mere Ordinance Amalgamation Entity! And now...ah!|

The surrounding weavings of existence half as her manic state, and yet when her tendrils of power lashed out nearby, they broke into nothingness the moment they got near the Existence Severing Entity.

His gold hair flowed serenely as his bronze skin shone with light, his expression placid as his eyes flickered with brilliance at this moment, gazing to the left as there- illusory weavings began to manifest.
They showed the image when the power of Existence Severing was first triggered within the Daughter of Existence.

The illusory weavings showed the image of their daughter with her head cleanly sliced off, the scene causing the woman beside the Existence Severing entity to turn ashen as thereafter- the existence of their daughter reversed entirely.
And the culprit behind all of this showed herself!
The figure of a woman She was covered with hazy multicolored radiance as one couldn't truly see her face.
Looking at her, the Existence Severing Palace Master spoke succinctly.

|She is capable enough to veil her weavings, and the emergence of my residual power did not kill her. There are no other signatures of existence involved as she acted alone. Her alignment...should be that of Matter, but she does not fit the weavings of any other power. If we seek to right this wrong, I would have to set off myself...|
His words only caused the expression of the Concubine beside him to become hysterical as she screeched out.
|Set off! Set off! Right this wrong for our daughter!|
She wanted an avenue to release her hate.
But there seemed to be something holding the Existence Severing entity back as he sighed.
|What was it that even caused this conflict...|
As he sighed, he panned around the illusory weavings where his authority had erupted.
And thereafter, his calm eyes opened wide.
Because he saw the glimmer of a white space that isolated the strings of the Expanse itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3363 Dominoes III
paragraphs: |A Blancverse...|
The eyes of the golden haired Existence Severing Entity gained a dim luster as he found out the source of what causes events to unfold the way they did.
He could see the Blancverse and nothing else as seeing his pause, the Concubine beside him gained a sense of fervor and hope for retribution.
|Will you avenge our daughter now? You can obtain a Blancverse alongside vengeance!|
She wanted to set off right away. She wanted murder to be met with justice!
But...the man in front of her shook his head even as he continued to stare at the last illusory weavings his authority was privy to.

|Haste and unknown have led to the Calamities of even Existence Severing entities. If not careful, it matters not how talented or how powerful one is- they can always fall. It would do you good to remember this. Palace Master Bizmo, at the Existence Severing stage, perished half a cycle ago with nobody knowing why. The twin Sons of Existence under Palace Master Naku who were getting ready to sever their Existence perished to the forces of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse not too long ago. The Megalonians of cycles ago...over a hundred Existence Severing entities and countless others below them- dead. The blood of Megalonians even acted as the fuel for me to Sever my Existence, but where are they now? What vengeance and retribution can they seek now? If not careful, we may all end up in similar situations!|
WAA!
The face of the Concubine became ashen.
She breathed out slowly and kneeled down, even going as far as to have her dress fall off her body as she bowed her head down.
|Forgive me for my weaknesses, Palace Master. I merely seek retribution, however you choose to bring it.|
She gave herself completely as looking at her, the Palace Master couldn't help but sigh.

|Get up. I will consult with the other Palace Masters to send out an Immovable Sacred Legion being led by someone just slightly off Existence Severing. In this cycle and the cycles to come, you will find that very few Existence Severing Entities and those Pioneers above are roving about the Expanse anymore. Too many perilous things are unfolding as even Existence Severing entities can fall.|
The face of the Existence Severing Palace Master was grim and filled with somberness as he spoke- his surroundings feeling separated from him and cut off entirely!

|We know that a great change is coming. A change that nobody can escape as alongside it is great peril- especially for those with tremendous complexity. Thus, many of us choose to lie low. Unless absolutely necessary, we won't move. But the Expanse always has a way of pulling us out. The death of a daughter. The appearance of another Blancverse Domain. Anything and anything can arise from the Expanse and enact a pull as its countless strings remain ever so abstruse. So no, I will not personally move, but I will oversee the deployment of those who can bring back that Blancverse while avenging Sentara, okay?|
His expression softened in the end as he looked at this Concubine of his.
The gorgeous woman nodded as she wiped away her tears, her gaze burning with a vengeance as she thought of her late daughter!
Within a certain Blancverse Domain.
The illusions of a massive tree and mountain gradually began to fade after a significant time passed, unknown volumes of authority having been funneled into an Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
At this moment, the multicolored globe swirled slowly while radiating silent waves of complexity.
Outside of it, Noah's eyes were bright as he stared at a few 3,233 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities and over ten thousand Ordinance Hearthraes Singularities!
3,233 from the initial 36 Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities.
Over ten thousand Ordinance Hearthraes Singularities from 90!

This was the result of Ruination utilizing Randomized Existence Proliferation, with the highest randomized multiplier being 1,000 that was only triggered once for an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity.
Apart from the failures that led to the collapse of loot, other multipliers weren't as exaggerated, but the results were astounding regardless.
For the Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities, it was akin to the initial ones being multiplied by a factor of 100- and just relatively higher for the Ordinance Hearthraes Singularities.

After completing such a task, Ruination only nodded towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body before she disappeared into Noah's body once more- undoubtedly to continue whatever terrifying project she was working on in his Infinite Forge!

Noah grasped an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity in his hands as its brilliant light began to be absorbed by him, and he could very clearly sense the observable advancement of his complexity of existence that was evenly spread out across all Ordinances.
The weavings of a Constellation were extremely deep.
Noah was merely a Minor Constellation Entity as he hadn't even become a Greater Constellation nor Elder Constellation who would have entirely exceeded even Existence Severing.
His complexity was still far, far too long.
And to reach the distinction of a Greater Constellation, one such path was to undergo Ordinance Amalgamation.

This...he was in no way ready for due to his obscene number of Ordinances and the fact that this junction represented a time when the unfavorable result of a collapse of existence was a possible reality.
He couldn't jump on this path just yet as there were too many unknowns.

But there was no harm whatsoever in increasing his complexity as is- where he expected that even as a Minor Constellation, he could raise his Complexity to exceed even the common Greater Constellations who had undergone Amalgamation!
They raised their complexity through a single Ordinance and amalgamated with it.
He...had to raise the complexity of over a hundred Ordinances.
Make each one just as complex.
It was over 100 times more difficult.
He would require over a hundred times as many resources!

So these Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities and Ordinance Hearthraes Singularities were many after the Randomized Existence Proliferation, but they would be just enough to feed Noah who was akin to an inexhaustible black hole.
And even then, it would only be a fraction of what he needed for his Complexity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3364 Dominoes IV
paragraphs: It meant he had to find even more sources of Loot.
"Hmm..." A devilish smile bloomed on his face as he thought about a certain hairy spider he had marked- the first entity to discover him within his Blancverse Domain.
Naturally, he had to keep his promises.

He thought he would still be some ways off before he could confidently challenge an Ordinance Amalgamation entity, but with the advancement of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed- his strength had undergone a great change!
Around his body, faint illusions of Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltrees and Primordial Mountains of the Expanse flashed ever so often as he continued to devour the golden gems around him.

In the depths of his existence, Pyrhuss' obsession seemed to be dancing and reveling in the blood of its enemies as the descendants of those who massacred and devoured his people were getting the same treatment!
Carnage.
Violence.
This was what Pyrhuss sought.
In the very beginning, he had told Noah that he wasn't seeking justice!
Because where was the Justice in killing the descendants of entities responsible for actions cycles past?
It was Carnage by sheer association- along with the fact that such descendants chose to be enemies due to greed.
And if Noah understood anything regarding causality...
'Will the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse be on my tail now? Will the brother of this Daughter of Existence come for me? Then the Father, Forefather, and any ancestors behind them after that?'

Noah mused to himself as the only thing he could control was himself and his actions, his gaze going towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body at this moment when his mind veered towards a certain hairy spider.
"There's another enemy that is already marked- let's make our way towards him. Your transformation..."
||Is effectively done in the short term as I now quantify the extent of the changes apart from the Infiniverse Megalos Body. Everything is undergoing a thorough alteration.||
The changes already seemed immaculate as even more of them were being carried out!
All aspects of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed would get revamped, but the biggest change remained what this unbound complexity could do now compared to before.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body flashed with multicolored radiance and appeared in front of Noah, her eyes pulsing with waves of complexity as she continued.
||The strength of the Infiniverse Megalos Body had been affirmed, with the only remaining part of this test being its transference and usability.||
Noah smiled as an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity melted in his hands, thinking of the power wielded by the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
In the past, he could wield an Atlatl- a Spear that contained the very weight of the past versions of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
So what type of power could he wield now as its limitations became unbound and its complexity reached shocking heights?
The Infiniverse Megalos Body raised her hand as multicolored light swirled around it like a storm.

||The utilization, cost, and integration of authority between us have fundamentally changed. The complexity in power I displayed can theoretically fully be integrated with you and maintained for a low cost. Shall I start the Integration now, Master?||
The Infiniverse Megalos Body asked for permission.
Noah grabbed more Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities as he nodded, his eyes expectant of what was to come!

In the next moment, the hand flickering with swirling multicolored storms of complexity prompts on Noah's chest, a blinding light of integration blooming as extremely complex weavings of existence began to sink into his body.
They delved under his skin and wrapped around every cell within his body!
|A unique process of the integration of complexity with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed has begun.|
|The product of this process, distinguished as the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology, is now underway.|
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded between them.
The savage strength that the Infiniverse Megalos Body displayed to beat down 4 Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
Who said it would only be limited to her?!

Noah's eyes were luminous and filled with tyranny as he looked around, a large part of his authority erupting out as well as it wrapped around the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain- this domain only trembling slightly before in the next moment, it disappeared!
After all, he couldn't stay at the location where he had just slain 4 Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
The Blancverse, containing a terrifying Infiniverse Megalos Seed, crossed the Expanse as at this moment, the marker of a certain Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation Spider was being followed.
Within the endless stretches of the Expanse.
Thousands of eyes without pupils burned brightly- each one radiating a horrific obsidian brilliance that felt like it could devour everything.
They were attached to a massive silver furred spider that had over nine thousand spiked silver limbs emerging from its body.
Currently, these eyes held a hint of caution and they looked towards two Ordinance Amalgamation Entities beside it!

One was a massive gray Necrotic Nest-Slug, its body dripping with ectoplasm as appalling serpentine eyes appeared all over its body- the illusion of gray stellar bodies flickering in and out of existence all over it.
The other was a Nihilos Shelled Snail that had a pure white shell over its body that radiated an unbreakable light.
|Nobody ever lets go of an opportunity or shares it with others...why did you two pull me along?|
The intent of the Silver Furred Spider, The Ancient Phrike- Vujun, was a cautious one as it asked the two beside it.
The slimy skin of the Necrotic Nest-Slug vibrated as a feminine voice came out.
|Naturally, it is because we alone can't grab what's right in front of us. Putting both of our complexities together, we didn't manage to reach even miles near this wonder before us.|
Wonder.
What lay before them?
The Ancient Phrike took another look at the heart shaking body that was ten thousand miles long.
Its weavings of existence were dim and without a will, and there even seemed to be a process of decay starting!
And yet, its surroundings pulsed with storms of a shocking complexity that could wipe out weak Ordinance of Existence entities.
|It is the body of an entity that recently failed Existence Severing. Its will has collapsed as the rest of its body will follow, but if we can devour it...|
The eyes of the three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities blazed with brilliance!

sentences.text: It meant he had to find even more sources of Loot.
"Hmm..." A devilish smile bloomed on his face as he thought about a certain hairy spider he had marked- the first entity to discover him within his Blancverse Domain.
Naturally, he had to keep his promises.

He thought he would still be some ways off before he could confidently challenge an Ordinance Amalgamation entity, but with the advancement of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed- his strength had undergone a great change!
Around his body, faint illusions of Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltrees and Primordial Mountains of the Expanse flashed ever so often as he continued to devour the golden gems around him.

In the depths of his existence, Pyrhuss' obsession seemed to be dancing and reveling in the blood of its enemies as the descendants of those who massacred and devoured his people were getting the same treatment!
Carnage.
Violence.
This was what Pyrhuss sought.
In the very beginning, he had told Noah that he wasn't seeking justice!
Because where was the Justice in killing the descendants of entities responsible for actions cycles past?
It was Carnage by sheer association- along with the fact that such descendants chose to be enemies due to greed.
And if Noah understood anything regarding causality...
'Will the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse be on my tail now?
Will the brother of this Daughter of Existence come for me?
Then the Father, Forefather, and any ancestors behind them after that?'

Noah mused to himself as the only thing he could control was himself and his actions, his gaze going towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body at this moment when his mind veered towards a certain hairy spider.
"There's another enemy that is already marked- let's make our way towards him.
Your transformation..."
||Is effectively done in the short term as I now quantify the extent of the changes apart from the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
Everything is undergoing a thorough alteration.||
The changes already seemed immaculate as even more of them were being carried out!
All aspects of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed would get revamped, but the biggest change remained what this unbound complexity could do now compared to before.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body flashed with multicolored radiance and appeared in front of Noah, her eyes pulsing with waves of complexity as she continued.
||The strength of the Infiniverse Megalos Body had been affirmed, with the only remaining part of this test being its transference and usability.||
Noah smiled as an Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularity melted in his hands, thinking of the power wielded by the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
In the past, he could wield an Atlatl- a Spear that contained the very weight of the past versions of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
So what type of power could he wield now as its limitations became unbound and its complexity reached shocking heights?
The Infiniverse Megalos Body raised her hand as multicolored light swirled around it like a storm.
||The utilization, cost, and integration of authority between us have fundamentally changed.
The complexity in power I displayed can theoretically fully be integrated with you and maintained for a low cost.
Shall I start the Integration now, Master?||
The Infiniverse Megalos Body asked for permission.
Noah grabbed more Amalgamation Hearthraes Singularities as he nodded, his eyes expectant of what was to come!

In the next moment, the hand flickering with swirling multicolored storms of complexity prompts on Noah's chest, a blinding light of integration blooming as extremely complex weavings of existence began to sink into his body.
They delved under his skin and wrapped around every cell within his body!
|A unique process of the integration of complexity with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed has begun.|
|The product of this process, distinguished as the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology, is now underway.|
HUUM!
Brilliance unfolded between them.
The savage strength that the Infiniverse Megalos Body displayed to beat down 4 Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
Who said it would only be limited to her?!

Noah's eyes were luminous and filled with tyranny as he looked around, a large part of his authority erupting out as well as it wrapped around the Inviolable Sacred Blancverse Domain- this domain only trembling slightly before in the next moment, it disappeared!
After all, he couldn't stay at the location where he had just slain 4 Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
The Blancverse, containing a terrifying Infiniverse Megalos Seed, crossed the Expanse as at this moment, the marker of a certain Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation Spider was being followed.
Within the endless stretches of the Expanse.
Thousands of eyes without pupils burned brightly- each one radiating a horrific obsidian brilliance that felt like it could devour everything.
They were attached to a massive silver furred spider that had over nine thousand spiked silver limbs emerging from its body.
Currently, these eyes held a hint of caution and they looked towards two Ordinance Amalgamation Entities beside it!

One was a massive gray Necrotic Nest-Slug, its body dripping with ectoplasm as appalling serpentine eyes appeared all over its body- the illusion of gray stellar bodies flickering in and out of existence all over it.
The other was a Nihilos Shelled Snail that had a pure white shell over its body that radiated an unbreakable light.
|Nobody ever lets go of an opportunity or shares it with others...why did you two pull me along?|
The intent of the Silver Furred Spider, The Ancient Phrike- Vujun, was a cautious one as it asked the two beside it.
The slimy skin of the Necrotic Nest-Slug vibrated as a feminine voice came out.
|Naturally, it is because we alone can't grab what's right in front of us.
Putting both of our complexities together, we didn't manage to reach even miles near this wonder before us.|
Wonder.
What lay before them?
The Ancient Phrike took another look at the heart shaking body that was ten thousand miles long.
Its weavings of existence were dim and without a will, and there even seemed to be a process of decay starting!
And yet, its surroundings pulsed with storms of a shocking complexity that could wipe out weak Ordinance of Existence entities.
|It is the body of an entity that recently failed Existence Severing.
Its will has collapsed as the rest of its body will follow, but if we can devour it...|
The eyes of the three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities blazed with brilliance!

chapters.title: Chapter 3365 Corpse! I
paragraphs: A body that was ten thousand miles long!
It looked slender with tout muscles, its skin gray and cracking as the head showed long white hair and pointed ears.
The corpse floated in the Expanse with its eyes entirely dimmed, but one could see an expression of defiance and resignation written on the face of this being even in death.
It's eyes.
The pupils were cracked and splintered as all they left behind were residues of what this being used to be.
This was the body of an entity that had failed Existence Severing!
The Ancient Phrike, Vujun, became contemplative as he looked at it.
|Its alignment is matter, but...look at its expression.|
He couldn't help but observe that gaze of defiance.
That look of a being that had strove for success and toiled away for who knew how many cycles
|Even in its collapse of existence, it was defiant. And yet it still could Sever its Existence. What happens when we arrive at such a point ourselves? If we face the collapse of our own Existence?|
The Nihilos Shelled Snail and the Necrotic Nest-Slug looked at each other in silence before the eyes of the slug-like entity flickered with brightness.

|What the fuck, Vujun? We invited you here just to combine our complexities and get near this body to devour it. Why the hell are you becoming a philosopher? Worry about your own Existence Severing when you get to it. You have even fewer worries than us being connected to that honored personage.|
The voice flickered with emotion towards the end as the many eyes of Vujun blinked as he nodded.
|Let's go.|
Their bodies flickered with heavy radiance as the light of chilling banners wrapped around them seamlessly, staying close together as they shot towards the floating body!
HUUM!
The moment they even came close, crescent waves of a terrifying authority lashed out towards them- an authority that did not want its owner to verify desecrated even in death.
It radiated a verdant allure as it was the Ordinance of Vitality.
It still brimmed within the corpses that had tried to sever itself away from Existence- where even though it failed, this Vitality was still potent enough to hang on until now!
BOOM!
It smashed onto the bodies of the three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities as they withstood it easily from this distance.
But the closer they went to the corpses.
CAAA!
The more verdant storms erupted and struck out against them, but they withstood and made their way over slowly!
Around this same time.
Many light years away, a distance of about one Omniverse.
A white space silently flickered into existence.
Within it, a man floated in a meditative position while the figure of a multicolored woman was finishing an infusion of a shocking process, her hand having moved from his chest and on his back.
When one took a closer look, one could see the very reality surrounding this man vibrating as his skin rumbled and roiled as if giant snakes were coursing underneath!
An unfathomable crimson gold radiance flashed over his skin as it seemed like quintillions of sheets of singularities were stacked on top of each other to reinforce it.
Colorless gold wings stretched out behind his back as the feathers made of pure colorless gold light seemed to be sharper than the blade of a common Ordinance Amalgamation entity.
Golden tattoo like bands covered his body, the largest one being on his chest as it seemed to hold within it the reserves of endless weight and tonnage.
At this moment.
|The Infiniverse Megalos Physiology has attained a state of awakening within your weavings of Existence.|
A prompt flashed over Noah's eyes.
Behind him, the Infiniverse Megalos Body released her hands from his back as her tremendous eyes stared at him- and within their depths, one could almost see a flash of pride.
Almost.
Feeling the unique complexity coursing within his body, Noah moved from the meditative position and stood up as this simple motion...
HUUM!
Caused the surrounding space to tremble.
As if something far too heavy was moving about!
"Hmm..." He raised his hand and clenched his fist as he felt the equivalent force of millions of singularities imploding just from the motion of his fingers.
It was all purely a complexity of his Physiology as even he felt extremely heavy, as if every step to take would be effortful!
But once he acclimated and was able to move freely...he could easily wield this tonnage of complexity that was the equivalent of the complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

||Any force you apply is now equivalent to the Infiniverse Extremity Vein, the Infiniverse Aletheian Havens surrounding it, and the vast complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself. Its advancement in complexity has allowed you to utilize it for a fraction of the previous cost, to the extent that only a tenth of your reserves of authority will be kept at bay to manage the utilization of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology.||
The Infiniverse Megalos Body released its intent and looked over Noah up and down as if she was looking at a weapon born from an unfathomable Forge.

Before, Noah could only borrow the strength and weight of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed at a high cost and only utilize it a few times, but its jump in complexity to become a Constellation now made it possible for him to utilize its sheer tonnage and complexity constantly, at a cost he could bear with ease!
The higher up in complexity one became, the simpler things seemed for them.
As he felt the complexity and weight of the power coursing through him, he knew he had to get acclimated to it as wondrously enough, there were targets not too far from here!
He came for the Ancient Phrike, Vujun, and yet this spider did not seem to be alone as alongside it, there were two other Anti-Matter entities!
Their power was not small as the moment that Noah appeared even a distance of an Omniverse away, he saw them, and they saw him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3366 Corpse! II
paragraphs: The two sides saw each other as not just that, Noah also observed the ten thousand miles long corpse that they were going towards!
"Oh?"
His eyes lit up brightly as he sensed the shocking aura of this corpse- and the weavings of collapse that covered its whole existence.

Above him, a golden eye opened up as he found that wondrously, due to his new Infiniverse Megalos Physiology, his eyes seemed to hold even greater weavings of complexity as well as it seemed like a massive gate was flung open when its lids emerged!
And its gaze landed on the massive corpse in the far distance.

[Corpse of Vital Fist Emperor- Taran]:: State of Existence- Failed Existence Severing. Source of Existence- Omniseed. Lifespan- 125 Megalos Cycle/126 Megalos Cycles. Records of Weavings- The corpse of an entity that felt the end of its lifespan nearing and took the gamble to Sever their Existence and change its fate. The gamble was unsuccessful as their complexity of existence was not sufficient enough, and their Weavings have entered a state of decay and collapse. Within their weavings, their amalgamated Ordinance has since then bloomed an obsession, releasing the wonders it has remaining in it to pull in any Entities that it can devour the life cycles of- a capability that the Ordinance of Vitality only glimpsed past the gate of Existence Severing. Any creature that seeks to devour the body of the Vital Fist Emperor will instead find themselves ensnared by an ordinance with an obsession that instantly absorbs their weavings of existence, rapidly depleting their lifespans in an effort to resurrect the weavings of the Vital Fist Emperor himself...
Noah's eyes vibrated with power and astonishment at such a description as it seemed that this corpse with his very weavings collapsing was still so dangerous!
It showed that any entity that had lived for enough cycles could potentially hold extremely dangerous capabilities- even as they died.
The issue here stemmed from the obsession of the Ordinance of Vitality that this being had amalgamated with.
"An obsession..." Noah's eyes radiated a luminous light as he thought of this word.
Pyrrhus died, and he also bore an obsession that made shocking things possible.

This entity who failed Existence Severing had his own Ordinance develop an obsession after it glimpsed a shocking ability had it managed to Sever Existence- the ability to devour the lifespans of others!
It was a ridiculous turn of events as it also made Noah think of the Omnifather.
How had that being survived the failed Severing of his Existence and attain the power that he did?
No answer presented itself as Noah refocused on the corpse in the distance looking for a target.
And now, three Anti-Matter entities were ensnared.
A potentially dangerous situation unfolded as in front of it...Noah did not back down!
He had to grasp the extent of complexity he could now unleash with the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology anyways.
A distance away.
The bodies of three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities were now only a single mile away from the corpse as it seemed like a grand prize was right before them.

And yet their expanded senses that could cover the equivalent length of a few omniverses observed the appearance of a Blancverse veiled with dazzling white brilliance- with the visage of a devilishly handsome man and a woman with a cold expression that could cause one trepidation being seen within.
Their expressions instantly soured with shock.
Any new entrants here complicated things greatly, and they were alarmed and shocked to see a moving Blancverse with these new entrants!
But...
|Him?!| The Ancient Phrike was even more shocked than the other two as he recognized the being in the far distance and his Blancverse.
The other two instantly honed in.
|Vujun, you know this entity?! You invited someone else?!|
Suspicion ran rampant among those in their stages as Vujun shook his limbs to deny while replying.

|No, he is an Ordinance of Existence entity who was lucky enough to bind a Blancverse. He is somehow able to displace it with his flimsy power as when he left, he made the threat that he would find me. But I never thought he would actually be stupid enough to do so...|

Confusion and caution were apparently in the eyes of Vujun as in the next moment, such confusion became amazed shock as Vujun and the two other Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities saw...the body of this being flickered and actually came out of the Blancverse Domain.
An Ordinance of Existence entity, in front of three Ordinance Amalgamation Entities, actually left their protective domain and came out?!
The three entities looked at each other with shock and elation as in the next moment...
BOOM!
The bodies unfurled with waves of brilliant Ordinances.

A silver light erupted from Vujun and shot out to cover the distance of one Omniverse in an instant, appearing right above Noah as it sought to take this chance to kill and make the Blancverse owner less!
He wasn't the only one as from the Necrotic Nest-Slug and the Nihilos Shelled Snail, extremely sharp Obsidian and White lights also shot out to arrive in sequence.
Entities at their stage held tremendous power as they could exert the influence of their ordinance extremely far away.
So at this moment, three blazing Ordinances seeking to impose their weavings on Existence descended towards Noah.
His head was raised as he looked at them.
The silver light alone was filled with the heavy complexity of Annihilare- seeking to impose utmost decimation on anything it touched.
This level of complexity would cause Noah to normally release multiple of his Ordinances- and he estimated maybe a few dozen of them all at once, to be able to deny its imposition!
Normally.
But now...
SAA!
He raised his hand up and grasped onto the descending light of decimation.
BOOM!
It struck down like the cataclysm of multiple Omniverses, and yet when it smashed into Noah's hand, it was as if it struck an Inviolable diamond.
He grasped the authority of the ordinance in his hands as when he clenched his fist, it became dispersed in a shower of silver brilliance!
As for the two other authorities of Ordinances that came down after...
BOOM! BOOM!

He allowed them to hit his body as wondrously, as if there was an unshakable layer of defense over his skin- the brilliance of these authorities only hit and dispersed into flickers of radiance afterwards!
The Ordinance Amalgamation entities in the distance stopped in place and looked at such a scene in a stupor.
This...was an Ordinance of Existence entity, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 3367 Dominance! I
paragraphs: Near the corpse of an entity that failed to sever their Existence, three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities watched with incredulity as the imposition of their Ordinances...were withstood and dispersed by the body of their target alone!
Withstood.
Dispersed.
For any such actions to occur, the complexity of the other side had to be that much more complex.
The Nihilos Shelled Snail felt its shell vibrating at such a reality as it roared out towards Vujun.
|You fucking donkey, that's an Ordinance of Existence entity? What the fuc-|
HUUM!
In the far distance, the entity they couldn't even fathom took a step.
A single step.
And the weavings of all three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation Entities buzzed as they felt his savage aura bloomed meters away from them an instant later.
He crossed the vast distances equivalent to an Omniverse in such a short period of time as he appeared, quite literally, right before them!
A grave sense of danger befell these powerful entities.
They had seen many things.
They had lived for many cycles.
They heard stories time and time again of oddities observed across the Expanse that did not conform to common sense, and many had fallen prey to this.
Ordinance Amalgamation Entities have fallen to such oddities, and even Existence Severing entities have fallen every now and then!
So when these three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities experienced the ridiculous entity that they dubbed an oddity before them...
BOOM!
|We have no qualms with you!|
|Your enmity is with Vujun, we will not interfere!|

The bodies of the Nihilos Shelled Snail and the Necrotic Nest-Slug erupted with graying mushroom pores and clouds of smoke as they distanced themselves rapidly, even moving away from the treasured corpses they all came here to devour.
They valued their lives far too much as, after living for so many cycles, they knew that their existence was paramount before anything else.
Pride? What the hell could they do with that?
Shame? Did it allow one to increase in complexity?
Friendship? This wasn't a fairy tale where the power of friendship was all that was required to overcome an exceedingly overpowered force.

The Necrotic Nest-Slug even threw Vujun under the bus as the Ancient Phrike looked towards them with maddened rage, his many eyes twisting as he didn't even probe the enemy he definitely knew to be an Ordinance Amalgamation entity, and he instead took another risk as he burst force with silver brilliance to get even closer to the Corpse before them!
If it could devour the remnant weavings of Existence of an entity that had almost severed their existence...there would be many more pathways before it.
Thus, three entities made their choices.
And the enemy they faced, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, had also made his!
His visage was a pondering one as he sensed all the complex changes around him.
How many intricate ways could the power of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology be used?
It could be used as brute force like he did before, to overcome Ordinances due to its sheer complexity.
But Noah felt like it was far too unique to only be applied this way as he felt like its complexity could also be channeled elsewhere.
He felt it.
And so he did it.
At this moment, Noah tested many things as he utilized the terrifying complexity of tonnage and weight of this Physiology, and applied it towards the Ordinance of Gravitation.
Just Gravitation.
The application of the Complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology through a concept.
BOOM!

Terrifying stellar purple waves erupted around him as instantly, the Ancient Phrike, Vujun, who was infinitely close to the corpse before him...felt a terrifying and undeniable force pull on his body and fling him away.

The Necrotic Nest-Slug and the Nihilos Shelled Snail roared out as while moving away, they suddenly felt a terrifying force pull them back as waves of unknown gravity began to spin them through a chaotic sequence of rotations!
Even the massive corpse of the Vital Fist Emperor began to buzz as it also began to slowly rotate.
The three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities were initially dismayed at such a scene as Vujun roared out, a terrifying amount of authority being released by him at this moment.
|Annihilare's Boundless Favor.|
Silver brilliance bloomed.
All around, decayed silver strings began to defend as they carried with them the authority to annihilate anything they touched.
It was the imposition of the Ordinance of Annihilare in its true sense, and-
|Huh?|
The many eyes of Vujun buzzed as he saw the silver strings coming down to impose his Ordinance tremble before they were cut up and ground down by the already existing waves of gravity all around.
His Ordinance...failed to establish its complexity against an already existing Ordinance.
For this to happen, the other Ordinance had to have much greater levels of Complexity!
And if this entity truly was of the Ordinance of Existence level, how could that be possible?!

Vujun's Ordinance could not be established, and the Necrotic Nest-Slug and the Nihilos Shelled Snail also realized the same thing as the terrifying complexity of the gravity currently spinning them around without their permission left them helpless to do anything.
What was the change of existence based on one's Ordinance?
What was the imposition and change of the very rulings of the surrounding reality based on one's own concept?
This was it!
A single entity laid down his rule of law, and nobody else could erase it or deny it!
Such a reality was one that rarely played out unless the two sides were truly on different landscapes of complexity entirely.

Their differences in the compositions of their existence- whether Matter or Anti-Matter, did not hold importance at this moment precisely due to the sheer gap in complexity granted by the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology.
The complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that rose from the Megalos Ynnere and into the Expanse!

A sense of awe and trepidation blazed from the product of such a wonder as at this moment, a single entity stood at the center of heavy waves of gravity that scrambled even Ordinance Amalgamation entities!

For any such actions to occur, the complexity of the other side had to be that much more complex.
The Nihilos Shelled Snail felt its shell vibrating at such a reality as it roared out towards Vujun.
|You fucking donkey, that's an Ordinance of Existence entity?
What the fuc-|
HUUM!
In the far distance, the entity they couldn't even fathom took a step.
A single step.
And the weavings of all three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation Entities buzzed as they felt his savage aura bloomed meters away from them an instant later.
He crossed the vast distances equivalent to an Omniverse in such a short period of time as he appeared, quite literally, right before them!
A grave sense of danger befell these powerful entities.
They had seen many things.
They had lived for many cycles.
They heard stories time and time again of oddities observed across the Expanse that did not conform to common sense, and many had fallen prey to this.
Ordinance Amalgamation Entities have fallen to such oddities, and even Existence Severing entities have fallen every now and then!

BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3368 Dominance! II
paragraphs: It was a scene that even Noah had not expected to bloom so quickly.
With over a hundred Ordinances, he felt like he could stand against Ordinance Amalgamation entities.
But he didn't feel like he could thrash them as he was currently doing with these Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities!
"Come!"

He motioned towards the Nihilos Shelled Snail that had now retracted its whole body into its shell, terrifying mechanisms being put in place as an ancient air leaked from it- an intent now choosing to cover itself entirely if it couldn't do anything to the surrounding existence, it would at least be able to reinforce its amalgamated body!
All of its complexity.
All of its cycles of brilliance.
It all gathered within its shell as its ancient eyes dimly observed from within.
It analyzed the terrifying strength this new enemy released as in an effort to overturn it, its gray eyes pulsed as its intent began to weave out.
|Friend, a fight to the death is not always the only solution in the Expanse! I have knowledge, I have my existence, I can trade even my allegianc-|
BOOM-CRACK!
Its Nihilos Shell.
Everything that it had built its Ordinance into- the culmination of cycles of its achievements!
It fractured and broke at this time as a blindingly bright fist came through, its snail-like eyes shaking as it felt a shocking level of complexity descend into its existence!
First, it felt completely suppression.
Then, the heavy weight that it's weavings of existence could not bear whatsoever cascaded down as they extinguished anything about it, its records, its weavings!
BOOM!
It was only a small fist, and yet the weight it carried was enough to collapse every molecule of work it had put in these dozens of cycles!
Its intent watched in silent horror as its weavings dimmed rapidly, all the way to the extent that it could no longer think, and infinite darkness came.
A horrific gravity continued to spin their bodies in defiance of their own wishes as Vujun and the Necrotic Nest-Slug saw the weavings of their compatriot collapse with a single punch.

The visage of Noah was surrounded by golden radiance as his fist retracted, his gaze going towards them as they felt a rising chill that told them this was the same fate waiting for them if nothing changed!
Vujun's eyes twisted into terrifying slits at this as above him, a terrifying Eye of Existence opened.
It radiated a shocking silver radiance as at this moment, trillions of webs seemed to sprout from it as this Ancient Phrike bent its legs down, its ancient voice echoing out.
|Save me, O Great Mother.|

Noah's eyes became stern at such words as he looked towards the forming eyes and the trillions of spider webs that seemed to be blooming within it- the pressure of Gravitation being focused by him to press down and crush this forming complexity called out by Vujun!
Great Mother?
Megalos Nihilos had someone with a similar distinction to the Great Mother of the Megalos Ynnere?
And why did it seem like almost every Ordinance Amalgamation entity had a backer they could either call for or were already protected by?!
The Daughter of Existence had the remnant authority of an Existence Severing entity that protected her, and now...
WUU!
An ancient cry emerged from the Eye of Existence that Vujun conjured as it resisted Noah's complex pressure, trillions of webs sprouting out as from this Eye, a will that wasn't Vujun's emerged.
A will that seemed to be gazing at everything through this terrifying eye as an utterly apocalyptic pressure leaked out of it.
Noah became unfathomably serious at such an eye that seemed to quickly gaze over everything before it locked onto him.
It was a pupil that seemed to be made out of endless layers of webs.
It instantly caused the massive body of Vujun to no longer be affected by the shocking complexity of gravitation all around, its massive body coming to a halt as if anchored in space.
It gazed at him coldly before an intent leaked out from it.
|How about you stop here? You will earn a favor from the Great Mother Weaver of Nihilos for sparing one of her children.|
The voice was feminine in nature and filled with shocking poison and beauty.
The Great Mother Weaver of Nihilos!
Noah was firm even against such a voice and identity as he couldn't help but smack his lips.

He had met a bit over 7 Ordinance Amalgamation entities in the Expanse, and two of them managed to either have the aid of a big boss far more powerful protecting them, or they could call upon one to come to their aid.
Meanwhile, which big boss did he have to call for help in case a truly terrifying enemy appeared?!
He glanced towards the distant Blancverse and the visage of the Infiniverse Megalos Body that was watching coldly within as he shook his head with a smile.
There was no one to rely on but himself and the tools he had on hand!
BOOM!
His body erupted with complexity as he parted towards the massive body of Vujun, utterly ignoring the terrifying authority that had made its brief entry here.
|What a foolish course of action. Have I been low-key for too long in the Expanse that my name is ignored like this?|
The cold voice erupted out with malice and power as, shockingly, the limbs of Vujun began to shrivel as his complexity greatly reduced.
As this occurred, a terrifying power gathered on the eye filled with webs as it seemed like to make a move against someone else through this method, Vujun had to pay a great cost!
But if it could save his life, it was a cost he could bear.
If it could save his life.
HUUM!
Noah's body flickered with radiance as around him, over 100 Ordinances unfurled with multicolored radiance.
And the weight and complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology was then infused unto all of these ordinances as he shot forth like an undeniable Constellation!

chapters.title: Chapter 3369 Brilliance Across the Megalos! I
paragraphs: An eye filled with countless layers of webs emanated a shocking intent, borrowing from the complexity of Vujun himself as a horrific gray flower made up of trillions of webs bloomed!
The moment this flower appeared, all of the surrounding weavings of existence dimmed as the golden light of the Expanse itself felt a little less brighter.
The flower felt demonic and filled with malice as it had a devilish face filled with countless eyes, and it radiated a chaotic light as it smashed towards Noah!
He blazed with multicolored radiance.
The complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology was applied equally to all Ordinances!
All of this power went towards the impact against the heavy cost that the Ancient Phrike, Vujun, bore to have a sliver of the Great Mother Weaver make a move.
The impact was a silent one.

This area of the expanse vibrated intently as against the clash of maddening gray brilliance and multicolored radiance, an inestimable force emerged between both sides were flung back for thousands of light years!
A flower had its petals dissipate one by one as its devilish glare stared out light years away, the body of Vujun shriveling up noticeably as above him, an eye began to close.
Before it did, it turned down to observe the weary Vujun and released an intent.
|Run as far as you can, and you may still have hope of survival. He should be near death and not capable of chasing after yo-...!|
The gradually closing eye of the terrifying entity reflected a sharp light while looking ahead as shockingly, from the direction Noah was flung to, his figure reappeared grandly.
His body had cracks as stellar gold blood flowed calmly like astral lava, his right hand missing all the components of skin and muscle as only a shattered multicolored skeleton could be seen!
Yet his face retained its coldness and regality as around him, the vibrant Ordinance of Genesis was already blooming.
Life and Vitalis were burning brightly!
Infinity, among others, blazed with radiance as his unfathomably tough body...was healing and regenerating in real time.
His gaze carried unbound tyranny as even in the face of this terrifying Entity, his voice echoed out.
"No, Great Mother, I am not near death."
"And I am afraid to say that one of your children has arrived at the end of their journey."
HUUM!
As his body healed, the wings behind him shone.
Invictus Maximus.
For the first time, the terrifying complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology was applied to his wings as he voiced out like an ancient Emperor passing forth a decree.
"Fatality."
Causality trembled.
The fate of The Ancient Phrike, Vujun, was already set in stone as at this moment, Noah only finalized it!
"Matter Immolation."

His voice carried heavy weight and coldness as the body of Vujun trembled with rage and terror, feeling the very fundamental makeup of his existence beginning to burn and explode as very quickly, all parts of his existence were aflame with silver radiance.
His makeup itself was immolating as above him, the closing eye gazed towards Noah coldly.
|I won't forget this. I won't forget you.|
A heavy threat, especially from an Entity that may be cemented at the stage of Existence Severing!
And yet against it, Noah only shook his head while he turned around to the only remaining Ordinance Amalgamation entity here who was still bound down by his gravitation.
The Necrotic Nest-Slug.
Noah began floating towards it as he replied to the blatant threat of the Great Mother Weaver without looking back.
"You, like many others that have made threats against me before, will definitely come to forget me. After all, when your weavings collapse, what more can you remember?"
Blatant disrespect flowed out from him as the sliver of the Great Mother Weaver within the eye crumbled while beginning to pulse with rage!
As Noah floated towards the Necrotic Nest-Slug, its slimy body trembled as its intent echoed out.
|Hold on, please. Just...!|
Actual fear arose in the heart of an Ordinance Amalgamation entity in a region of the Expanse as Noah blared his brilliance heavily!
But he didn't just express such brilliance here.
Far from here, within the weavings of a Tresorverse, another body of his sat on one of three thrones that would decide the ownership of Origin Tresoverse Towers of Existence.
Above him, a singularity continued to extinguish as the other Ordinance of Existence entities could no longer stay still- throwing attacks towards all three thrones!
The Viceroy of the Commonwealth was surrounded by Protectors as he had others to defend for him, his own power not even needing to be put to use!
The unknown entity that looked exceedingly young on the other throne had a stern expression, his Ordinance erupting out to reject any others that sought to impose themselves unto him.
And then, there was Noah.
At this moment, he didn't radiate any shocking allure of even a single Ordinance as he simply sat on the throne.
Above him, one Ordinance after another flickered.
Kuklos.
Light. Death.
Fire.
Fate.
One after another, powerful entities shot them out in order to knock him from the throne he sat on!
And yet...
BZZT!
Every single Ordinance striking down fizzled the moment it came inches away from his body, with him not even making an active effort to defend whatsoever.
It was simply that his complexity was too far above what any of them could compare to.
This included Antediluvian Leviathans, Protectors, and other assorted races and Lineages of Entities that had attained the stage of the Ordinance of Existence here!
Seeing Noah's absolutely unbothered look as nothing phased him, the many entities here turned their attention towards the other two thrones while expressing their shock and dismay.
As for Noah himself, he only turned his head above to stare at the fading singularity that was nearly extinguished.
With its disappearance, he would gain access to a Modus Operandi that promised a great deal of things regarding complexity!

This included Antediluvian Leviathans, Protectors, and other assorted races and Lineages of Entities that had attained the stage of the Ordinance of Existence here!
Seeing Noah's absolutely unbothered look as nothing phased him, the many entities here turned their attention towards the other two thrones while expressing their shock and dismay.
As for Noah himself, he only turned his head above to stare at the fading singularity that was nearly extinguished.
With its disappearance, he would gain access to a Modus Operandi that promised a great deal of things regarding complexity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3370 Brilliance Across the Megalos! II
paragraphs: As his brilliance shone in the Expanse and in the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather, another one of his bodies stood within a vessel that crossed the Megalos Ynnere.
Beside him, the figure of Command Protector Valeria continued to turn to him every few seconds with a gaze of doubt as she couldn't help but ask.
|We are really going to face the Outerversal Morphon behind all this right now? The Great Ponderor?|
She asked as it truly didn't seem real.
They were able to take down a weak body of Savitar, but all other Outerversal Morphons, especially the Great Ponderor, they knew very little of and was extremely dangerous!
Her power that was just grasping the Eye of Existence would likely not be able to do much as all three reliance would be on him.
And he gave a light smile in reply.

"Yes. I've already nuked his homes as he has made the choice to gather all forces in one place in the Megalos Ynnere. He can't bring himself to cut off his reach here entirely due to me, as he is likely plotting to get help from others or a myriad of other means. But at the end of the day, no schemes will make up for sheer strength."
WAA!
His words vibrated with confidence as Command Protector Valeria couldn't deny them!
She could only listen and choose to believe for the sake of her sister.
And as they neared whatever location Noah was bringing them towards, he said one last thing.
"I do this only to wrap up what I've started. After that, I will leave as you can make the choice of staying as Protectors of the Commonwealth, or follow me."
Words that caused the face of Command Protector Valeria to flicker in shock echoed out as she had a strong reaction to them, but before she could even relay her shock...
"We are here."
The Omniversal Voyager slowed down as it neared an Omniverse.
Not tainted.
Not even half-tainted.
Just a normal Omniverse.
The location where the Great Ponderor retreated with all of his forces as he planned his next course of action after all his Tainted Omniverses were wiped away!
Noah was still a terrifying distance away, but his body released a golden flicker of sandy gold light that silently went on to cover a distance equivalent to three Omniverses.
It was to ensure that today, nobody would be able to even leave this perimeter.
It was time to begin the dissadulation of the one who actually made himself an enemy of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian and thought he could scheme freely behind the scenes!
As for how Noah had located this hiding spot of the Great Ponderor?

There was a body of this entity within a certain Pantheon of Umbra in the Megalos Beyond that Ozymandias could observe freely this whole time, and with the rise in complexity...many more droves of information were capable of being obtained.
The rise in complexity of Ozymandias.
This alone caused an unfathomable brilliance to bloom across the Megalos Beyond as Ozymandias...had a direct link to the Infiniverse Megalos Body!
Within the Megalos Beyond.
The Pantheon of Umbra!

Ozymandias sat amidst throes of eldritch horrors as his terrifying banner had covered Umbra and even stretched out beyond it when he declared his Ordinance, and he had the resurgence of the Great Mother and the Observer of Old and Young appear once more as they joined the Great Wheel with their heavy support of the Instrument of the Beyonder!

Little Aspasia sat by the side calmly as the tentacles of the Great Mother in the form of an infinity symbol wriggled while relaying an intent of great expectations for Ozymandias. |O Instrument of the Beyonder, you may have not begun traversing the Expanse since you just declared your Ordinance...but I have a possible path for us to take to quickly wade across the Megalos Beyond onto the Pantheons holding the Crucibles of the Beyonder. Without being delayed or battling Heretics who do not wish to see you succeed. We can traverse the Megalos Beyond...through the Expanse.|
Her intent was a ridiculous one as it caused the Great Wheel and the Observer of Old and Young to almost scoff.

Enter the Expanse in one area of the Megalos Beyond, and traverse across the Expanse and make an exit in another area that would grant you an exit in an entirely different space within the Megalos you were in!

|I am confident in this, O Instrument, and in this manner, you can even observe one of our bases in the Expanse- where Outerversal Morphons from countless cycles past have made their home as they wade through that endless land of weavings. You will get to see the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse where Outerversal Morphons who have transcended their Existence occupy.|
A grandiose plan was laid out as beside the Great Mother, the Observer of Old and Young couldn't help but interject.

|Is it not too hasty? He has just declared his Ordinance as his complexity should have reached a level for him to transcend his existence and enter the Expanse, but...it has only been days since his birth. This...|
They had been alive for cycles.
Thousands of years could pass from a deep slumber for them.
Moving so rapidly in just a matter of days...
At such an intent, the tentacles of the Great Mother wriggled in a smile as she looked towards Ozymandias.

|What say you, Instrument of the Beyonder? Are you able to make the jump into the Expanse with your current complexity? I will even provide you with a marker that will draw you towards where my body is there.|
The Great Mother held tremendous confidence in the Instrument of the Beyonder.
For him to be able to enact change across the Megalos Beyond, he had to be exceptional.
He had to confound and amaze them!

Were to be merely a genius Outerversal Morphon or a distinguished Great One like them, would he be able to achieve anything? There were many Great Ones, yet none of them could say that they could change the whole Megalos Beyond!
The Great Mother looked at Ozymandias expectantly.

And Ozymandias felt the trembling connection with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that just waited to be unleashed and course through his unfathomable brilliance, the singularities within his eyes beginning to ebb with a golden light as he replied nonchalantly.
"Merely an entrance into the Expanse, nothing major."

chapters.title: Chapter 3371 Brilliance Across the Megalos! III
paragraphs: Merely.
Ozymandias spoke with such confidence that the Outerversal Morphons listening to it felt a thrill course through them.
This was especially so for the Great Mother who fanatically believed in the Great Behonder!
|Haha, then let us do it. If you ascend from here, I will cover this area with a marker that will pull you toward my location in the Expanse.|
She continued to be expectant towards the Instrument of the Beyonder.
For him to truly effect change, he had to be and do what others could not even imagine!
Ozymandias gazed at the eldritch horrors around him who looked towards him with many hopeful gazes for the future
They believed him to be someone he wasn't, but he had no qualms about taking this identity as he had already come this far.
So he would simply take it a step further and enjoy the boons that came with it.
"Open."
HUUM!
He uttered out a single word as if he was commanding the Expanse to open up its doors to him.
At the same time, he truly did open a door as the vastness of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...he allowed it to flow into him.
Stellar obsidian radiance flourished with maddening splendor.
An instant later, unfathomable waves of Complexity emerged from Ozymandias, his stellar obsidian body vibrating as it lifted off the dark earth of the Pantheon of Umbra and began to rise up!
From all directions, the Megalos Beyond itself twisted as it seemed like its very surrounding space was flowing into Ozymandias, his complexity rapidly shooting upwards.

The Great Mother looked at this with alarm as her body instantly pulsed to ensure that any weavings from here would head towards a certain point in the Expanse, not expecting the process to be so rapid and so tyrannical!
As if he was making a jump.
As if his complexity could be spurred at any moment, and he was now simply activating it all.
BOOM!
His body became warped with obsidian light as it seemed like a part of it left him- turning into a brilliant burst of light that disappeared above!
Outerversal Morphons watched the scene somberly.

The main body of Ozymandias remained floating grandly, the weavings of the Megalos Beyond surging around him and forming a cocoon as a transformation continued- the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology blooming within him as well. Far from here.
Within a point in the Expanse.

Golden strings glowed faintly as a stellar obsidian body emerged between them, an entity opening his eyes and observing his surroundings to see the shimmering of three countless golden strings...that gradually transformed into obsidian purple strings of light in the distance.
The distance.

There, he saw a massive Blancverse the size of an Omniverse that rejected everything else, billowing purple smoke burning around it so intensely that it even influenced the surrounding strings of existence!

Within the Blancverse, the intricate weavings of countless massive obsidian and purple tentacles could be seen along with structures floating grandiosely within- the complex weavings unique to Outerversal Morphons radiated outwards.
At this moment, an aura seemed to lock down on Ozymandias from within this Blancverse, the aura of powerful entities crossing vast distances in a short time as quickly as they neared his position!
At the forefront, light flickered to reveal an entity in the form of an infinity symbol, her tentacles vibrating with anticipation.
Behind her, auras of Outerversal Morphons burning with the power of Ordinance of Existence entities followed as her intent radiated out grandly.

|I am honored to welcome the Instrument of the Beyonder to this Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse. The Great Beyonder made many homes for us in the Megalos Beyond, and he did the same in the Expanse as there are multiple junctions like this where we can live free. Come.|
The Great Mother appeared and gave a grand Welcome in the Expanse.
Ozymandias followed as all around, his body was absorbing wisps of the power of complexity here as he observed everything.

|A Palace of the Expanse such as this is protected by what is known as a Blancverse- an inviolable domain that even Pioneers sitting above Existence Severing have a hard time making a forceful entry in. Within, there are a few Elder Morphons that have been living for far too many cycles at the Existence Severing stage that oversee many things. We will get you acclimated here first before we begin making moves elsewhere. You have only been alive for days, and should at least show you the joy that all Morphons seek to protect in the Megalos Beyond and in the Expanse...|
The Great Mother, filled with anticipation, led Ozymandias into a domain filled with highly complex Outerversal Morphons!
As Ozymandias made his entry into the Expanse and arrived in the bounds of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse.
Far from such a place, within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Inside a radiant Blancverse, many domains within domains were set up.
Inside one such domain.

Here, a Palace Master was making his way towards the last Existence Severing Palace Master he had to talk to in order to form the strongest coalition of a force that could achieve his aims with surety.

A force filled with powerful Ordinance Amalgamation entities that had successfully been given and utilized a Complexity Modus Operandi that made the way they utilized their power reach multiple octaves higher.
|Palace Master Antiope, sorry for the intrusion.|
His intent radiated out as he descended onto a small domain the size of a world within this Blancverse.

Palace Masters were granted various positions to take within the Blancverse, each one being an Existence Severing Entity as they were given forces under them to command and identities with weight across the Expanse.

When one joined a force like the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, they gained access to a vast array of information accumulated over countless cycles- the locations of unique areas that increased the rate of Complexity of Existence, unique Blancverse Domains, treasures like Hearthraes...and more!

chapters.title: Chapter 3372 The Wheel Turns As The Wheel Turns! I
paragraphs: Most of all, it was the sense of protection.
Because in any Palace of the Expanse, there was likely a Pioneer.
Someone that had gone ahead step further after Existence Severing!
Someone who could walk across the Expanse with a level of confidence.
With entities like these behind them, there was a level of confidence in surviving the calamity to come.
|Hmm? Palace Master Evrin? What brings you here?|
Inside the domain as small as a world.
Thousands of white lotuses bloomed, a terrifying Existence Severing entity seated atop one Lotus as she raised her eyes calmly towards the descending golden figure of Palace Master Evrin.
The woman seated on the lotus carried a terrifying sense of charm, her eyes being pure white with no pupils as they held unfathomable waves of complexity.
Even Palace Master Evrin always felt a sense of trepidation towards this being, and it was why he left her for last.
Palace Master Antiope...she did not seem like any other Existence Severing entity!
Palace Master Evrin gave a light nod as he spoke.

|A minor matter. A Daughter of Existence I sired was killed today as the enemy is a peak Ordinance Amalgamation creature. I do not wish to have any others fall to them as I wanted to send off a few select forces under us that would ensure quick and smooth success. I just wish to borrow one of your Immovable Sacred Legion- or a few combatants from it.|
He wanted to ensure success and that no others in their Palace fell to this enemy.
Palace Master Antiope raised her eyes at such a request before she replied while tapping on the white lotus below her.
|Which creature is so bold as to not care about the identity of a Daughter of Existence?|

|Ah, just a minor character that may not even know about the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse...| Palace Master Evrin waved his hands and conjured the hazy image of the woman surrounded by multicolored radiance.
Her face was hazy, but one could barely see the flash of apathy and utmost confidence within.
Palace Master Antiope raised her eyes languidly as they came to rest upon the illusory figure shown by Evrin, and...
BOOM!

Her white eyes instantly blasted open as a shocking complexity bloomed from it, Palace Master Evrin becoming stern as his body that was entirely severed from any outside existence but himself floating amidst this eruption of complexity calmly while probing what caused such a sudden change!
He saw...the figure of Palace Master Antiope covered by trillions of compressed sheets of complexity all over her body, a terrifying white eye blooming behind her as if she was ready for battle!
Her whole figure emanated a terrifyingly sharp light that even caused Palace Master Evrin to turn somber, and he looked around as he thought they were under attack.
But...
There was nobody here.
The only thing that Palace Master Antiope was still staring at while shocked and panting was...the illusory image of the target he sought to kill to avenge his daughter.
This...this illusory image caused Palace Master Antiope to react in such a way?
|Palace Master Antiope?|
Evrin called out slightly.
And...
Antiope only continued to stare at the illusory image ahead, her eyes finally regaining their focus as her body, which had moved impulsively based on cycles of intuition, finally calmed.
It was just an illusion.
Just an illusion!
But...
|How could she be here? This is...|
Her eyes held a trace of fear.
An Existence Severing entity- fearful!
Palace Master Evrin only looked at this scene with greater and greater shock as he didn't know what was going on!
Did Palace Master Antiope know the veiled entity that had killed his Daughter? And why would she be reacting this way?
|Antiope.|
He called out again.
And Palace Master Antiope snapped out of it and stared at him, her gaze then returning towards the illusory image ahead as she waved her hands and caused it to disappear.
|Hold on. Don't do anything yet!|
Her voice held a sense of clear alarm and shock within it as shockingly, a lotus bloomed where she was as she instantly disappeared.
Before she did, in a whisper nobody could hear, she seemed to be talking to herself as she asked.
|How could she be here? How could the Infiniverse Dowager be in these Weavings of Existence?!|
With a flicker, she had disappeared, leaving behind a dazed Palace Master Evrin!
In the depths of the Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
A lotus flickered in and out of existence as it went deeper and deeper into this Blancverse, entering a region that even Existence Severing entities were barred from entering most times.

She flickered through such areas rapidly before she came to slow down as she neared a domain filled with a blue sea, multiple serene floating islands anchored above this blue sea as she went towards the central one.

On such a floating island, in a field of green gold grasslands and trees, a man was talking with a woman as they both raised their heads up at this moment to observe the frantic entrance of Palace Master Antiope.

The woman emanated a terrifying air of another Existence Severing entity, while the man...his dark hair and blue eyes would cause trepidation even in an Existence Severing entity as he seemed to have exceeded such a stage.
A Pioneer!
Existence Severing were Greater Constellations in terms of Complexity.
Pioneers of Existence...were Elder Constellations as they could walk across the Expanse without fear!
Palace Master Antiope landed on the green gold grasslands as her frantic voice echoed out while she waved her hands.
|She is here. Within this timeline of the Wheel! Within these Weavings of the Wheel- she is here!|
The image of the veiled multicolored woman that was just shown by Palace Master Evrin bloomed once more.
The moment her image was shown, the blue eyes of the Pioneer became stern as the Existence Severing Entity beside him took a step back instinctively.
As if a fear of this being was deeply ingrained within her!
|The Infiniverse Dowager...the Existence Devourer!|
They all recognized her.
The slight veiling, her multicolored radiance- they recognized it all too well!
