|Which creature is so bold as to not care about the identity of a Daughter of Existence?|

|Ah, just a minor character that may not even know about the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse...| Palace Master Evrin waved his hands and conjured the hazy image of the woman surrounded by multicolored radiance.
Her face was hazy, but one could barely see the flash of apathy and utmost confidence within.
Palace Master Antiope raised her eyes languidly as they came to rest upon the illusory figure shown by Evrin, and...
BOOM!

Her white eyes instantly blasted open as a shocking complexity bloomed from it, Palace Master Evrin becoming stern as his body that was entirely severed from any outside existence but himself floating amidst this eruption of complexity calmly while probing what caused such a sudden change!
He saw...the figure of Palace Master Antiope covered by trillions of compressed sheets of complexity all over her body, a terrifying white eye blooming behind her as if she was ready for battle!
Her whole figure emanated a terrifyingly sharp light that even caused Palace Master Evrin to turn somber, and he looked around as he thought they were under attack.
But...
There was nobody here.
The only thing that Palace Master Antiope was still staring at while shocked and panting was...the illusory image of the target he sought to kill to avenge his daughter.
This...this illusory image caused Palace Master Antiope to react in such a way?
|Palace Master Antiope?|
Evrin called out slightly.
And...
Antiope only continued to stare at the illusory image ahead, her eyes finally regaining their focus as her body, which had moved impulsively based on cycles of intuition, finally calmed.
It was just an illusion.
Just an illusion!
But...
|How could she be here?
This is...|
Her eyes held a trace of fear.
An Existence Severing entity- fearful!
Palace Master Evrin only looked at this scene with greater and greater shock as he didn't know what was going on!
Did Palace Master Antiope know the veiled entity that had killed his Daughter?
And why would she be reacting this way?
|Antiope.|
He called out again.
And Palace Master Antiope snapped out of it and stared at him, her gaze then returning towards the illusory image ahead as she waved her hands and caused it to disappear.
|Hold on.
Don't do anything yet!|
Her voice held a sense of clear alarm and shock within it as shockingly, a lotus bloomed where she was as she instantly disappeared.
Before she did, in a whisper nobody could hear, she seemed to be talking to herself as she asked.
|How could she be here?
How could the Infiniverse Dowager be in these Weavings of Existence?!|
With a flicker, she had disappeared, leaving behind a dazed Palace Master Evrin!
In the depths of the Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
A lotus flickered in and out of existence as it went deeper and deeper into this Blancverse, entering a region that even Existence Severing entities were barred from entering most times.

She flickered through such areas rapidly before she came to slow down as she neared a domain filled with a blue sea, multiple serene floating islands anchored above this blue sea as she went towards the central one.

On such a floating island, in a field of green gold grasslands and trees, a man was talking with a woman as they both raised their heads up at this moment to observe the frantic entrance of Palace Master Antiope.

The woman emanated a terrifying air of another Existence Severing entity, while the man...his dark hair and blue eyes would cause trepidation even in an Existence Severing entity as he seemed to have exceeded such a stage.
A Pioneer!
Existence Severing were Greater Constellations in terms of Complexity.
Pioneers of Existence...were Elder Constellations as they could walk across the Expanse without fear!
Palace Master Antiope landed on the green gold grasslands as her frantic voice echoed out while she waved her hands.
|She is here.
Within this timeline of the Wheel!
Within these Weavings of the Wheel- she is here!|
The image of the veiled multicolored woman that was just shown by Palace Master Evrin bloomed once more.
The moment her image was shown, the blue eyes of the Pioneer became stern as the Existence Severing Entity beside him took a step back instinctively.
As if a fear of this being was deeply ingrained within her!
|The Infiniverse Dowager...the Existence Devourer!|
They all recognized her.
The slight veiling, her multicolored radiance- they recognized it all too well!

chapters.title: Chapter 3373 The Wheel Turns As The Wheel Turns! II
paragraphs: This entity had given them and countless others nightmares for far too long.
At this moment, the blue eyes of the stern Pioneer asked quickly.
|What is the context? What is she currently embroiled in?|
Hearing this voice of calm, Antiope also calmed down as she spoke clearly.
|The death of an Ordinance Amalgamation Daughter of Existence- a Daughter of Existence.|
The moment she repeated these words, there was immense silence.
Even after she said them, she also seemed to have realized something.
|Wait...|
Countless weavings clicked.
|This...this is a time before she attained her unshakable power. We've come across her before she even Pioneered her own path! If she is dealing with Ordinance Amalgamation entities now...|
Her heart beat wildly.
Her eyes began to shine with hope!
She looked towards the Pioneer of Existence before her as his blue eyes were contemplative, seeming as if he had come across a truly difficult problem!
|Nobody had ever been successful in finding out the Source Weavings of Existence that the Infiniverse Dowager stemmed from. But you forget. If she is here, then likely...so is he.|
WAA!
Words that caused the gaze of Palace Master Antiope to flicker and change rapidly as she became somber.
The other Palace Master, also an Entity at the Existence Severing stage, shuddered as if she recalled a terrifying memory!
|You mean...the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian could also be within this Weaving of Existence? That...|
A chilling and fearful light flashed in the eyes of this Existence Severing entity.
The Infiniverse Dowager alone was dreadful.
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian? He was a nightmare!
An immense silence ensued the moment his name was mentioned as they felt like the very air became that much more oppressive.
|Heracles...|
Palace Master Antiope looked towards the blue eyes of the Pioneer of Existence.
Someone with such terrifying complexity that no Existence Severing entity could even understand his depth.
Antiope looked at this being as she spoke slowly.

|Nobody- Nobody has ever discovered anything relating to the history of these beings. The Infiniverse Dowager. The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. His Instrument. There are other Calamities that come down the line for multiple Weavings of Existence- for multiple Weavings of the Wheel, but these are among the top. Can you imagine...actually taking them out early? Before they attain their dreadful power? Before they can even use the Turns of the Wheel of Existence?|
Her eyes were truly hopeful.
She thought of all those that could be saved.
All the lives that could be spared.
The destruction that could have been avoided!
Even after hearing her words, the Pioneer of Existence only gazed at her with solemnity.
He seemed to be lost in thought as he looked at far too many things, until he eventually spoke.
|They weren't always Calamities. If that hadn't happened, if the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian was not hunted down. If-|
|What has happened and what will happen across different Weavings of Existence cannot be changed.|
Antiope stopped the reminiscent regrets of the Pioneer of Existence, Heracles.
What happened could not be changed.
What was bound to happen in the future...could not be changed even more! Things had to unfold the way they should unfold.
Heracles shook his head as he thought about many things while Palace Master Antiope continued.

|Imagine it. A future free of at least those Calamities. Timelines of Existence not decimated by them. If we have truly found their Source Weavings of Existence here...you should do well to remember how we all came to be lost in another Weaving of Existence apart from our own. Thrown into weak bodies that are barely allowing us to reclaim our power. You've jumped ahead of us, but you are still bound to our collective goals, Heracles. To protect the Weavings of the Wheel of Existence. Please...tell me we can at least act on this. You have already Pioneered your path once more as if the Infiniverse Dowager is only dealing with Ordinance Amalgamation entities now, your power- our power, may just be sufficient.|
She yearned for hope.
Something.
Anything!
And yet Heracles still shook his head with thought.
His blue eyes shimmered as he spoke calmly.

|Do not forget the capabilities of the Infiniverse Dowager and, even more so, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. The Tyrant that seeks to eclipse all of Existence...he is someone far too many have underestimated, and they had all fallen to him. Common sense means nothing to that being as unless it is a sure kill- unless there is 100% Absolute certainty, anything less than that will be a failure. If we expose ourselves to him here, things could become catastrophic.|
His words poured a cold sea over their hopes and dreams as he reminded them of the other Calamity.
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
An entity all of them thought to be of ancient nature- having stemmed from the oldest weavings of Existence itself!
A survivor of the extinction of the Megalonians cycles ago. In all possible Weavings of Existence, the Megalonians always perished due to their brilliance.
None survived.
None but the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.

|If we make a move and fail- destroy a body of his but not everything. Leave any trace of our weavings...he will gradually come to find out about us. His nature defies the weavings of existence entirely as just imagine he gets his hands on any of us. Our weavings. Our memories. Would that not result in an even greater Calamity? If he knew what we know?|
Immense silence came down.
They calculated and just thought of the mere possibility of failure as their gazes turned ashen.
In this point of immense silence...
|But, your words have merit.|
The Pioneer of Existence, Heracles, voiced out with a sigh.
He crouched down and touched the green gold grass below him as his blue eyes calculated countless possibilities.

|Maybe the turning of the Wheel led us all here. We escaped from our Weavings of Existence to run from the decimation of the Infiniverse Dowager, only to be lost through time and weavings. For us to come into these weavings that may very well be the Source Weavings of so many Calamities...|

chapters.title: Chapter 3374 The Wheel Turns As The Wheel Turns! III
paragraphs: Heracles didn't finish his last words as the two women beside him looked at each other.
Antiope had been speaking this whole time, but in the next moment, the other Existence Severing Palace Master, who hadn't said much, opened her mouth.

|We do not even necessarily have to try and expose ourselves in erasing his weavings. All we need to do is cut off his pathway and the pathway of the Infiniverse Dowager to advance. Remember, our existence in these Weavings of Existence itself is an anomaly, with much of our weavings and memories blocked off. If any of us were to die or be captured by the Infiniverse Dowager or the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, they wouldn't be able to gain too much. The Wheel would not allow such an imbalance- and you can just look at us and how we've had to struggle here as an example. If we could pull upon all that we knew, if critical parts of ourselves were not completely blocked off, would we not have reached the stage of those cruel beings simply observing all of this chaos from above after all these cycles?|
WAA!
Bundles of what seemed like extremely important pieces of information leaked out from this being, and she continued calmly!

|Everything comes at a cost, we know this. So we can move slowly. We need to gather much more information and not just go from conjecture. We need to confirm the sighting of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, we need to confirm their current stage of power. And from there...the possibilities of what we can do are endless.|
Antiope looked at the red haired Palace Master, Nisa, who stated such an intent as she nodded.
She slowly paced around the green gold grasslands as she also added on.

|And let's not count our complexity of Existence out just yet. We fear the future Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, yes, but the current ones here...may not be as existence defying as the ones we know.|
She sought to bolster their confidence as the moment she said these words...
|Never think like that again.|
Heracles raised his head and corrected her sternly.
Palace Master Antiope paused and turned around as Heracles continued.

|Even here, treat them with the same level of caution and fear. Many underestimated them in the past and future, we cannot do the same. First, let us gather more information. And only after we have absolute certainty in any move we choose to make, and then two or three fallback plans just in case that absolute certainty turns out to not be so absolute...only then do we move. Understood?|
He laid his words down with an undeniable pressure that even caused their complexity at the Existence Severing stage to quiver as the two nodded.
Palace Master Antiope rose up as she voiced out sternly.
|I will mix my forces with those that Palace Master Evrin is amassing. I will advise him to only monitor and understand the one who killed his daughter first and not yet make a move.|

|Mmm, and keep it strictly other forces. Do not impose your will to possess any of them for you to observe yourself, nor mix any trace weavings of your existence. Cut yourself out of the process entirely as our weavings cannot get discovered.|
The words of Pioneer Heracles rang out again as Palace Master Antiope paused and nodded, her figure flickering out of existence.
She left behind only two beings who raised their gazes to observe the illusory image of a veiled woman that reminded them of too many things.
Looking at it, Heracles couldn't help but sigh as he thought of what could have been!
|The Wheel turns as the Wheel turns...nobody can stop it. Nobody can predict it...we can only do our best.|
Countless profundity and emotion lay within these words as among those here, only someone like him could truly understand what they meant.
A distance away from here, Palace Master Evrin had been thoughtfully pondering recent actions as he replayed the reaction of Palace Master Antiope again and again.
For her to react like that...had he stumbled onto something that could even frighten an Existence Severing Palace Master?
It didn't make sense.
But moments after...
WAP!
Palace Master Antiope returned with a calm gaze and spoke to him.

|You can have the Lotus Immovable Sacred Legion under me. I will advise you to first monitor everything regarding your target and those around it before making a move as I suspect they may be connected to another Sacred Palace of the Expanse- or a force that could trigger the dominoes of war. I'm heavily interested in this as I'll work with you hand in hand...|
Her eyes carried a chillingly sharp light as Palace Master Evrin couldn't help but be cautioned by such a rapid change!
Far from the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
In a region filled with endless golden strings, a man floated silently as four massive corpses surrounded his illustrious figure.
The corpse of a massive Ancient Phrike, a Necrotic Nest-Slug, and a Nihilos Shelled Snail.
There was also the Corpse of the Vital Fist Emperor, whose last shred of weavings was actually just lying in wait to see if they could deny the weavings of existence itself.
Three Ordinance Amalgamation Entities, and one who was on the cusp of Existence Severing and had failed!
These were the bundles of loot lying before him as moments later, space fluctuated around him as the Infiniverse Megalos Body appeared.
||I shall analyze and prepare them for you, Master.||
As if she was telling someone she would prepare food for them.

Her voice was succinct as Noah gave a nod of affirmation, watching this brilliant cluster of complexity that somehow all came from a small Spiritual Land go forward and appear inches away from the corpse of the Vital Fist Emperor.
Within the depths of this Corpse, a silent Ordinance was aroused as it felt like its chance had finally come, and it got ready to pounce the moment that any weavings made contact with it!
And...!
HUUM!

The calm visage of the Infiniverse Megalos Body pressed forward with a perilous and heavy burst of complexity that burst across the corpse of the Vital Fist Emperor- decimating any remnant weavings within it and collapsing them entirely.
What had remained of the Vital Fist Emperor watched this scene with shock and despair at the failure of resurgence as it wondered before it disappeared entirely.
Who the hell strikes against a corpse with such callous cruelty?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3375 The Wheel Turns As The Wheel Turns! IV
paragraphs: In a nondescript point of the Expanse, a uniquely complex entity collapsed the last weavings of another that had failed Existence Severing.

Her hands then began to move as she dissected and cut open this entity along with three others, studying their Physiology and makeup before they were turned into threads of weavings under her own unique design.

Quite a distance away from here, there was another complex entity just recently arriving in the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, being led by an infinity symbol pulsing with tentacles as his journey there had depended on legends passed down from eons past.
Legends of an instrument that would come and change the landscape of the Megalos Beyond- legends that this entity grasped for himself whether they truly represented him or not.
Another tremendous distance away from here, Immovable Sacred Legions were already dispatched to catch the scent and obtain weavings of information about a certain entity.
At first glance, these events may not have any correlation whatsoever, and yet the weavings of every single action and reaction pushed the spokes of the Wheel further!
Far from these interactions of complex weavings.

In an area of weavings carrying much greater complexity- an area that Terrestrial Entities nor Constellations Entities would ever be capable of entering unless they utterly transformed everything about themselves.

Within such an area of complexity, a humanoid entity whose body was formed from solid white astral radiance was looking out into an area filled with immense waves of complexity while raising an object in his hands.
The object...seemed to be a clock.
And yet this clock held nine hands that seemed to constantly be moving chaotically, making it very hard to discern anything!
This Entity sighed while he looked at the area of immense complexity while voicing out lightly.
|Even after everything we know, you still interfered, Sir Bob.|
His voice was only for himself, and it seemed to be one of melancholy and helplessness.
Bob.

This white solidified astral entity was gazing towards the weavings of such an entity as the only thing that could be seen currently were hundreds of sharp lines that seemed to be extending from a single singularity.
No, not lines.
Spokes.
Spokes that stemmed from nothing else other than a Wheel.
As this entity thought of this, it counted all the different Spokes of the Wheel that Bob had visited recently.
The different Weavings of the Wheel!
The weavings of the Wheel of Existence came in different forms.
Different variations that held entirely different flows of time and existence itself.
Each Weaving of Existence held a different type of complexity- a different type of Frequency.
Different types of spokes!

In simpler terms, a spoke was a singular rod that extended from the center of a wheel to its rim, with many spokes coming together to support the whole structure of the Wheel and allow it to rotate seamlessly.
To allow countless intricate weavings to flow together.
Countless variations of existence.
Any Wheel had many Spokes holding it up, with some lines of spokes being much more critical than others.
Bob had visited some truly critical Spokes of the Wheel.
The things he did within each were veiled even to this being, but he had heard from others.
Bob wasn't the only one that had moved.
Others had as well.
This made this entity and many others maddened as they knew Bob and those like him held tremendous knowledge- far more than any of them could have over countless lifetimes.

They should know that any interference to any Frequency of the Wheel- to any Weavings of the Wheel they were only supposed to ensure the flow of, would only muddy the waters and cause the rise of more chaos.
They all knew something was coming.
They all knew that it was unavoidable.
So why?
Why did they still muddy the waters while knowing what they knew?!
This entity did not have the answer.
So he could only sigh once more.
|The Wheel turns as the Wheel turns.|
|At the end of the day, even we are powerless against it, Sir Bob. Even we cannot stop what is coming. We-|
|Are you talking behind my back ?|
HUUM!
The solidified white astral entity trembled as his words came to a stop, feeling the sensation of the shocking complexity that was Sir Bob behind him as he swallowed hard.
He could feel the round head of this complex entity even without turning around as he heard the serene voice.

|Don't worry too much about the flow of things, little guy. None of us can change much. The individual power any single being can wield is incomparable to the countless complex weavings of the Wheel. If even I tried to fight it, I would be crushed instantly as I would never be able to stop the Weaving of the Wheel for even an instant, much less reverse or alter things within it. Whatever I did won't do much at the end of the day.|

|Haha, the Wheel turns as the Wheel turns...you all have been whispering that so much that a lot of kids are saying it nowadays. Even referring to those they do not understand as cruel. Cruel...do I seem cruel to you? I am just Bob, a harmless little thing on the scales of everything, and you don't see me constantly whispering about the turns of the Wheel. What do you all even know about the Wheel? Simplify things for yourselves and do not worry so much. Come, there is work to be done, and you cannot slack off.|
Brilliance unfurled.
Inside the far distance, hundreds of massive Spokes flowed with order and serenity.
There was one particularly massive Spoke that subtly flashed with a silent radiance.
Nobody saw such a flash of radiance.
Nobody would even know what it meant.
Inside of this Spoke of the Wheel.
Inside of this Weaving of Existence- this Frequency of Existence.

Boundless brilliance was contained within it as in an insignificant corner of it, a Great One in the form of a tentacled infinity symbol led Ozymandias through the gates of a Blancverse radiating seas of Outerversal Authority!

Her hands then began to move as she dissected and cut open this entity along with three others, studying their Physiology and makeup before they were turned into threads of weavings under her own unique design.

Another tremendous distance away from here, Immovable Sacred Legions were already dispatched to catch the scent and obtain weavings of information about a certain entity.
At first glance, these events may not have any correlation whatsoever, and yet the weavings of every single action and reaction pushed the spokes of the Wheel further!
Far from these interactions of complex weavings.

Bob.

chapters.title: Chapter 3376 The Wheel Turns As The Wheel Turns! V
paragraphs: |I brought you to this Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse not just to localize you here and lead you to different regions of the Megalos Beyond from here, but also to see if it would be viable for you to grasp an opportunity.|

The Great Mother radiated her intent as Ozymandias listened closely, delving into a Blancverse shimmering with obsidian radiance as massive pulsing tentacles stretched throughout, and obsidian Nests and singularities could be seen anchored in different regions as terrifying auras of Outerversal Morphons were contained within.
In the short while that they had been moving, a figure of an old man appeared in front of them as it was none other than the Observer of Old and Young.
He nodded towards Ozymandias and the Great Mother as he came to follow beside them calmly.
As if he merely wanted to continue being an Observer!
The Great Mother laughed at this and continued.

|In this Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, there is an Existence Severing Great One whose body allows for unique means of increasing complexity. Inside her, the shackles of the slow grind of complexity are loosened greatly as she severed them to a tremendous degree, and any methodology of increasing complexity carried out inside her for the first time will yield terrifying results. If she allows you to step inside of her Severed Existence, we may be able to give you yet another bump in your elevation of complexity to welcome you to the Expanse.|
Her words were shocking ones as Ozymandias listened closely while moving forward.

The murky obsidian region of this Blancverse was slowly showing the massive tentacles flowing like roots at this moment, and the Great Mother floated down to land on a particular tentacle while the rest followed.
Thereafter, a tentacle emerged from her body to form into a horror inducing palm- a palm that touched the massive tentacle below as she spoke!
|The Great Mother seeks an audience with the Great Segregator.|
WAA!
A simple intent that traversed across the tentacle!
And a few seconds after...
HUUM!
An obsidian light flashed that wrapped around their bodies and began pulling them forward- their figures sinking deeper into the pulsating Blancverse thereafter.
Weavings of Outerversal Authority embedded and flowed like a deluge of a black sea as within seconds, their figures slowed down and appeared in an isolated domain.

At the center of this domain, an oscillating obsidian flower floated calmly, the bud of this flower showing an ancient face with filled solemnity as millions of tentacles budded off of it like rose buds.
Its aura was a heavy one as it seemed to exist on its own volition of existence, with its ancient eyes gazing forth at those before it.
|You rarely seek others out, Great Mother. For you to be here...this is for the supposed Instrument of the Beyonder you have found?|
News traveled fast.
Especially when it was related to myths and legends as from one Pantheon to another!
The tentacles of the Great Mother swirled with power as they bent down in slight respect.

|Great Segregator, Netherflower, I came to bid for the Instrument of the Beyonder to increase the level of his complexity for a time within your Severed Domain. Given his accomplishments, I have no doubt that the Great Segregator will also benefit greatly from it.|
Yes.

Her Severed Domain was a unique one as after she tested it cycles ago, it was found that any other entity undergoing great change in their complexity within her Domain faced much fewer restrictions within their existence, and there was a feedback of complexity to the Great Segregator as well!
All she had to do was allow entry and provide the space, and she even stood to benefit from it. And yet...
|What if it is not what you say? What if the gains are minimal for me having to spend a decent amount of effort to open up that Severed Domain?|
A cruel light passed in the eyes of the swaying obsidian flower as the Great Mother answered as if she had expected this part of her nature.
|If I am wrong, the Great Segregator can devour half of my Complexity of Existence.|
A terrifying cost!
But the Great Mother was that confident as beside her, the face of the Observer of Old and Young changed while Ozymandias became stern.
A jagged, cruel laughter erupted from the flower ahead as its face began to open, revealing an endless obsidian stretch of radiance as its intent echoed out.

|I will take that offer. But I am not cruel- I look up to the Great Beyonder as well. You can both enter- if his weavings are as explosive as you say, then even you will be able to benefit from his rise in complexity. If it is nothing to talk about...then I will move to honor your offer.|
Half of her complexity was on the line.
And yet the Great Mother was unfettered as she beckoned to Ozymandias, the two of them being pulled towards the unfurled obsidian flower and flowing into it as they entered a terrifying space.
The moment Ozymandias passed through the mouth of the flower, he felt as if a buzzing weight and noise that was there the entire time faded away.
He felt lighter.
As if there were many things that bogged him down, and this space he was in isolated all of that!
Not entirely, but by a great deal.
|The unique Severed Domain of the Great Segregator. Here, a rise in complexity is many times more potent and faster than outside of it. Just do what you would normally do without worries.|
Beside him, the Great Mother seemed to be smiling with her tentacles as she spoke, Ozymandias gazing at her and the great lengths she was willing to go as he began to think.
When it came to a rise in complexity of the weavings of existence, there were a few means.
But at this moment, he could only think of one thing.
Inside of him, a certain rune was shimmering with brightness once more as, after all this time, the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was ripe once more!
He could dream.
But he didn't know how terrifying the dream would be if it was being done in a space that Severed the weavings of the outside existence entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 3377 A Dream of a Different Tune! I
paragraphs: The Great Segregator.
An Existence Severing Eldritch entity in the form of a massive flower.
Currently, the figures of the Great Mother and Ozymandias were within her unique Severed Domain as she had many musings flowing through her.
Many had always paid a great cost to utilize her Severed Domain, with this space being something she uniquely discovered years after she Severed her own existence to be free and unfettered.

After devouring a few entities into this space, an Ordinance Amalgamation creature that struggled and tried to make a breakthrough before his weavings were ground down and collapsed, and this entity was shocked to find that his progress that always seemed stalled and heavy became light and free-flowing!

The last bouts of complexity that evaded him before he could sever his own existence seemed to be coming to him rapidly as he began to increase his complexity, seeking to sever his existence and break out of the Domain of the Great Segregator.
When this entity did this, the Great Segregator discovered her own slow ebb of weavings beginning to move- as if catalyzed by the new weavings advancing within her.
Even though they weren't as complex as hers, the variations and uniqueness in weavings allowed her own to experience a significant advancement.

But of course, she couldn't have an Ordinance Amalgamation entity actually sever his existence with her, no matter if he would be successful or not, so this being who allowed her to initially see the usage of her Severed Domain was decimated by her moments later as he never stood a chance.
Since then, she had made her weavings known as for a cost, genius Outerversal Morphons could step into her Domain and cultivate!
She made gains from it in complexity, and made even further gains once a cost was made for use.
But out of all beings to utilize her Severed Domain so far, only three were truly memorable to her for the extent of advancement they provided.
The first entity who almost Severed his existence.
A Great One that had risen cycles ago whose name was now feared across the Megalos Beyond- the Great Ruler.
And an Outerversal Morphon who advanced from attaining their Eyes of the Megalos all the way to Ordinance Amalgamation in a single year.
A year.

Such an event had caused a shocking commotion to the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, with that Entity having long exceeded the Great Segregator in complexity as he had even Pioneered his own path!
A legend among Outerversal Morphons.
The Great Nexus.

These three beings were the main memorable ones as the Great Nexus cultivating within her Severed Domain had allowed her to cement her position as an Existence Severing expert- very few Outerversal Morphons being able to shake her within this same stage.
After all these cycles, she could tell the moment an entity started increasing their complexity whether they would provide a significant enough boon for her, or whether it would be minimal.

Her own Severed Domain would show a tell purely depending on how much complexity and the degree of freedom an entity gained after escaping the outside weavings of the Expanse or Megalos Beyond. If her Severed Domain vibrated, she was always in a good mood as this meant she could expect a somewhat significant boost in her own complexity.
If an obsidian radiance of the megalos shone within it, even more so!

The Great Nexus had even shown the Manifestation of the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse the moment any sense of shackles were unbound from him as the Great Segregator had made tremendous gains then.
So...what would the supposed Instrument of the Beyonder bring?
'If half of the things they've said about him are true, then I should make suffic-'
RIIP!
A massive, interminable tear instantly bloomed and caused her Severed Domain to vibrate and tumble chaotically.

Her intent began to rise in incredulity and confusion as above Ozymandias, a rune of Amarantos flashed with shocking radiance before it released Shockwaves of brilliance- a phenomenal reaction occurring as the simple reality that this rune was activating in a space free from the weavings of existence of the Expanse and Megalos seemed to have triggered a shocking reaction!
Free from the weavings of existence. Free...from the weavings of the Wheel, by a certain extent.
A dream was initiated in such an environment.

And the Great Segregator did not know this, but for the initiation of this dream, the terrifying complexity of an Infiniverse Megalos Seed quite a distance from here was allowed to flow freely to power up this dream!
The complexity of something that had never before emerged.
The ability passed down from the Great Beyonder.
The unique environment brought forth by the Great Segregator.
And Ozymandias himself.

Multiple factors came together to produce an unimaginable result as above Ozymandias, the rune of Amarantos blared with heavy radiance- this entire space fluctuating as stellar obsidian weavings of the Megalos Beyond unfurled around it!
Below, a massive obsidian Primordial Mountain of the Expanse bloomed as above, a Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree emerged and gushed down waves of complexity!
But this wasn't all.
From all around, illusory golden strings of the Expanse itself began to manifest.
Uncountable in number, brilliant in their Manifestation.
Strings of Existence. Strings of the Expanse!

A terrific convergence and recipe for disaster seemed to be blooming here as the rip that had bloomed within this Severed Domain became even more massive, as if it wasn't meant to isolate and sever such a shocking degree of complexity as it was almost collapsing!

Shocked and infuriated, the Great Segregator bellowed out as terrifying droves of her own unique Severed Existence erupted out, flowing voraciously into the Severed Domain and holding it steady as if it collapsed, a large part of herself would collapse as well.
Steadiness came into the domain as she looked with rising rage and incredulity within, wondering if this was a plot from the Great Mother to kill her in their very own Blancverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3378 A Dream of a Different Tune! II
paragraphs: But the Great Segregator could see the shock and confusion on the Great Mother herself as her body began pulsing with obsidian light, her form of an infinity symbol beginning to glow as if even she was affected by this rising complexity.

After the brief period of impending doom of her Severed Domain, the moment of stability allowed the Great Segregator to feel a sense of rising horror and shock as from the depths of her weavings, she felt ridiculously complex weavings of Existence arise and begin to proliferate in a way she could have never imagined.
A type of complexity of existence that she seemed far away from.
It rose and began to seethe within her as the moment she stabilized her Severed Domain, she began to feel the boons that came with the ridiculous weavings unfolding within her.
At this moment, she felt like she finally understood as her Severed Domain...seemed to only be getting utilized as a conduit.

It should have merely allowed others to explode with complexity outside the influence of the Expanse and Megalos, but the Instrument of the Beyonder within had enacted enough of a change that now, her Domain was used akin to a passage to allow something that should have theoretically not been possible!
As for what it was, even she didn't know.

All she knew was the rousing complexity that didn't seem to only benefit her, but even the Great Mother within her Domain seemed to be benefiting as her body in the form of an Infinity symbol seemed to be coursing with boundless obsidian waves of brilliance- influenced by the shimmering rune of Amarantos spinning above Ozymandias as at this moment, it let out a blinding light that almost seemed like it wanted to pause everything!
As if this moment would forever be halted in its weavings of time.
Above the blaring rune of Amarantos.

Ozymandias was only able to stare at it for an instant before his vast consciousness buzzed into oblivion, feeling his existence pulled in a way that never occurred before as he came to understand the Dream he initiated this time around...would be an utterly incomprehensible one!
Within the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse.

On this day, many auras within were aroused as near the center of the Blancverse this power belonging to the Megalos Beyond was situated, a glaring obsidian light filled with heavy complexity bloomed for an instant.
Only an instant!
But its complexity was enough to alarm even Existence Severing entities.
A dream.
An Outerversal Morphon seemed to be waking up from an endlessly long dream, his weavings feeling fractured and out of sorts as he gathered himself and set his will outwards.
As if he was regaining his vision, he saw that he lay on a field of swaying black gold grass.

He rose as his hands passed through this grass, seeing a humanoid obsidian stellar skin as when he looked at himself fully, he found that he was entirely humanoid in nature- but his body was simply made up of the vastness of the Megalos Beyond itself as he glowed with a dim obsidian stellar radiance.

He rose as his hands passed through this grass, seeing a humanoid obsidian stellar skin as when he looked at himself fully, he found that he was entirely humanoid in nature- but his body was simply made up of the vastness of the Megalos Beyond itself as he glowed with a dim obsidian stellar radiance.
A single wing burning with obsidian flames stretched out behind his back, and a halo of obsidian radiance floated above him.
Soon, he regained more of his cognition as he realized he was not alone.
To his left, there was an entity letting out serene waves of Ordinance Amalgamation and those of Matter, her skin tanned and shining with a bronze hue as her hair glowed with bright gold radiance.
She seemed to be sleeping at this moment, with his gaze on her waking her up at this moment.
Her eyes fluttered to show gold pupils that looked towards him with a happy smile, her exquisite figure rising up at this moment and coming closer to him as she came to rest her head on his lap.

"We can't keep hiding in this little dream of ours, Archimedes. The Great Instrument of the Beyonder has already made a Decree for all those at Existence Severing and below to gather and prepare for the Incursion into Megalos Nihilos. We cannot delay this any longer."
An Entity made of Matter. A human.
She currently looked towards him, Archimedes, an Outerversal Morphon, with love and care.
She wasn't bound to him.
She wasn't a Delegatus.
And yet, they were together.
His head felt a splitting pain as if weavings of memories were about to erupt, scattered and everywhere all at once!
"Are you okay? I told you not to mess around with the techniques of the Great Beyonder. Only his Instrument is able to use them to perfection as the rest of us cannot compare."
In his scattered state, the woman before him grabbed his head tenderly and asked as he blinked and cleared his weavings, some memories returning as he looked around.
He turned his gaze above and spread his will out as he found himself in a massive Omniverse, and outside of it...he could see the start of an even more massive Pantheon in the distance!
An Omniverse and a Pantheon close together.
When his will spread further out, he saw weavings of both Matter and Dark Matter leaking into each other as it seemed like the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere were mixed together chaotically!
"Archimedes?"
The woman before him grasped his head with concern as he shook himself out of his reverie and smiled.
Some memories came back.
Memories of this place.
He forced a smile as he floated up.
"I'm okay, Lacana. Come on, let's get going."

His voice was magnetic as Lacana nodded with hesitation, their figures rising up and shooting out of the small planet within the calm Omniverse where Outerversal Morphons and Lineages linked to Matter could all be seen mixed together.
The two of them went towards a certain sector where the Great Instrument of the Beyonder was gathering all forces under his command as he sought to stretch out his influence across all Megalos!
'The Great Instrument of the Beyonder...'
Archimedes thought this as scattered memories came and went, a rune of Amarantos shining brilliantly within him as his sense of cognition slowly returned.
What he knew of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder also flowed in freely.
An entity of great reverence and power that had managed to expand the Megalos Beyond into the Megalos Ynnere.
He had only glimpsed his brilliance once when this entity was decimating Existence Severing Antediluvian Leviathans.
Moving on four limbs, a massive body radiating brutality and brilliance.
The Great Instrument of the Beyonder, Kurai!
It was not Ozymandias.
It caused Archimedes, who was accepting many fractured memories to wonder.
Exactly where was he?

chapters.title: Chapter 3379 A Dream of a Different Tune! III
paragraphs: Archimedes!
An Ordinance Amalgamation powerhouses- an Outerversal Morphon that was known as the Great Titan.
This was his identity as among the Ordinance Amalgamation Entities, he was a renowned one.
Finding companionship in a human Ordinance Amalgamation Entity aligned with Matter had caused many to talk behind his back about his preferences, but none dared to say anything to his face.

Under the banner of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder, Kurai, both the forces of the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere now fell and moved under his command as Outerversal Morphons and Lineages of humans and beasts intermingled!
Gradually over the last thousand years.
And now, a thousand years after the conquest of Megalos Ynnere, the Great Instrument of the Beyonder moved for Megalos Nihilos.
All forces would answer his call and participate, or have their weavings marked for decimation by the Great Instrument of the Beyonder and his Champions.
This, Archimedes and his woman, Lacana, moved towards a Sector that held a portion of the forces of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder- led by an Existence Severing Champion!
"It's certainly not quiet..." Lacana raised her brows as they arrived near a bustling Pantheon.

On it, terrifying auras converged as with a single glance, Archimedes could sense a bit over 100 Existence Severing Entities here, a few thousand at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage, tens of thousands of Ordinance of Existence entities, and hundreds of thousands of others below them who had attained the state of Eye of Existence or One With Existence!
It was a terrifying cluster of forces, but it was only a portion of those under the banner of the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere.

Archimedes could see that at the center of the Pantheon, a massive obsidian Tiger Whale floated with a horrific aura of power, obsidian tentacles leaking from its body as this was the Existence Severing Champion leading forces from this Sector- The Great Demolisher!
Near him, the calm visage of a multicolored Antediluvian Leviathan could be seen as existence itself seemed to be parting ways from him.
Other Existence Severing entities converged around these beings as they waited for the command of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder.
Uniquely, as Archimedes continued to look around these beings, he found a very scant amount of Simians of the Commonwealth!
Not just scant, but none of them really.
He frowned at this as he and Lacana arrived near a cluster of Ordinance Amalgamation entities within a Bazaar, his voice unconsciously leaking out.
"The Simians of the Commonwealth..." He had scattered memories regarding this as Lacana stared at him in surprise before replying with a look of pity.

"Why mention that extinct race? They enraged the Antediluvian Leviathans during the early stages of the Megalos War which eventually led to their defeat. Under the Origin Leviathan, the Commonwealth and all Simians were decimated and erased across history."
Simians- extinct!
Such a reality caused Archimedes' mind to buzz as he felt that this Dream...became more and more foreign!
It didn't feel right.
It didn't feel like what he knew.
Outerversal Morphons and Lineages of Matter passed around them in this Pantheon as more and more forces were gathered, until one day- the order came from above to set off.
Above the Pantheon, Existence weaved and split apart as if paper was being torn.
The Great Instrument of the Beyonder had inherited a shocking Transcendental Technique of the Beyonder as his means were too mysterious, allowing for him to open up pathways across the Megalos!
On that day, pathways were opened above multiple Pantheons and Omniverses where the forces of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder were clustered, and the war against Nihilos began.
Archimedes followed the throngs of forces as, with Lacana by his side, they delved across the torn pathway to arrive at a region of white-gray blank space.
A space seemingly filled with emptiness and nothingness, and yet the moment they entered...
SCREE!

From the white blankness, massive gray spiders appeared with spikes, legs, and thousands of eyes, Existence around them having been severed as they bore down towards the coming armies as if they knew exactly where they would appear!
Behind the Existence Severing gray spiders, Legions of obsidian worms also rose and surged out like an endless sea as a terrifying battle started.
A war with Existence Severing entities in the lead, Ordinance Amalgamation Entities taking on a somewhat critical role, and all those below them acting like cannon fodder!
It was long and bloody.

A year passed since the war began, and Archimedes gained a thorough grasp of knowledge on a few regions of the Megalos Nihilos and those that moved within it as he decimated Ordinance of Existence and Ordinance Amalgamation entities while studying their bodies and makeup.
Those who knew of the Great Titan, Archimedes, said behind his back that he had gone crazy after spending so many days in the soft thighs of a human.
The Great Titan merely continued with his research as the war waded on, coming to understand quite a bit regarding the Systems of Existence of those within the Megalos Nihilos!
Another unique point he came to grasp during all this...was his search for those he knew of before.
The Observer of Old and Young.
The Great Mother.
The Great Wheel.
The Great Ponderor.
The Great Segregator.

No weavings of such beings were discovered, and months ago he had grasped onto weavings of the Great Mother in another regiment as when he went to go see...he only observed the visage of a massive octopus with thousands of tentacles at the Existence Severing stage.
Not an entity who was countless tentacles in the form of an infinity symbol.

It was another oddity that made Archimedes realize this dream was far too different, along with the fact that unlike the other Amarantos Dreams of the Megalos he had before, this felt far, far too real!
As if even though it was musings of a Dream, it was actually weavings of existence that seemed to be undeniably occurring all around him.
It was not based on the Megalos that he knew.
It was based on something else entirely as the weavings he found himself in...felt like those of an entirely different frequency of Existence than what he knew!
